definition_zh: 多样性；差异；种类繁多；人群或组织的多元构成；生物多样性；遗传多样性；语言与文化多样性；用指数度量的差异程度
definition_en: the state or quality of being different or varied: a range of distinct kinds, the fact of difference, and the measurable variety of a group, population, or system
core_image: 一条河在入海口分成十几条水道，每条水道带走不同颜色的泥沙
scene: Where the river splits into a dozen channels, each carrying a different load of silt, the delta shows its diversity.
sceneCN: 这里 diversity 是「种类繁多、彼此不同」（第 1 个义项：多样性）；句意：河流分成十几条水道，每条携带的泥沙各不相同，三角洲因此显出它的多样性。图中可辨识物件：分叉的河道、不同颜色的水流、沉积的沙洲、远处的芦苇、河口的测量桩。

pos.zh: 多样性；差异；多元构成；生物多样性；遗传多样性

collocations.zh: 多元与包容（企业人事政策）

forms.label: 复数（多种多样性／多个差异）

derivatives.zh: 使多样化；扩大经营品类

senses.title: Variety of kinds: many different sorts held together
senses.titleCN: 种类繁多：许多不同的东西聚在一起
senses.definition: the quality of including or consisting of many different types or kinds
senses.definitionCN: 包含或由许多不同类型、不同种类构成的性质
senses.example: The market's diversity of goods surprised visitors from the capital.
senses.exampleCN: 集市上货物的种类之繁多，让来自首都的访客感到惊讶。
senses.why: Latin diversitas is the noun of diversus, the past participle of divertere 'to turn apart'. Things that have turned in different directions are, by that image, different kinds; the noun names the resulting spread.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 diversitas 是 diversus 的名词形式，而 diversus 是 divertere“转开”的过去分词。朝不同方向转开的东西，按这个意象就是不同的种类；名词命名的正是这种铺开的分布。

senses.title: Difference itself: the fact of not being the same
senses.titleCN: 差异本身：彼此不相同这件事
senses.definition: the fact or degree to which two or more things differ from one another
senses.definitionCN: 两个或更多事物彼此不同的这一事实或程度
senses.example: The diversity between the two dialects is small but audible.
senses.exampleCN: 两种方言之间的差异不大，却听得出。
senses.why: The earliest English use, from Old French diversité, named 'difference' before it named 'variety'. Divertere's 'turn apart' still shows: difference is the angle between two paths that once ran together.
senses.whyCN: 英语最早经古法语 diversité 借入时，先表示“差异”，后才有“繁多”。divertere 的“转开”仍在其中：差异就是两条原本并行的路分开后形成的夹角。

senses.title: Social mixture: different groups sharing one place
senses.titleCN: 人群多元：不同群体共处一处
senses.definition: the presence of people of different backgrounds, identities, or origins within one group or institution
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体或机构中存在不同背景、身份或来源的人
senses.example: The committee's diversity changed how decisions were made.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会的多元构成改变了决策的方式。
senses.why: When the 'range of kinds' is applied to people, the kinds become backgrounds and identities. The word then names a social fact rather than a biological or statistical one, though the image of different paths remains.
senses.whyCN: 当“种类范围”被用于人时，种类就变成背景与身份。词义于是指向一种社会事实，而不是生物或统计事实，但“不同的路”这一意象仍在。

senses.title: Biological diversity: many species in one habitat
senses.titleCN: 生物多样性：一个生境里物种众多
senses.definition: the variety of species, ecosystems, and genetic material in a defined area
senses.definitionCN: 某一区域内物种、生态系统与遗传物质的多样程度
senses.example: Coral reefs hold more diversity than any other marine habitat.
senses.exampleCN: 珊瑚礁拥有的物种多样性超过任何其他海洋生境。
senses.why: The compound biodiversity was coined in the 1980s for exactly this sense, but it borrows diversity's core image: many different forms branching from one living system.
senses.whyCN: 复合词 biodiversity 于 1980 年代为这个义项而造，但它借用的仍是 diversity 的核心意象：许多不同形态从同一个生命系统分叉而出。

senses.title: Genetic diversity: variation inside a population
senses.titleCN: 遗传多样性：种群内部的基因差异
senses.definition: the total range of inherited variation carried by the individuals of a population
senses.definitionCN: 一个种群中各个个体所携带的可遗传变异的总范围
senses.example: A narrow gene pool leaves crops with little genetic diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 狭窄的基因库使作物几乎没有遗传多样性。
senses.why: Here the 'different kinds' are alleles rather than species. Because a population with few alleles has few paths to take when conditions change, diversity becomes a measure of survival options.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“不同种类”是等位基因而不是物种。等位基因少的种群在环境变化时可选的路也少，于是 diversity 成了生存选项的度量。

senses.title: Cultural and linguistic diversity: many tongues and traditions
senses.titleCN: 文化与语言多样性：多种语言和传统
senses.definition: the coexistence of different languages, customs, and traditions in a society
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会中不同语言、习俗与传统的同时存在
senses.example: Urban schools reflect the linguistic diversity of the city.
senses.exampleCN: 城市学校反映出这座城市的语言多样性。
senses.why: Applied to culture, the separated paths are languages and traditions that developed apart. The word treats them as resources to be counted and protected, not as deviations from one norm.
senses.whyCN: 用于文化时，被分开的“路”是各自独立发展的语言和传统。这个词把它们看作可计数、需保护的资源，而不是偏离某一标准的偏差。

senses.title: Workplace diversity: a policy of mixing and including
senses.titleCN: 职场多元：混合与包容的制度安排
senses.definition: an organizational policy aimed at recruiting and retaining people of varied backgrounds
senses.definitionCN: 旨在招募并留住不同背景人员的组织政策
senses.example: The firm publishes an annual report on diversity and inclusion.
senses.exampleCN: 该公司每年发布一份关于多元与包容的报告。
senses.why: In management language the abstract quality becomes a programme: diversity is something an institution reports, budgets for, and measures. The 1990s fixed this phrase in corporate usage.
senses.whyCN: 在管理话语中，这种抽象性质变成一项方案：diversity 成了机构要汇报、要预算、要考核的东西。1990 年代，这个说法在企业用语中固定下来。

senses.title: Measured variety: a score computed from counts
senses.titleCN: 可度量的多样性：由计数算出的分值
senses.definition: a numerical index summarizing how evenly different categories are represented
senses.definitionCN: 概括不同类别分布是否均匀的数值指标
senses.example: The Shannon index converts species counts into a single diversity score.
senses.exampleCN: 香农指数把物种计数换算成一个单一的多样性分值。
senses.why: Once variety is counted, it can be compressed into one number. The word keeps its 'many kinds' meaning but shifts from a description to a statistic; low diversity means a few kinds dominate the count.
senses.whyCN: 一旦种类被计数，就可以压缩成一个数字。词仍保留“多种类”的含义，却从描述变成了统计量；多样性低意味着少数几类在计数中占主导。

intro.en: Diversity came into English through Old French diversité from Latin diversitas, the noun of diversus 'turned in different directions'. The verb behind it, divertere, is dis- 'apart' plus vertere 'to turn'. Dates are approximate and the older English sense was 'difference' before 'variety'.
intro.cn: diversity 经古法语 diversité 借自拉丁语 diversitas，即 diversus“朝不同方向转开”的名词形式。其动词 divertere 由 dis-“分开”加 vertere“转动”构成。年代为大致估计；英语较早的义项是“差异”，后来才有“繁多”。

items.en: Diversity and inclusion becomes a standard corporate phrase, turning the abstract noun into a named policy area.
items.cn: diversity and inclusion 成为企业标准说法，这个抽象名词变成一个有名字的政策领域。

items.en: Biodiversity is coined from biological plus diversity for the variety of life, and the word gains its strongest modern association.
items.cn: biodiversity 由 biological 加 diversity 造出，指生命的多样，这个词由此获得最强的现代联想。

items.en: English diversity is recorded, first meaning 'difference' and soon after 'variety', borrowed through Old French diversité.
items.cn: 英语 diversity 见于记载，先表示“差异”，很快又表示“繁多”，经古法语 diversité 借入。

items.en: Latin diversitas names difference and variety; diversus is the past participle of divertere, so the noun inherits the image of paths turned away from one another.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diversitas 表示差异与繁多；diversus 是 divertere 的过去分词，因此这个名词继承了“路径彼此转开”的意象。

items.en: divertere joins dis- 'apart' with vertere 'to turn', from PIE *wert- 'to turn, wind'. The same vertere underlies divert, invert, convert and verse.
items.cn: divertere 由 dis-“分开”与 vertere“转动”构成，后者出自原始印欧语 *wert-“转、绕”（重构形式）。同一个 vertere 也支撑着 divert、invert、convert、verse。

note.en: The first group separates accidental spelling neighbours from the real family; the second group compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把偶然撞形的词与真正的同族词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the act of splitting into parts. It comes from dividere 'to force apart', whose root is -videre 'to separate', not vertere 'to turn'.
entries.definitionCN: 分开、分割的行为。它来自 dividere“强行分开”，词根是 -videre“分离”，不是 vertere“转动”。

entries.definition: to turn something aside. It is the plain verb divertere in English form, the same source as diversity, but it kept the literal 'turn away' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物转向。它就是 divertere 的英语形式，与 diversity 同源，但保留了字面的“转开”义。

entries.definition: the legal ending of a marriage. It descends from divortium, from divertere 'to turn apart': the couple's paths are turned away from each other.
entries.definitionCN: 法律上解除婚姻。它出自 divortium，源于 divertere“转开”：两个人的路彼此转开。

entries.definition: a collection of different kinds. It stresses the many items themselves, while diversity stresses the quality of being different.
entries.definitionCN: 不同种类的汇集。它强调众多项目本身，而 diversity 强调“彼此不同”这一性质。

entries.definition: the quality of being made of unlike parts. It is the technical, often statistical counterpart of diversity, built from Greek heteros 'other'.
entries.definitionCN: 由不同部分构成的性质。它是 diversity 在技术、尤其统计语境中的对应词，由希腊语 heteros“另外的”构成。

entries.definition: a large number of items or kinds. It emphasizes sheer count, where diversity emphasizes difference among the counted items.
entries.definitionCN: 大量项目或种类。它强调数量之多，而 diversity 强调被计数的项目之间的差异。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: diversity is divertere plus -itas: to turn apart, then the state of being turned apart.
normal.cn: diversity 是 divertere 加 -itas：先“转开”，再是“被转开的状态”。

normal.en: The di- in diversity is dis- 'apart', not the di- of two or double.
normal.cn: diversity 里的 di- 是 dis-“分开”，不是“二、双”的那个 di-。

normal.en: vertere 'to turn' also gives divert, convert, invert and verse; all of them involve a change of direction.
normal.cn: vertere“转动”还给出 divert、convert、invert、verse，它们都涉及方向的改变。

normal.en: divorce belongs to the same family: divertere meant 'turn apart', and a divorce turns two paths apart.
normal.cn: divorce 同属这一族：divertere 意为“转开”，而离婚就是把两条路转开。

normal.en: Biodiversity is simply biological plus diversity, coined in the 1980s for the variety of life.
normal.cn: biodiversity 就是 biological 加 diversity，1980 年代为生命的多样而造。

abstract.en: Picture one river splitting into many channels: the water is one, the routes and their silt are many.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河分成许多水道：水是同一份，路线与泥沙却有许多种。

abstract.en: The same image scales from species to genes to languages to staff: one system, many paths turning away from each other.
abstract.cn: 同一意象可以从物种放大到基因、语言、员工：一个系统，许多条彼此转开的路。

abstract.en: Every sense answers the same question: how many different ways can this one thing go?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在回答同一个问题：这一样东西能分出多少条不同的路？

examples.en: The forest's diversity of insects supports the whole food web.
examples.cn: 森林中昆虫的多样性支撑起整个食物网。

examples.en: Genetic diversity lets a population adapt when the climate shifts.
examples.cn: 遗传多样性让种群在气候改变时得以适应。

examples.en: The university measures diversity by the range of languages its students speak.
examples.cn: 这所大学用学生所讲语言的种类来衡量多样性。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「代我思索体」——代我思索的那套体系里，答案不止一种 → diversity 多样性、差异

root: 拉丁语 diversitas“差异、繁多”＝diversus（divertere“转开”的过去分词）＋-itas（性质名词后缀）；divertere＝dis-“分开”＋vertere“转动”。核心意象是“同一处出发，转向不同方向”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: paths that once ran together have turned apart. What differs is what the paths stand for — goods, dialects, people, species, genes, languages, staff, or counted categories.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：原本并行的路转向了不同方向。变化的只是“路”代表什么——货物、方言、人、物种、基因、语言、员工，还是被计数的类别。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one river splits into many channels, each carrying a different load.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条河分成许多水道，每条带走不同的泥沙。

branches.en: TURNING APART: difference is the angle between two paths, and variety is the whole fan of paths taken together.
branches.cn: 转开：差异是两条路之间的夹角，繁多则是所有分叉合起来形成的扇形。

branches.en: MIXED PEOPLE: the paths become backgrounds, so one institution holds people who developed separately.
branches.cn: 人群混合：路变成背景，于是一个机构里容纳了各自独立成长的人。

branches.en: LIFE FORMS: species are the branches of one habitat, alleles the branches inside one gene pool.
branches.cn: 生命形态：物种是一个生境的分支，等位基因是一个基因池内部的分支。

branches.en: CULTURE AND POLICY: languages and traditions are counted as resources, and institutions then budget for them.
branches.cn: 文化与制度：语言和传统被当作资源来计数，机构随后为它们做预算。

branches.en: MEASURED RANGE: the fan of paths is compressed into one number that says how evenly the branches are spread.
branches.cn: 可度量范围：整片扇形被压缩成一个数字，用来说明分支分布得有多均匀。

intro.en: Diversity is Latin divers- plus -ity. The suffix -ity, from Latin -itas, turns an adjective into the name of a quality; English then builds the verb diversify on the same stem.
intro.cn: diversity 是拉丁词干 divers- 加 -ity。后缀 -ity 出自拉丁语 -itas，把形容词变成性质名词；英语随后用同一词干造出动词 diversify。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are dis- 'apart' and vertere 'to turn'. vertere supplies the stems vers- and vert-, visible in diverse, divert, convert, invert and version.
latinIntro.cn: 两个拉丁成分是 dis-“分开”和 vertere“转动”。vertere 提供 vers- 与 vert- 词干，见于 diverse、divert、convert、invert、version。

items.meaning: the quality of being varied or different
items.meaningCN: 多样、不同的性质（-ity 构成性质名词）
items.example: The island's diversity of birds attracts researchers.
items.exampleCN: 这座岛屿鸟类的多样性吸引着研究者。

items.meaning: of many different kinds
items.meaningCN: 多种多样的；不同的
items.example: The city has a diverse population.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市人口构成多元。

items.meaning: to make varied, or to add new kinds
items.meaningCN: 使多样化；增加新品类（-ify 表示“使……化”）
items.example: The farm diversified into fruit and honey.
items.exampleCN: 这家农场把经营扩展到水果和蜂蜜。

items.meaning: the process of adding variety
items.meaningCN: 多样化的过程；经营多元化
items.example: Diversification reduced the company's risk.
items.exampleCN: 多元化降低了公司的风险。

items.meaning: in many different ways
items.meaningCN: 以多种不同方式地
items.example: The group was diversely trained.
items.exampleCN: 这个小组受过多种不同的训练。

items.meaning: to turn something aside from its course
items.meaningCN: 使转向；使改道
items.example: Traffic was diverted around the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 交通被改道绕过这座桥。

items.meaning: the act of turning aside, or a pastime that turns attention away
items.meaningCN: 转向；转移注意力的事物
items.example: The detour was a minor diversion.
items.exampleCN: 这段绕行只是小小的改道。

items.meaning: the legal turning apart of a married couple
items.meaningCN: 离婚（字面“转开”）；使分离
items.example: The couple filed for divorce after ten years.
items.exampleCN: 这对夫妻在十年后申请离婚。

items.meaning: the variety of living things
items.meaningCN: 生物多样性（bio- 表示生命）
items.example: Logging threatens the region's biodiversity.
items.exampleCN: 伐木威胁着该地区的生物多样性。

items.meaning: to turn something into another form
items.meaningCN: 转变；转换（con- 表示彻底）
items.example: The mill converts grain into flour.
items.exampleCN: 磨坊把谷物变成面粉。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 差异；繁多；diversity 所本的拉丁名词

definition_zh: 文档；文件资料；文档编制；文献记录；证明材料；软件文档；病案记录；法律文件
definition_en: the act of recording something in documents, the body of documents so produced, and the evidence or instructions those documents provide
core_image: 一叠盖章的纸被逐页归档，每页都能证明上一页说过的话
scene: The clerk stamped each page and filed it, so that the shipment's documentation could be checked at the border.
sceneCN: 这里 documentation 是「随货文件、证明材料」（第 3 个义项：证明文件）；句意：职员给每页盖章并归档，以便这批货物在边境受检时能出示文件。图中可辨识物件：成叠的纸页、印章、档案柜、货箱、边境检查窗口。

pos.zh: 文档；文件资料；文档编制；文献记录；证明材料

forms.label: 单数（文档工作／一套文件）

derivatives.zh: 有文件记录的；有据可查的
无记录的；无合法证件的

senses.title: The body of documents: papers taken as a whole
senses.titleCN: 文件整体：把一批文件当作一个集合
senses.definition: the collected documents that relate to a subject, person, or event
senses.definitionCN: 与某一主题、人物或事件相关的一批文件的总称
senses.example: The archive holds the documentation of the entire expedition.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保存着整次探险的全部文件。
senses.why: Latin documentum meant 'lesson, proof, warning', from docere 'to teach'. A set of such papers teaches later readers what happened; -ation gathers the papers into one mass noun.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 documentum 意为“教训、证据、警示”，出自 docere“教”。这样一组纸页向后来的读者“讲述”发生了什么；-ation 把这些纸页聚成一个集合名词。

senses.title: The act of documenting: recording step by step
senses.titleCN: 记录行为：逐步把过程写下来
senses.definition: the process of recording facts, decisions, or procedures in written or digital form
senses.definitionCN: 用书面或数字形式记录事实、决定或流程的过程
senses.example: Careful documentation of each trial made the results reproducible.
senses.exampleCN: 对每次试验的仔细记录使结果可以复现。
senses.why: -ation is an action-noun suffix from Latin -ationem. The word therefore names not only the papers but the deliberate act of producing them, which is why it appears in research methods.
senses.whyCN: -ation 是出自拉丁语 -ationem 的动作名词后缀。因此这个词不只指纸页，也指有意产出纸页的行为，这就是它常出现在研究方法中的原因。

senses.title: Proof papers: what you show an official
senses.titleCN: 证明文件：递给官员查验的那一套
senses.definition: official papers that establish identity, ownership, or compliance
senses.definitionCN: 用来证明身份、所有权或合规性的官方文件
senses.example: Without proper documentation, the goods could not cross the border.
senses.exampleCN: 没有齐全的文件，货物无法过境。
senses.why: This is documentum's 'proof' sense made concrete. A document is evidence because it can be shown; documentation is the bundle you hand over when someone has the right to ask.
senses.whyCN: 这是 documentum“证据”义的落实。文件之所以是证据，是因为它可以被出示；documentation 就是当别人有权查验时你递过去的那一叠。

senses.title: Software documentation: instructions for users and maintainers
senses.titleCN: 软件文档：给用户和维护者的说明
senses.definition: manuals, references, and notes explaining how software is used or built
senses.definitionCN: 说明软件如何使用或如何构建的手册、参考与注记
senses.example: The library is good, but its documentation is out of date.
senses.exampleCN: 这个库不错，但它的文档已经过时。
senses.why: Programming borrowed the word in the mid-20th century. Here documents teach two different readers: users how to operate, maintainers how the code is organised.
senses.whyCN: 编程领域在 20 世纪中期借用了这个词。这里的文档在教两类读者：用户如何操作，维护者如何理解代码结构。

senses.title: Procedure records: written steps that keep work consistent
senses.titleCN: 流程记录：让工作保持一致的书面条文
senses.definition: written descriptions of agreed procedures, used to keep work repeatable and auditable
senses.definitionCN: 对已商定流程的书面描述，用于使工作可重复、可审计
senses.example: The lab's documentation specifies exactly how each sample is stored.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室的流程文件明确规定了每个样本的存放方式。
senses.why: Once the papers are meant to guide future action rather than prove past action, documentation becomes an operating instrument. The same noun now points forward.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这些纸页是用来指导未来行动而非证明过去行动，documentation 就成了操作工具。同一个名词由此指向未来。

senses.title: Historical record: the trace a period leaves behind
senses.titleCN: 历史记录：一个时代留下的痕迹
senses.definition: the surviving written material by which a period or practice is known
senses.definitionCN: 后人据以了解某一时期或某种做法的存世书面材料
senses.example: The documentation of the old guild is fragmentary but revealing.
senses.exampleCN: 这个古老行会的存世记录虽然零碎，却很有揭示力。
senses.why: historians use documentation for what survives rather than what was written deliberately for them. The word shifts from a product of an office to the raw material of a discipline.
senses.whyCN: 历史学家用 documentation 指存留下来的材料，而不是专为他们写的东西。词义从“办公室的产物”转为“一个学科的原料”。

senses.title: Clinical charting: the patient's written trail
senses.titleCN: 病案记录：病人的书面轨迹
senses.definition: the ongoing written record of a patient's condition, treatment, and consent
senses.definitionCN: 对病人病情、治疗与知情同意所作的持续书面记录
senses.example: Poor documentation of the dosage led to a review of the ward.
senses.exampleCN: 剂量记录不完整，导致该病区接受了复查。
senses.why: In medicine the proof sense becomes legal and ethical: if it was not documented, it cannot be defended. The noun carries both the care given and the evidence that it was given.
senses.whyCN: 在医学中，“证据”义带上法律与伦理色彩：没有记录就无法自证。这个名词既承载所给的照护，也承载“确实给过”的证据。

senses.title: Legal paperwork: contracts and filings
senses.titleCN: 法律文件：合同与备案材料
senses.definition: the contracts, deeds, and filings required to make a transaction or status legally valid
senses.definitionCN: 使交易或身份在法律上成立所需的合同、契据与备案材料
senses.example: The merger stalled until the documentation was signed in full.
senses.exampleCN: 直到全部文件签署完毕，合并才得以推进。
senses.why: Here the papers do not merely record the deal; they constitute it. Latin documentum already mixed 'proof' with 'formal instrument', and law keeps both at once.
senses.whyCN: 这里的文件不只是记录交易，而是构成交易。拉丁语 documentum 本就把“证据”与“正式文书”混在一起，法律同时保留了这两层。

intro.en: Documentation is document plus -ation, built in English on the Latin noun documentum. The root verb is docere 'to teach', which also gives doctor, doctrine and docile. The exact date of the English noun is not fixed, so the late-18th-century dating below is approximate.
intro.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，在英语里以拉丁名词 documentum 为基础构成。其根动词是 docere“教”，也给出 doctor、doctrine、docile。英语名词的确切年代没有定论，下面所标 18 世纪后期只是大致估计。

items.en: Software documentation becomes a fixed term, and the word is routinely used for online manuals and API references.
items.cn: 软件文档成为固定术语，这个词开始日常用于在线手册与 API 参考。

items.en: Computing and engineering adopt documentation for written specifications, splitting user documents from maintenance documents.
items.cn: 计算机与工程领域采用 documentation 指书面规范，并把用户文档与维护文档区分开。

items.en: The English noun documentation is recorded in the sense 'the act or result of documenting'; the dating here is approximate.
items.cn: 英语名词 documentation 以“记录的行为或结果”义见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Latin documentum means 'lesson, proof, warning', an instrument that teaches or convinces. The suffix -mentum marks a means or result, so a document is literally 'that by which one is taught'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 documentum 意为“教训、证据、警示”，是一种用来教导或说服的工具。后缀 -mentum 表示手段或结果，因此 document 字面上就是“借以受教之物”。

items.en: docere 'to teach' is generally referred to PIE *dek- 'to take, accept', also seen in Latin decus 'honour' and discere 'to learn'. The reconstruction is standard but indirect.
items.cn: docere“教”一般认为出自原始印欧语 *dek-“接受、接纳”，也见于拉丁语 decus“荣誉”与 discere“学习”。这一重构是通行的，但属于间接推定，*dek- 为重构形式。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives from spelling neighbours; the second compares words that only partially overlap in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与只是撞形的词分开；第二组比较只有部分含义重叠的词。

entries.definition: a doctrine accepted without question. It comes from Greek dogma, from dokein 'to seem, think', not from Latin docere 'to teach'.
entries.definitionCN: 不加质疑即接受的教条。它出自希腊语 dogma，源于 dokein“显得、认为”，与拉丁语 docere“教”无关。

entries.definition: a learned person or physician. Latin doctor is 'one who teaches', from docere; the medical sense came later through 'teacher of medicine'.
entries.definitionCN: 博学之人；医生。拉丁语 doctor 就是“教导者”，出自 docere；医学义后来才由“医学的教师”引申而来。

entries.definition: easy to teach or manage. It comes from docilis 'teachable', also from docere, but it names a temperament rather than a record.
entries.definitionCN: 易教、易管教的。它出自 docilis“可教的”，同样源于 docere，但指性情而非记录。

entries.definition: any stored account of facts. It is broader than documentation and may be spoken, visual, or written.
entries.definitionCN: 任何被保存的事实记述。它比 documentation 宽泛，可以是口述的、影像的或书面的。

entries.definition: the routine forms and letters an office must handle. It stresses tedium and bureaucracy, where documentation stresses content and proof.
entries.definitionCN: 办公室必须处理的例行表格与信件。它强调繁琐与官僚气，而 documentation 强调内容与凭证。

entries.definition: material that supports a claim. Documentation can serve as evidence, but evidence may be physical or testimonial.
entries.definitionCN: 支持某一主张的材料。documentation 可以充当证据，但证据也可以是实物或证言。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: documentation is document plus -ation, the same -ation that turns record into an action-noun.
normal.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，正是把动词变成动作名词的那个 -ation。

normal.en: The root docere 'to teach' also gives doctor, doctrine and docile; a document is something that teaches you what happened.
normal.cn: 词根 docere“教”还给出 doctor、doctrine、docile；document 就是教你“发生了什么”的东西。

normal.en: -mentum in documentum is a means-or-result suffix, so a document is 'that by which one is taught or convinced'.
normal.cn: documentum 里的 -mentum 是表示手段或结果的后缀，所以 document 就是“借以受教或被说服之物”。

normal.en: Documentation and dogma look alike but split at the root: docere teaches, dokein merely seems.
normal.cn: documentation 与 dogma 形似却词根不同：docere 是“教”，dokein 只是“显得”。

normal.en: In software, documentation teaches two readers at once: the user who operates and the maintainer who rebuilds.
normal.cn: 在软件里，documentation 同时教两类读者：操作它的用户和维护它的开发者。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of stamped pages: each page is a small teacher standing behind the one before it.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠盖章的纸页：每一页都是站在前一页身后的一个小老师。

abstract.en: The same stack can be proof at a border, a manual on a desk, a chart in a ward, or a deed in a lawyer's file.
abstract.cn: 同一叠纸可以在边境是证明，在桌上是手册，在病房是病案，在律师的卷宗里是契据。

abstract.en: Every sense asks the same question: what does this paper teach the next reader, and who has the right to ask?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问同一个问题：这张纸教给下一位读者什么，又是谁有权来查验？

examples.en: The researcher kept meticulous documentation of every measurement.
examples.cn: 研究者对每一次测量都做了细致的记录。

examples.en: Customs officers refused the shipment for lack of documentation.
examples.cn: 海关人员因文件不全而拒绝放行这批货物。

examples.en: Read the documentation before you upgrade the database.
examples.cn: 升级数据库之前请先阅读文档。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「多 Q 门头写生」——多开几道门头，把每笔都写生记下 → documentation 文档、记录

root: 拉丁语 documentum“教训、证据、文书”＝docere“教”＋-mentum（手段／结果后缀）；documentation＝document＋-ation（动作或结果名词后缀）。核心是“把发生的事写下来，使其可教、可证”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: papers that teach a later reader. What changes is the reader and the purpose — an archive, a method, a border officer, a user, a future shift, a historian, a doctor, a court.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一叠纸在教后来的读者。变化的只是读者与用途——档案馆、研究方法、边境官员、软件用户、下一班同事、历史学家、医生、法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of stamped pages, each able to prove what the previous page said.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠盖章的纸页，每一页都能证明前一页说过的话。

branches.en: PAPERS AND THE ACT: the bundle and the deliberate writing that produced it are two faces of one noun.
branches.cn: 文件与行为：一整叠文件与产出它的有意书写，是同一个名词的两面。

branches.en: PROOF: the pages become evidence at the moment an authority has the right to demand them.
branches.cn: 凭证：当权威有权索取时，纸页就成了证据。

branches.en: INSTRUCTIONS: the same pages turn forward, telling users how to operate and staff how to repeat a procedure.
branches.cn: 说明：同一批纸页转向未来，告诉用户如何操作、员工如何复现流程。

branches.en: THE SURVIVING TRAIL: historians read what remains, clinicians read what was charted, and absence itself becomes information.
branches.cn: 留存的轨迹：历史学家读残存之物，医生读被记录之物，而“缺失”本身也成为信息。

branches.en: CONSTITUTING THE DEAL: in law the papers do not merely record the transaction; they make it valid.
branches.cn: 构成交易：在法律上，文件不只是记录交易，而是使交易生效。

intro.en: Documentation is document plus -ation, from Latin -ationem, an action-or-result suffix. English first borrowed document from Latin documentum, then built the longer noun on it.
intro.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，后者出自拉丁语 -ationem，表示动作或结果。英语先借入 document（来自 documentum），再在它上面造出更长的名词。

latinIntro.en: The root is docere 'to teach', whose stem doc- appears in document, doctor, doctrine and docile. The suffix -mentum in documentum marks means or result.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 docere“教”，其词干 doc- 见于 document、doctor、doctrine、docile。documentum 中的 -mentum 表示手段或结果。

items.meaning: the act of recording, or the body of records produced
items.meaningCN: 记录行为，或由此形成的整套文件（-ation 构成动作／结果名词）
items.example: The documentation of the experiment filled three folders.
items.exampleCN: 这次实验的记录装满了三个文件夹。

items.meaning: a written instrument that records or proves something
items.meaningCN: 记录或证明某事的书面文书（-ment 表示手段／结果）
items.example: Please sign this document in the presence of a witness.
items.exampleCN: 请在见证人在场时签署这份文件。

items.meaning: based on documents, or a film built from recorded material
items.meaningCN: 以文件为据的；纪录片（-ary 构成形容词）
items.example: The evidence was purely documentary.
items.exampleCN: 证据完全是书面的。

items.meaning: supported by written records
items.meaningCN: 有书面记录的；有据可查的
items.example: The species is well documented in regional surveys.
items.exampleCN: 这个物种在区域调查中有充分记录。

items.meaning: lacking records, or lacking official papers
items.meaningCN: 无记录的；无合法证件的
items.example: Undocumented workers are vulnerable to exploitation.
items.exampleCN: 没有合法证件的工人容易遭受剥削。

items.meaning: one who teaches, later a learned or medical practitioner
items.meaningCN: 教导者；后指博士或医生（-tor 表示施动者）
items.example: She became a doctor of philosophy in 1998.
items.exampleCN: 她于 1998 年获得哲学博士学位。

items.meaning: a body of teaching held to be true
items.meaningCN: 被奉为正确的教义、学说
items.example: The party revised its economic doctrine.
items.exampleCN: 该党修订了其经济学说。

items.meaning: capable of being taught; compliant
items.meaningCN: 可教的；顺从的（-ile 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: The docile horse accepted the new rider.
items.exampleCN: 这匹温顺的马接受了新骑手。

items.meaning: to teach a set of beliefs uncritically
items.meaningCN: 灌输（使人不加批判地接受一套信念）
items.example: The camp sought to indoctrinate its recruits.
items.exampleCN: 该营地试图向新成员灌输思想。

items.meaning: a dramatised film based on real records
items.meaningCN: 纪实剧情片（docu- 来自 document）
items.example: The docudrama blurred records and invention.
items.exampleCN: 这部纪实剧情片把记录与虚构混在一起。

latinEntries.meaning: to teach, to show, to instruct

definition_zh: 支配地位；优势；控制；生态优势度；显性（遗传）；市场主导地位；支配层级中的位次；惯用手的主导性
definition_en: the state of being dominant: control over others, the position of greatest power or importance, and the corresponding technical states in ecology, genetics, markets, and behaviour
core_image: 高山俯瞰周围的丘陵，所有视线都要向上仰望它
scene: One peak rises above the surrounding hills, and every trail in the valley leads toward its shadow. That peak holds its dominance over the whole valley.
sceneCN: 这里 dominance 是「优势、支配地位」（第 2 个义项：最重要、最强势的地位）；句意：一座山峰高过周围丘陵，对整条山谷占据支配地位，谷中每条小路都通向它的阴影。图中可辨识物件：主峰、较低的丘陵、放射状的小径、山脚的村落、峰顶的旗帜。

pos.zh: 支配地位；优势；控制；生态优势度；显性

collocations.zh: 支配等级（动物群体中的位次序列）
某物种在群落中的优势度

forms.label: 复数（多种优势状态，较少用）

derivatives.zh: 支配的；占优势的；显性的
占主导地位的；最显著的

senses.title: Control over others: making another obey
senses.titleCN: 对他人的控制：使对方服从
senses.definition: the exercise of power or influence over other people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 对其他人或群体施加权力或影响力
senses.example: The party's dominance over local politics lasted forty years.
senses.exampleCN: 该党对地方政治的支配持续了四十年。
senses.why: Dominance is dominant plus -ance, and dominant is Latin dominantem, the present participle of dominari 'to rule'. The noun names the ongoing state of ruling rather than one act of conquest.
senses.whyCN: dominance 是 dominant 加 -ance，而 dominant 是拉丁语 dominantem——dominari“统治”的现在分词。这个名词指持续的统治状态，而非一次征服行为。

senses.title: Top position: being the most important or strongest
senses.titleCN: 最上位：最重要、最强势的地位
senses.definition: the position of greatest prominence, strength, or importance in a field
senses.definitionCN: 在某一领域中地位最显著、力量最强或最重要
senses.example: English retains its dominance as the language of scientific publishing.
senses.exampleCN: 英语仍保持作为科学出版语言的支配地位。
senses.why: The image behind dominus, 'master of a house', is spatial: one point stands above the rest. Applied to a field, dominance is that top point, whether or not anyone literally obeys.
senses.whyCN: dominus“一家之主”背后的意象是空间性的：一个点高过其余。用于某个领域时，dominance 就是这个最高的点，无论有没有人真的服从。

senses.title: Ecological dominance: one species outweighs the rest
senses.titleCN: 生态优势：一个物种在群落中占压倒地位
senses.definition: the condition in which one species controls a community's structure through numbers or size
senses.definitionCN: 某一物种凭借数量或体型控制群落结构的状况
senses.example: The kelp's dominance shapes every layer of the coastal community.
senses.exampleCN: 海带的优势地位塑造了沿岸群落的每一层。
senses.why: Ecology extends the social image to a community without a ruler: dominance is measured by biomass, cover, or competitive exclusion. One species takes the high point of the canopy.
senses.whyCN: 生态学把社会意象延伸到没有统治者的群落：优势度用生物量、盖度或竞争排斥来量度。一个物种占据了冠层的高点。

senses.title: Genetic dominance: one allele masks another
senses.titleCN: 显性：一个等位基因遮盖另一个
senses.definition: the property of an allele that produces its trait even when only one copy is present
senses.definitionCN: 某一等位基因即使只有一份也能表现出其性状的性质
senses.example: The dominance of the brown-eye allele explains the family's pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 褐眼等位基因的显性解释了这一家族的遗传模式。
senses.why: Mendel's terms were borrowed from ordinary language: a dominant factor 'rules' the visible outcome, while the recessive one steps back. Dominance here is about expression, not power over other organisms.
senses.whyCN: 孟德尔的术语借自日常语言：显性因子“统治”可见结果，隐性因子则退到幕后。这里的 dominance 指表现与否，不是对别的生物的支配。

senses.title: Market dominance: one firm sets the terms
senses.titleCN: 市场主导：一家企业定下条件
senses.definition: the ability of a firm or product to set prices or standards because rivals are weak
senses.definitionCN: 由于对手弱小，某企业或产品得以定价格、定标准的能力
senses.example: Regulators examined whether the platform's dominance blocked new entrants.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构审查该平台的支配地位是否阻挡了新进入者。
senses.why: When dominance is used in competition law it becomes a threshold with legal consequences. The mountain image turns into market share plus the power to act independently of rivals.
senses.whyCN: 在竞争法中，dominance 变成一个会带来法律后果的门槛。高山意象变成市场份额，加上“可以不看对手脸色行事”的能力。

senses.title: Behavioural dominance: the top of a pecking order
senses.titleCN: 行为支配：啄序顶端的位次
senses.definition: the rank an animal holds in a group, granting priority access to food or mates
senses.definitionCN: 动物在群体中的位次，使其优先获得食物或配偶
senses.example: A single male's dominance decides who feeds first.
senses.exampleCN: 一只雄性的支配地位决定谁先进食。
senses.why: Ethology turned dominance into a measurable rank, because priority is observable even without any symbolic authority. The noun then names a position in a queue rather than a personality.
senses.whyCN: 动物行为学把 dominance 变成可测量的位次，因为“优先权”即使没有象征权威也能观察到。于是这个名词指队列中的位置，而不是性格。

senses.title: Military dominance: control of a space or region
senses.titleCN: 军事支配：对某空间或区域的控制
senses.definition: the capacity to control territory, air, or sea so that rivals cannot operate freely
senses.definitionCN: 控制陆地、空域或海域，使对手无法自由行动的能力
senses.example: Air dominance allowed the convoy to move by daylight.
senses.exampleCN: 制空权使车队得以在白天行进。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer of the word in practical use: dominari describes a master's hold over a household, and a commander's hold over a region repeats the same relation at a larger scale.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词在实际使用中最古老的一层：dominari 描述主人对家宅的掌控，而指挥官对区域的掌控只是把同一关系放大。

senses.title: Lateral dominance: the hand or side that leads
senses.titleCN: 惯用侧优势：起主导作用的手或一侧
senses.definition: the tendency of one hand, eye, or side of the body to lead in skilled movement
senses.definitionCN: 在精细动作中一只手、一只眼或身体一侧起主导作用的倾向
senses.example: Tests of manual dominance placed her firmly on the right.
senses.exampleCN: 手部优势测试把她明确归入右手型。
senses.why: The 'ruling' sense is scaled down to the body: one side takes command in writing or throwing. It shows how far the metaphor can shrink while keeping the same 'one part leads' structure.
senses.whyCN: “统治”义被缩小到身体：写字或投掷时由一侧“发号施令”。这说明该隐喻可以缩到多小，却仍保持“其中一部分领先”的结构。

intro.en: Dominance is an English noun, first recorded in the early 19th century, built from dominant plus -ance; it is not a classical Latin noun. Dominant descends from Latin dominari 'to rule', from dominus 'master'. The link between dominus and domus 'house' is generally accepted but not certain.
intro.cn: dominance 是英语自己造的名词，最早见于 19 世纪初，由 dominant 加 -ance 构成，并非古典拉丁语名词。dominant 出自拉丁语 dominari“统治”，再上为 dominus“主人”。dominus 与 domus“房屋”的联系一般被认为是成立的，但并非定论。

items.en: Dominance in digital markets becomes a standard concern in competition policy, attached to platforms rather than states.
items.cn: 数字市场中的支配地位成为竞争政策的常规议题，被安到平台而非国家身上。

items.en: Ecology, genetics and ethology each give dominance a technical definition: species cover, allele expression, group rank.
items.cn: 生态学、遗传学与动物行为学各自给 dominance 一个技术定义：物种盖度、等位基因表现、群体位次。

items.en: The English noun dominance is recorded, formed on dominant plus -ance. Before it, English used the rarer dominancy.
items.cn: 英语名词 dominance 见于记载，由 dominant 加 -ance 构成。在它之前，英语用的是更少见的 dominancy。

items.en: Latin dominari 'to rule' yields the present participle dominans, stem dominant-. Dominus 'master, lord' is generally derived from domus 'house', 'the one who owns the house'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dominari“统治”给出现在分词 dominans，词干为 dominant-。dominus“主人、家主”一般认为出自 domus“房屋”，即“拥有房屋的那个人”。

items.en: domus comes from PIE *dem- 'house, household', the same root that gives domestic, domicile and domain; dominari therefore starts from household power, not from military power.
items.cn: domus 一般认为出自原始印欧语 *dem-“房屋、家户”（重构形式），同一词根给出 domestic、domicile、domain；因此 dominari 的起点是家户之权，而非军事之权。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives and one accidental neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分真正的同族词与一个偶然撞形的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the act or process of dominating. It stresses the doing, while dominance stresses the resulting position.
entries.definitionCN: 支配的行为或过程。它强调“做”，而 dominance 强调由此形成的位置。

entries.definition: a masked cloak, or a playing piece. The cloak sense comes through French from Latin dominus as a title for a priest; it never passed through the 'rule' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 化装斗篷；多米诺骨牌。斗篷义经法语来自拉丁语 dominus 作为对神职人员的称谓，从未经过“统治”这一义线。

entries.definition: an evil spirit. It comes from Greek daimon 'divine power, lesser god', and only resembles dominance in spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 恶灵。它出自希腊语 daimon“神力、次要的神”，与 dominance 只是拼写相像。

entries.definition: the state of being highest in authority. It is stronger and more total than dominance, often political or military.
entries.definitionCN: 权威上的至高地位。它比 dominance 更强、更彻底，常用于政治或军事。

entries.definition: the fact of being widespread. It counts frequency, not power; dominance implies control as well as abundance.
entries.definitionCN: 普遍存在的程度。它计频率而非权力；dominance 除数量外还含控制。

entries.definition: the recognised right to command. It is legitimate power, where dominance may be mere strength.
entries.definitionCN: 被承认的指挥权。它是正当的权力，而 dominance 可能只是实力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: dominance is dominant plus -ance; the suffix names a state, so it is 'the state of being dominant'.
normal.cn: dominance 是 dominant 加 -ance；后缀表示状态，所以它就是“处于支配的状态”。

normal.en: The root dominus 'master' also gives dominate, dominion, domain and predominate.
normal.cn: 词根 dominus“主人”还给出 dominate、dominion、domain、predominate。

normal.en: dominus is generally traced to domus 'house', so dominance began as household power before it became battlefield power.
normal.cn: dominus 一般认为出自 domus“房屋”，所以 dominance 先有家户之权，后有战场之权。

normal.en: Genetics borrowed the word for an allele that 'rules' what you can see; recessive alleles step back.
normal.cn: 遗传学借这个词指“统治”可见性状的等位基因；隐性等位基因则退到幕后。

normal.en: Dominance is not domination: -ance is the position, -ation is the act.
normal.cn: dominance 不等于 domination：-ance 是位置，-ation 是行为。

abstract.en: Picture one peak above a ring of hills: no hill is abolished, but every path still leads toward the shadow.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈丘陵中耸起一座主峰：没有哪座丘陵被消灭，但每条小路都通向那片阴影。

abstract.en: The same peak appears as a ruling party, a canopy species, a visible allele, a market leader, a top ape, an air fleet, or a writing hand.
abstract.cn: 同一座主峰可以显形为执政党、冠层物种、可见等位基因、市场领先者、群体首位的猿、制空机队，或写字的那只手。

abstract.en: Every sense keeps one structure: one part leads, the rest arrange themselves around it.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都保持同一结构：一个部分领先，其余围绕它排布。

examples.en: The firm's dominance in the market drew the attention of regulators.
examples.cn: 这家公司在市场上的支配地位引起了监管机构的注意。

examples.en: In this forest, one tree species has clear dominance in the canopy.
examples.cn: 在这片森林里，一个树种在冠层中具有明显的优势。

examples.en: The study tracked dominance ranks among the wolves for three winters.
examples.cn: 这项研究追踪了狼群中的支配位次长达三个冬天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「多米能事」——多一米就能压住别人，站得更高 → dominance 支配地位、优势

root: 拉丁语 dominari“统治”＝dominus“主人、家主”＋动词后缀；dominus 一般认为出自 domus“房屋”（原始印欧语 *dem-“家户”）。英语 dominance＝dominant＋-ance（状态名词后缀），核心是“一个部分高过其余、发号施令”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one shape: a single peak above a field. What changes is the field — politics, a discipline, a community, a genome, a market, a group, a theatre of war, or the body itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保持同一形状：一片场域之上的一座主峰。变化的只是场域——政坛、学科、群落、基因组、市场、群体、战区，或身体本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one peak stands above the surrounding hills and every path bends toward its shadow.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座主峰高过周围丘陵，每条小路都弯向它的阴影。

branches.en: POWER: dominus rules a household; a commander rules a region. Same relation, larger room.
branches.cn: 权力：dominus 治理家宅，指挥官治理区域。关系相同，房间更大。

branches.en: TOP POSITION: prominence in a field can exist without anyone obeying, as a peak needs no subjects.
branches.cn: 最上位：领域中的显著地位可以在无人服从时存在，正如山峰不需要臣民。

branches.en: COMMUNITY WEIGHT: in ecology the peak is measured in biomass and cover, not in commands.
branches.cn: 群落重量：在生态学中，主峰用生物量与盖度衡量，而不是用命令。

branches.en: VISIBLE TRAIT: in genetics one allele rules the phenotype while the other stays silent.
branches.cn: 可见性状：在遗传学中，一个等位基因统治表型，另一个保持沉默。

branches.en: MEASURED RANK: market share, pecking order, and the leading hand all reduce the peak to a rank or a score.
branches.cn: 可测位次：市场份额、啄序、惯用侧，都把主峰化约为一个位次或分值。

intro.en: Dominance is dominant plus -ance. The suffix -ance, from Latin -antia, names a state or quality; English coined the noun in the 19th century rather than inheriting it whole from Latin.
intro.cn: dominance 是 dominant 加 -ance。后缀 -ance 出自拉丁语 -antia，表示状态或性质；这个名词是英语在 19 世纪自造，而非整体继承自拉丁语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is dominus 'master, lord', with the verb dominari 'to rule' and its participle dominant-. The same base gives dominion, domain and predominate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 dominus“主人、家主”，动词 dominari“统治”及其分词 dominant-。同一词基给出 dominion、domain、predominate。

items.meaning: the state of being dominant
items.meaningCN: 处于支配、优势的状态（-ance 构成状态名词）
items.example: Its dominance lasted until a rival cut prices.
items.exampleCN: 它的支配地位一直持续到对手降价。

items.meaning: ruling, prevailing, or expressed over another allele
items.meaningCN: 支配的；占优势的；显性的
items.example: Blue is the dominant colour in the painting.
items.exampleCN: 蓝色是这幅画的主色。

items.meaning: to rule, control, or tower over
items.meaningCN: 支配；控制；高耸于
items.example: The tower dominates the old harbour.
items.exampleCN: 这座塔俯瞰着旧港。

items.meaning: the act or process of dominating
items.meaningCN: 支配、控制的行为或过程（-ion 构成动作名词）
items.example: The region suffered decades of foreign domination.
items.exampleCN: 该地区遭受了数十年的外国统治。

items.meaning: territory or authority under one ruler
items.meaningCN: 领地；统治权
items.example: The island was once a distant dominion.
items.exampleCN: 这座岛曾是遥远的领地。

items.meaning: to be the strongest or most common element
items.meaningCN: 占主导；占多数（pre- 表示“在前、高于”）
items.example: Oak predominate on the lower slopes.
items.exampleCN: 橡树在下坡地带占主导。

items.meaning: most noticeable or most frequent
items.meaningCN: 占主导地位的；最显著的
items.example: Grey was the predominant tone of the room.
items.exampleCN: 灰色是这个房间的主色调。

items.meaning: bossy, controlling others by force of character
items.meaningCN: 专横的；好支配别人的
items.example: His domineering manner silenced the meeting.
items.exampleCN: 他专横的作风让会场安静下来。

items.meaning: the area a person or group controls
items.meaningCN: 领域；领地；域名
items.example: Tax policy lies in the domain of the finance ministry.
items.exampleCN: 税收政策属于财政部的职权范围。

items.meaning: relating to the household or to one's own country
items.meaningCN: 家庭的；国内的（与 domus“房屋”同根）
items.example: Domestic flights resumed after the storm.
items.exampleCN: 暴风雨后国内航班恢复。

latinEntries.meaning: master, lord, owner of a household
to rule, to have dominion over

latinEntries.meaningCN: 统治着的；占优势的；dominant 的直接来源

definition_zh: 耐久性；耐用程度；持久性；（协议、关系）长久维持的能力；（免疫、记忆）持续时间；数据持久性；耐用消费品属性
definition_en: the ability to withstand wear, pressure, or change and to continue in the same state over time
core_image: 一块被反复踩踏的石阶，边缘磨圆了却没有断裂
scene: The same stone step has taken a century of boots, worn round at the edge but never cracked. The step's durability comes from the same hard stone that wore round instead of cracking.
sceneCN: 这里 durability 是「耐磨损、经久不坏」（第 1 个义项：耐久性）；句意：这级石阶的耐久来自同一种硬石：边缘磨圆却从未断裂。图中可辨识物件：石阶、磨圆的边角、密集的脚印、缝隙里的青苔、旁边的铁栏杆。

pos.zh: 耐久性；耐用程度；持久性；持续时间

collocations.zh: 耐用品（durability 的具体载体）
数据持久性（存储不丢失）

forms.label: 复数（多种耐久程度，较少用）

senses.title: Resistance to wear: lasting under repeated use
senses.titleCN: 抗磨损：反复使用仍不坏
senses.definition: the ability of an object or material to keep functioning despite repeated wear
senses.definitionCN: 物体或材料在反复磨损下仍能保持功能的能力
senses.example: Buyers judge the boots by their durability, not their colour.
senses.exampleCN: 买家看重这双靴子的耐用性，而不是颜色。
senses.why: Durability comes from Latin durabilitas, from durabilis 'lasting', from durare 'to last, harden'. The root durus 'hard' supplies the physical image: what is hard resists being rubbed away.
senses.whyCN: durability 出自拉丁语 durabilitas，再上为 durabilis“持久的”，源于 durare“持续、变硬”。词根 durus“硬”提供物理意象：硬的东西不易被磨掉。

senses.title: Structural strength: not failing under load
senses.titleCN: 结构强度：承重之下不失效
senses.definition: the capacity of a structure to carry loads over its designed life without failure
senses.definitionCN: 结构在其设计寿命内承受荷载而不失效的能力
senses.example: The bridge's durability was tested with years of simulated traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的耐久性用多年模拟交通荷载来检验。
senses.why: Engineering separates durability from sheer strength: a strong beam may corrode, while a durable one keeps its strength. durare's 'harden' sense underlies both concrete and metal fatigue.
senses.whyCN: 工程学把耐久性与单纯的强度分开：一根梁可以很强却会腐蚀，耐久的那根则能一直保持强度。durare 的“变硬”义同时支撑着混凝土与金属疲劳的讨论。

senses.title: Lasting agreements: institutions that do not collapse
senses.titleCN: 持久协议：不会垮掉的制度安排
senses.definition: the quality of an arrangement or institution remaining in force over a long period
senses.definitionCN: 某种安排或制度长期保持有效的性质
senses.example: The treaty's durability surprised the diplomats who drafted it.
senses.exampleCN: 这份条约的持久程度让起草它的外交官都感到意外。
senses.why: The metaphor moves from stone to paper: an agreement is durable when pressure does not break it. The word measures time survived, not hardness, though the same dur- root stays.
senses.whyCN: 隐喻从石头移到纸面：协议之所以 durable，是因为压力压不垮它。这个词衡量的是熬过的时间，而不是硬度，但 dur- 词根仍在。

senses.title: Enduring impressions: memory that stays put
senses.titleCN: 持久印象：留在原处的记忆
senses.definition: the tendency of an experience or image to remain in memory without fading
senses.definitionCN: 某段经历或形象留在记忆中而不消退的倾向
senses.example: The durability of that childhood scene shaped her later work.
senses.exampleCN: 那个童年场景的持久印象塑造了她后来的创作。
senses.why: Applied to mind, worn stone becomes etched memory. Latin durare could already mean 'to last, continue', so no new root is needed for this shift.
senses.whyCN: 用于心智时，被磨的石阶变成被刻下的记忆。拉丁语 durare 本就可表“持续、延续”，所以这一转移不需要新词根。

senses.title: Durable goods: things bought to be kept
senses.titleCN: 耐用品：买来长期保留的物件
senses.definition: the property that qualifies household products, such as appliances, to be used for years
senses.definitionCN: 使家电等家用产品可使用多年的属性
senses.example: Economists track spending on goods of high durability, such as cars.
senses.exampleCN: 经济学家追踪高耐用性商品（如汽车）的支出。
senses.why: Statistics turned the quality into a category: durable goods are defined by a lifespan of roughly three years or more. The noun names the threshold that sorts purchases.
senses.whyCN: 统计学把这种性质变成一个类别：耐用品按约三年以上的使用寿命定义。这个名词成了给消费分类的门槛。

senses.title: Immune durability: protection that holds
senses.titleCN: 免疫持久性：保护力维持多久
senses.definition: the length of time a vaccine-induced or post-infection immune response remains protective
senses.definitionCN: 疫苗或感染后产生的免疫反应保持保护作用的时长
senses.example: Trials measured the durability of the antibody response over two years.
senses.exampleCN: 试验测量了抗体反应在两年内的持久性。
senses.why: Immunology borrowed the word because antibodies rise and then fall: durability is the shape of the tail, not the height of the peak. The stone image becomes a plateau in time.
senses.whyCN: 免疫学借这个词，是因为抗体先升后降：durability 描述的是“尾部”的形状，而不是峰值的高度。石头的意象变成时间上的一段平台。

senses.title: Data durability: storage that does not lose what it holds
senses.titleCN: 数据持久性：存储不丢失内容
senses.definition: the guarantee that stored data persists and is not silently lost over time
senses.definitionCN: 对被存储数据长期存在、不被悄悄丢失的保证
senses.example: Replication improves data durability across failing drives.
senses.exampleCN: 副本机制提升了硬盘故障时的数据持久性。
senses.why: Computing split durability from availability: a system may be reachable yet lose writes. Durability here means the record survives, which is exactly documentum's old promise in a new medium.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域把持久性与可用性分开：系统可以连得上，却仍丢失写入。这里的持久性指记录能存活，正是 documentum 那句古老承诺在新介质里的翻版。

senses.title: Political durability: staying in office or in force
senses.titleCN: 政治持久性：留任或持续生效
senses.definition: the length of time a government, policy, or leader remains effective without being replaced
senses.definitionCN: 政府、政策或领导人未被替换而持续有效的时长
senses.example: Analysts doubted the coalition's durability after the budget vote.
senses.exampleCN: 预算表决之后，分析人士怀疑该联盟能否持久。
senses.why: In politics the noun measures survival against challenge, the same test as stone under boots. A durable policy is not one that is never attacked but one that outlasts the attacks.
senses.whyCN: 在政治中，这个词衡量“经受挑战而存续”，与石阶在靴底下的考验相同。持久的政策不是从未受攻击，而是比攻击活得更久。

intro.en: Durability entered English in the late 14th century through Old French durabilité from Latin durabilitas, the noun of durabilis 'lasting'. durabilis comes from durare 'to last, harden', from durus 'hard'. The Latin noun is Late Latin rather than classical, so the exact classical attestation is uncertain.
intro.cn: durability 于 14 世纪后期经古法语 durabilité 进入英语，源自拉丁语 durabilitas——durabilis“持久的”的名词形式。durabilis 出自 durare“持续、变硬”，再上为 durus“硬”。这个拉丁名词属于晚期拉丁语而非古典拉丁语，其古典时期的用例无法确证。

items.en: Economics, immunology and computing each define durability by a time threshold: three years for goods, months for antibodies, years for stored data.
items.cn: 经济学、免疫学与计算机各自用时间门槛定义 durability：商品三年、抗体数月、数据数年。

items.en: English durability is recorded, borrowed through Old French durabilité from Latin durabilitas.
items.cn: 英语 durability 见于记载，经古法语 durabilité 借自拉丁语 durabilitas。

items.en: Late Latin durabilitas names lastingness; durabilis is durare plus -bilis 'capable of', so the adjective literally says 'able to last'.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 durabilitas 表示持久性；durabilis 是 durare 加 -bilis“能够被……的”，所以这个形容词字面就是“能持久的”。

items.en: durus 'hard, firm' is generally linked to PIE *deru- 'be firm, solid', the same root family as tree and true, though the exact branch is a reconstruction.
items.cn: durus“硬、坚固”一般认为与原始印欧语 *deru-“坚固、结实”相关，与 tree、true 同属一个词根家族，但具体分支属于重构，*deru- 为重构形式。

items.en: The noun is later than the adjective: durable is attested in English before durability, which suggests the noun was formed to name the quality of things already called durable.
items.cn: 名词比形容词晚：英语中 durable 先于 durability 出现，说明名词是为“已经被称为 durable 的东西”命名其性质而造。

note.en: The first group separates same-root relatives from one spelling neighbour of a different root; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把同根词与一个不同词根的撞形词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the length of time something lasts. It is durare plus -ation and measures the span, while durability measures the ability to fill that span.
entries.definitionCN: 某物持续的时间长度。它是 durare 加 -ation，衡量时间跨度；durability 衡量的是“撑满这段跨度”的能力。

entries.definition: coercion, pressure that forces action. It comes from Latin duritia 'hardness', from durus, but the hardness became pressure on a person, not on an object.
entries.definitionCN: 胁迫、迫使行动的压迫。它出自拉丁语 duritia“坚硬”，源于 durus，但“硬”变成了对人的压迫，而不是对物的耐磨。

entries.definition: obedient, doing what duty requires. Duty comes from Latin debere 'to owe', so the resemblance to durable is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 顺从的、尽本分的。duty 出自拉丁语 debere“欠”，因此与 durable 的相似只是偶然。

entries.definition: long life or long service. It measures the years attained, where durability measures resistance to wear during those years.
entries.definitionCN: 长寿；长期使用。它衡量达到的年数，durability 衡量这些年里抗磨损的能力。

entries.definition: the ability to recover after being bent or hit. Durability resists damage; resilience returns after damage.
entries.definitionCN: 受弯折或打击后恢复的能力。durability 抵抗损伤，resilience 则在损伤后回弹。

entries.definition: solidity of construction. It stresses how firmly something is built, while durability stresses how long it keeps working.
entries.definitionCN: 构造的结实。它强调造得多牢固，而 durability 强调能正常工作多久。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: durability is durable plus -ity; -ity, from Latin -itas, names the quality of being durable.
normal.cn: durability 是 durable 加 -ity；-ity 出自拉丁语 -itas，表示“耐用的性质”。

normal.en: The root durus 'hard' also gives endure, endurance, duration and duress.
normal.cn: 词根 durus“硬”还给出 endure、endurance、duration、duress。

normal.en: durare means both 'to last' and 'to harden', which is why wearing stone and lasting time share one word.
normal.cn: durare 既表“持续”又表“变硬”，这正是磨石与熬时间共用一词的原因。

normal.en: Durable goods are defined by lifespan, not by hardness: a durable car is one kept for years.
normal.cn: 耐用品按寿命而非硬度定义：一辆耐用的车是用了很多年的车。

normal.en: durability and duration split the dur- family: one is ability to last, the other is the span lasted.
normal.cn: durability 与 duration 分占 dur- 家族：一个是持久的能力，一个是被持续的时间跨度。

abstract.en: Picture a stone step worn round at the edge but still whole: the wear is visible proof that nothing broke.
abstract.cn: 想象一级边缘磨圆却仍完整的石阶：磨痕本身就是“没断”的可见证据。

abstract.en: The same step becomes a treaty, a memory, a vaccine response and a stored file: each is judged by how long it holds.
abstract.cn: 同一级石阶可以变成条约、记忆、疫苗反应和存储文件：每一个都按“能保持多久”来评判。

abstract.en: Every sense measures resistance across time; only the thing resisting changes from stone to paper to memory to data.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在衡量“跨越时间的抵抗”；变的只是抵抗者——石头、纸、记忆、数据。

examples.en: The durability of the alloy was tested in salt water for a year.
examples.cn: 这种合金的耐久性在盐水中测试了一年。

examples.en: Investors questioned the durability of the ceasefire.
examples.cn: 投资者质疑停火能否持久。

examples.en: Backups are about data durability, not just speed.
examples.cn: 备份关乎数据持久性，而不只是速度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「丢拉玻璃体」——丢、拉、玻璃体都不碎，够经久 → durability 耐久性、持久性

root: 拉丁语 durabilitas“持久性”＝durabilis“能持久的”（durare“持续、变硬”＋-bilis“能够被……”）＋-itas（性质名词后缀）；durare 源于 durus“硬”。核心是“硬而耐久，磨而不坏”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses measure the same thing: how long something holds its state under pressure. The bearer changes — material, structure, treaty, memory, purchase, immune response, stored data, government.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在量同一件事：某物在压力下能保持原状多久。承载者不同——材料、结构、条约、记忆、商品、免疫反应、存储数据、政府。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone step worn round by a century of boots but never cracked.
core.cn: 核心意象：一级被百年靴底磨圆却从未裂开的石阶。

branches.en: PHYSICAL RESISTANCE: hardness stops abrasion; structural capacity stops collapse under load.
branches.cn: 物理抵抗：硬度挡住磨损，结构承载力挡住荷载下的垮塌。

branches.en: TIME APPLIED TO ABSTRACT THINGS: a treaty or a memory is durable when pressure fails to break it or fade it.
branches.cn: 时间用于抽象之物：条约或记忆之所以持久，是因为压力压不垮、岁月磨不掉。

branches.en: A CATEGORY: statistics turns the quality into a lifespan threshold that sorts goods into classes.
branches.cn: 一个类别：统计把这种性质变成寿命门槛，把商品分成不同类别。

branches.en: A TAIL IN TIME: immune durability is the plateau after the peak, not the peak itself.
branches.cn: 时间上的尾巴：免疫持久性是峰值之后的平台，而不是峰值本身。

branches.en: SURVIVING FAILURE: stored data survives drive failure; a government survives votes and challenges.
branches.cn: 熬过失效：存储数据熬过硬盘故障，政府熬过表决与挑战。

intro.en: Durability is durable plus -ity, and durable is Latin durabilis: durare 'to last, harden' plus -bilis 'capable of'. The suffix chain -abil- + -ity is what turns 'able to last' into 'the measurable ability to last'.
intro.cn: durability 是 durable 加 -ity，而 durable 是拉丁语 durabilis：durare“持续、变硬”加 -bilis“能够……的”。-abil- 与 -ity 这条后缀链，把“能持久”变成“可测量的持久能力”。

latinIntro.en: The base is durus 'hard' and its verb durare 'to last, harden'. The same family gives duration, endure, endurance and duress, and the PIE root *deru- 'firm' also underlies tree and true.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 durus“硬”及其动词 durare“持续、变硬”。同族词包括 duration、endure、endurance、duress，原始印欧语 *deru-“坚固”还支撑着 tree 与 true。

items.meaning: the ability to last or resist wear
items.meaningCN: 持久、抗磨损的能力（-ity 构成性质名词）
items.example: The durability of the rope was proven in the storm.
items.exampleCN: 这条绳子的耐久性在风暴中得到了证明。

items.meaning: able to last or resist damage
items.meaningCN: 耐用的；能持久的（-able 表示“能够……”）
items.example: They chose durable materials for the footbridge.
items.exampleCN: 他们为这座人行桥选了耐用材料。

items.meaning: in a lasting way
items.meaningCN: 耐久地；持久地
items.example: The label was durably printed on the casing.
items.exampleCN: 标签被牢固持久地印在外壳上。

items.meaning: the length of time something lasts
items.meaningCN: 持续时间；时长（-ation 构成名词）
items.example: The duration of the flight was nine hours.
items.exampleCN: 这次飞行的时长为九小时。

items.meaning: to bear hardship or continue through time
items.meaningCN: 忍受；持续存在（字面“在硬中坚持”）
items.example: The village endured three harsh winters.
items.exampleCN: 这个村庄熬过了三个严冬。

items.meaning: stamina, or the capacity to last
items.meaningCN: 忍耐力；持久力（-ance 构成状态名词）
items.example: The climb tested every runner's endurance.
items.exampleCN: 这段爬升考验了每位跑者的耐力。

items.meaning: coercion; pressure that forces someone to act
items.meaningCN: 胁迫；逼迫人行动的压迫（“硬”由物转到人）
items.example: He signed the contract under duress.
items.exampleCN: 他在胁迫之下签了合同。

items.meaning: stubbornly hard, refusing to change
items.meaningCN: 执拗的；顽固不化的（字面“硬到底”）
items.example: The council remained obdurate on the plan.
items.exampleCN: 委员会对这项计划始终顽固不让。

items.meaning: to harden, physically or emotionally
items.meaningCN: 使硬化；使变得冷酷（较少用）
items.example: Time had indurated the clay into stone.
items.exampleCN: 时间把黏土硬化成了石头。

items.meaning: long confinement, or lastingness (archaic)
items.meaningCN: 长期监禁；持久（古旧用法）
items.example: The prisoner was held in durance for years.
items.exampleCN: 这名囚犯被长期监禁多年。

latinEntries.meaning: to last, to endure, to harden

latinEntries.meaningCN: 持久性；耐久性（晚期拉丁语）

definition_zh: 生态的；生态学的；与环境相关的；生态平衡的；生态影响／足迹的；生态农业的；生态效度的；生态谬误的
definition_en: relating to ecology as a science, to the relations between organisms and their environments, or to environmental protection and impact
core_image: 一张看不见的网把溪水、鱼、岸边树木和坡上的农田都连在同一根线上
scene: A stream, its fish, the riverside trees and the farm on the slope are tied together by one invisible net. The stream, its fish, the trees and the farm form one ecological system.
sceneCN: 这里 ecological 是「生态的、生物与环境相互关联的」（第 1 个义项：生态学的）；句意：溪水、溪鱼、岸边树木与坡上农田构成一个生态整体，被一张看不见的网连在一起。图中可辨识物件：溪流、游鱼、岸边树根、坡地农田、代表联系的无形线条。

pos.zh: 生态的；生态学的；与环境相关的

collocations.zh: 生态效度（研究结论在真实情境中的适用性）

derivatives.zh: 生态灭绝（大规模破坏生态系统）

senses.title: Of ecology as a science: what ecologists study
senses.titleCN: 生态学的：生态学家所研究的那一类
senses.definition: relating to ecology, the scientific study of organisms and their environments
senses.definitionCN: 与生态学——研究生物与其环境关系的科学——相关的
senses.example: The paper reports ecological data from twenty lakes.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文报告了来自二十个湖泊的生态学数据。
senses.why: Ecological is ecology plus -ical. Ecology was coined by Haeckel from Greek oikos 'house' plus -logia 'study of', so ecological literally means 'of the study of the household of life'.
senses.whyCN: ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical。ecology 由海克尔用希腊语 oikos“房屋”加 -logia“研究”造出，所以 ecological 字面就是“关于生命之家户之研究的”。

senses.title: Of the environment: nature and its condition
senses.titleCN: 环境的：自然及其状况
senses.definition: relating to the natural environment and the state of its systems
senses.definitionCN: 与自然环境及其系统状态相关的
senses.example: The dam caused ecological damage far downstream.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大坝在远下游造成了生态破坏。
senses.why: In public usage the adjective often drops the science and keeps the object: ecological means 'of the environment'. The focus shifts from researchers to rivers.
senses.whyCN: 在大众用法中，这个形容词常丢掉“学科”而保留“对象”：ecological 就是“环境的”。焦点从研究者转到河流。

senses.title: Of interactions: relations among organisms
senses.titleCN: 相互作用的：生物之间的关系
senses.definition: concerning the relationships between organisms or between organisms and their surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 关于生物之间、或生物与其周围环境之间关系的
senses.example: The beetle plays an ecological role far beyond its size.
senses.exampleCN: 这种甲虫的生态作用远超它的体型。
senses.why: The core of ecology is relation, not scenery. Ecological therefore often describes a role or link — pollinator, predator, decomposer — rather than a place.
senses.whyCN: 生态学的核心是关系，而不是风景。因此 ecological 常修饰角色或联系——传粉者、捕食者、分解者——而不是地点。

senses.title: Of impact: the footprint left on a system
senses.titleCN: 影响面的：留在系统上的足迹
senses.definition: concerning the measurable effect of human activity on ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 关于人类活动对生态系统可测量的影响
senses.example: The city's ecological footprint is larger than its area suggests.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的生态足迹比它的面积所显示的要大。
senses.why: This sense converts the relation into a debt: resources taken and waste returned are added up as area. The adjective becomes quantitative without losing its 'web' image.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把关系换算成欠账：取走的资源与归还的废物被折算成面积。形容词变得可量化，却没有丢掉“网”的意象。

senses.title: Of balance: a system staying healthy
senses.titleCN: 平衡的：系统保持健康
senses.definition: concerning the stability and health of an ecosystem's internal relations
senses.definitionCN: 关于生态系统内部关系的稳定与健康
senses.example: Wetlands maintain the ecological balance of the floodplain.
senses.exampleCN: 湿地维持着洪泛平原的生态平衡。
senses.why: Balance is a metaphor inside the metaphor: the web is imagined as a scale that can tip. Ecological here means 'capable of keeping the web from tipping'.
senses.whyCN: 平衡是隐喻中的隐喻：那张网被想象成一架会倾斜的天平。这里的 ecological 意为“能让网不倾覆的”。

senses.title: Of practice: farming and industry shaped by ecology
senses.titleCN: 实践上的：按生态学塑形的农业与产业
senses.definition: describing methods designed to work with ecosystems rather than against them
senses.definitionCN: 描述顺应而非对抗生态系统的做法
senses.example: Ecological farming replaced chemical spraying with predators.
senses.exampleCN: 生态农业用天敌取代了化学喷药。
senses.why: Here the adjective moves from describing nature to prescribing conduct. An ecological method is one whose design copies the relations the science discovered.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词从“描述自然”转为“规定行为”。所谓生态的方法，就是其设计模仿了科学所发现的关系。

senses.title: Of validity: findings that hold outside the lab
senses.titleCN: 效度的：结论在实验室外也成立
senses.definition: describing research whose conditions resemble real-world settings closely enough to generalise
senses.definitionCN: 描述研究条件足够接近真实世界、因而可推广
senses.example: The memory study was criticised for low ecological validity.
senses.exampleCN: 这项记忆研究因生态效度低而受到批评。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the word for a different kind of relation: not organism to habitat, but task to real life. Ecological validity asks whether the lab's little web resembles the world's big one.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借这个词表达另一种关系：不是生物与生境，而是任务与真实生活。生态效度问的是：实验室的小网是否像世界的大网。

senses.title: Of fallacy: a group pattern wrongly applied to individuals
senses.titleCN: 谬误的：把群体模式错加给个人
senses.definition: describing the error of inferring individual traits from aggregate group statistics
senses.definitionCN: 描述由群体汇总统计推断个体特征的错误
senses.example: Assuming every resident is wealthy is an ecological fallacy.
senses.exampleCN: 假定每位居民都富有，是一种生态谬误。
senses.why: The name comes from early studies of areal groups, where 'ecological' meant grouped by region. The fallacy is to read a map of averages as a description of persons.
senses.whyCN: 这个名称来自早期对地域群体的研究，那里的 ecological 指“按地区分组的”。该谬误就是把平均值地图当成对个人的描述。

intro.en: Ecological is ecology plus -ical. Ecology was coined by the German zoologist Ernst Haeckel, first as Oecologie in 1866 and recorded in English in the 1870s, from Greek oikos 'house, dwelling' plus -logia 'study of'. The adjective follows the noun and is not an inherited Latin word.
intro.cn: 一般认为，ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical。ecology 由德国动物学家恩斯特·海克尔所造，1866 年作 Oecologie，英语在 1870 年代见诸记载，由希腊语 oikos“房屋、居所”加 -logia“研究”构成。这个形容词随名词而造，并非继承的拉丁词。

items.en: The adjective extends into policy, agriculture, psychology and statistics, each adding a different noun after it: footprint, farming, validity, fallacy.
items.cn: 这个形容词扩展到政策、农业、心理学和统计学，各自接上不同的名词：footprint、farming、validity、fallacy。

items.en: English ecology and ecological are recorded, spreading Haeckel's German coinage through British and American science.
items.cn: 英语 ecology 与 ecological 一般认为在 1870 年代见于记载（确切年份来源不确定），把海克尔的德语新造词传播到英美科学界。

items.en: Haeckel proposes Oecologie for the relation of organisms to their environment, using Greek oikos 'house' as the image of a shared dwelling.
items.cn: 海克尔提出 Oecologie，指生物与其环境的关系，用希腊语 oikos“房屋”作为共同居所的意象。

items.en: oikos 'house, household' is the base of oikonomia 'household management' and oikoumene 'the inhabited world', so ecology, economy and ecumenical all begin from one house.
items.cn: oikos“房屋、家户”是 oikonomia“家务管理”与 oikoumene“有人居住的世界”的词基，因此 ecology、economy、ecumenical 都从同一座房子出发。

items.en: -logia comes from logos 'word, account, reasoning', from legein 'to gather, say'. Ecology is thus a 'account of the house' rather than a 'law of the house'; the law sense belongs to -nomia.
items.cn: -logia 出自 logos“言说、论述、推理”，再上为 legein“聚集、说”。所以 ecology 是“关于家户的论述”，而不是“家户的法则”；“法则”义属于 -nomia。

note.en: The first group separates a shared-house relative and two accidental neighbours; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个同屋同源的词和两个偶然撞形的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: thrifty, or relating to saving money. It shares oikos 'house' but adds nomos 'managing, law', so it concerns household management, not the study of life.
entries.definitionCN: 节约的；与省钱相关的。它与 ecological 共享 oikos“房屋”，但接的是 nomos“管理、法则”，因此讲的是家务管理，不是生命研究。

entries.definition: selecting from many sources. It comes from Greek eklektikos 'selective', from eklegein 'to pick out', and only looks like eco-.
entries.definitionCN: 从多种来源中选取的。它出自希腊语 eklektikos“挑选的”，源于 eklegein“挑出”，只是看起来像 eco-。

entries.definition: a reflected sound. It comes from Greek ēkhē 'sound', with no relation to oikos 'house'.
entries.definitionCN: 回声。它出自希腊语 ēkhē“声音”，与 oikos“房屋”无关。

entries.definition: relating to the surroundings of living things. It is broader and less relational than ecological, which stresses interactions.
entries.definitionCN: 与生物周围环境相关的。它比 ecological 更宽、更少讲关系，而 ecological 强调相互作用。

entries.definition: environmentally friendly, in everyday speech. It is a stance or label, where ecological is a descriptive relation.
entries.definitionCN: 日常口语中“环保的”。它是一种立场或标签，而 ecological 是描述性关系。

entries.definition: relating to a whole ecosystem as a system. It is more technical and more whole-oriented than ecological.
entries.definitionCN: 把整个生态系统当作系统来看的。它比 ecological 更技术化、更强调整体。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecological is ecology plus -ical; -ical is the adjective suffix seen in biological and geological.
normal.cn: ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical；-ical 是 biological、geological 里那个形容词后缀。

normal.en: eco- comes from Greek oikos 'house', not from 'eco' as a brand of anything.
normal.cn: eco- 出自希腊语 oikos“房屋”，不是任何品牌的“eco”。

normal.en: -logy is 'study of', so ecology is the study of the household of life; -nomy in economy is 'managing', a different second half.
normal.cn: -logy 是“研究”，所以 ecology 是研究生命之家户；economy 里的 -nomy 是“管理”，后半截不同。

normal.en: ecological validity and ecological fallacy are both statistical uses, not nature uses.
normal.cn: ecological validity 与 ecological fallacy 都是统计学用法，不是自然用法。

normal.en: The adjective keeps the noun's web image: a stream, its fish, the trees and the farm are one linked system.
normal.cn: 这个形容词保留名词的“网”意象：溪水、鱼、树、农田是一个相连的系统。

abstract.en: Picture an invisible net laid over a valley: every knot is an organism, every line a relation.
abstract.cn: 想象一张看不见的网铺在山谷上：每个结是一个生物，每条线是一种关系。

abstract.en: The same net explains a role, an impact, a balance, a farming method, a lab's realism and a statistical error.
abstract.cn: 同一张网可以解释一个角色、一种影响、一种平衡、一种耕作法、一间实验室的真实度，以及一个统计错误。

abstract.en: Every sense asks one question: what is tied to what, and what happens when one knot moves?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问一个问题：什么与什么相连，当一个结移动时会发生什么？

examples.en: The report assessed the ecological impact of the new port.
examples.cn: 这份报告评估了新港口的生态影响。

examples.en: Beavers play an ecological role by building wetlands.
examples.cn: 河狸通过筑造湿地发挥生态作用。

examples.en: Ecological farming uses predators instead of pesticides.
examples.cn: 生态农业用天敌代替杀虫剂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口逻辑」——一口水、一口土都讲逻辑，万物相互牵连 → ecological 生态的

root: 希腊语 oikos“房屋、家户”＋-logia“研究、论述”（logos“言说、推理”）→ ecology“生态学”；再加 -ical（形容词后缀）→ ecological。核心是“把自然看成一户人家，成员彼此相连”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep the image of a net of relations. What changes is the question asked of the net: what is it, how is it damaged, who fills which role, how much is taken, how it stays balanced, how we imitate it, whether a study resembles it, or how it is misread.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留“关系之网”的意象。变化的只是对这张网提出的问题：它是什么、如何受损、谁担任什么角色、取走多少、如何保持平衡、我们如何模仿它、研究是否像它、以及它如何被误读。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an invisible net ties stream, fish, trees and farmland into one system.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张看不见的网把溪水、鱼、树、农田连成一个系统。

branches.en: THE SCIENCE AND ITS RELATIONS: ecology studies the household, and ecological marks what belongs to that study or to its web of roles.
branches.cn: 学科及其关系：生态学研究这个“家户”，ecological 标记属于该研究或其角色之网的东西。

branches.en: CONDITION AND BALANCE: the net can be described as healthy or as tipping, which yields environmental damage and ecological balance.
branches.cn: 状况与平衡：这张网可以被描述为健康或正在倾覆，于是有生态破坏与生态平衡。

branches.en: ACCOUNTING: impact converts relations into a measurable footprint of land and resources.
branches.cn: 记账：影响把关系换算成可测量的土地与资源足迹。

branches.en: IMITATION: ecological farming copies the relations the science describes instead of overriding them.
branches.cn: 模仿：生态农业复制科学所描述的关系，而不是压过它们。

branches.en: TWO STATISTICAL EXTENSIONS: one asks whether a study resembles the real net; the other warns against reading group averages as persons.
branches.cn: 两个统计学延伸：一个问研究是否像真实的网；另一个警告不要把群体平均值读成个人。

intro.en: Ecological is ecology plus -ical. The suffix -ical, from Latin -icalis and Greek -ikos, turns a noun into an adjective of relation; the base ecology is a 19th-century scientific coinage from Greek elements.
intro.cn: ecological 是 ecology 加 -ical。后缀 -ical 出自拉丁语 -icalis 与希腊语 -ikos，把名词变成关系形容词；词基 ecology 则是 19 世纪用希腊语成分造出的科学新词。

latinIntro.en: The Greek pieces are oikos 'house, household' and -logia 'study, discourse'. oikos also gives economy and ecumenical; -logia gives biology, geology and psychology.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分是 oikos“房屋、家户”和 -logia“研究、论述”。oikos 还给出 economy、ecumenical；-logia 给出 biology、geology、psychology。

items.meaning: relating to ecology or to organism-environment relations
items.meaningCN: 与生态学或生物—环境关系相关的（-ical 构成关系形容词）
items.example: The reserve was chosen for its ecological value.
items.exampleCN: 这片保护区因生态价值而被选定。

items.meaning: the science of organisms and their environments
items.meaningCN: 研究生物与其环境的科学（eco- 表“家户”，-logy 表“研究”）
items.example: Ecology treats a forest as a system, not a list of trees.
items.exampleCN: 生态学把森林看作一个系统，而不是一份树木清单。

items.meaning: from an ecological point of view
items.meaningCN: 从生态角度；在生态上
items.example: The valley is ecologically fragile.
items.exampleCN: 这条山谷在生态上很脆弱。

items.meaning: a scientist who studies ecology
items.meaningCN: 生态学家（-ist 表示从事某学科的人）
items.example: An ecologist surveyed the marsh for three seasons.
items.exampleCN: 一位生态学家对这片沼泽做了三季调查。

items.meaning: a community and its environment treated as one unit
items.meaningCN: 生物群落与其环境构成的统一整体
items.example: The reef is a fragile ecosystem.
items.exampleCN: 珊瑚礁是一个脆弱的生态系统。

items.meaning: large-scale destruction of an ecosystem
items.meaningCN: 对生态系统的大规模破坏（-cide 表示“杀”）
items.example: The spill was called ecocide by local groups.
items.exampleCN: 当地团体把这次泄漏称为生态灭绝。

items.meaning: a transition zone between two ecosystems
items.meaningCN: 两个生态系统之间的过渡带
items.example: Species mix along the ecotone.
items.exampleCN: 物种在生态过渡带上混合分布。

items.meaning: a large regional community of life
items.meaningCN: 大尺度生物群落区（生物群系）
items.example: The taiga is the largest forest biome.
items.exampleCN: 泰加林是最大的森林生物群系。

items.meaning: the place where an organism lives
items.meaningCN: 栖息地（拉丁 habitare“居住”）
items.example: Drainage destroyed the frog's habitat.
items.exampleCN: 排水毁掉了这种蛙的栖息地。

items.meaning: the capacity to keep a system going without depletion
items.meaningCN: 可持续性；维持系统不耗竭的能力
items.example: The plan's sustainability depends on the water table.
items.exampleCN: 该方案的可持续性取决于地下水位。

latinEntries.meaning: the study of the household of nature; the form behind ecology
latinEntries.meaningCN: 关于自然家户的研究；ecology 所本的构词形式

definition_zh: 生态学家；研究生物与环境关系的科学家；野外生态调查者；生态保护倡导者；生态模型与数据分析者；修复生态学家；按类群分工的生态学家；生态咨询顾问
definition_en: a person who studies ecology: the relations between organisms and their environments, whether in the field, in models, or in conservation practice
core_image: 一个人跪在浅水里数着卵石下的幼虫，笔记本被溅湿了一半
scene: Kneeling in the shallows, the researcher counts larvae under the stones while the notebook gets wet. The researcher kneeling in the shallows is a field ecologist counting larvae.
sceneCN: 这里 ecologist 是「做野外生态调查的人」（第 2 个义项：野外生态调查者）；句意：跪在浅水里的研究者是一位野外生态学家，正在数石头下的幼虫。图中可辨识物件：浅水、翻起的卵石、幼虫、湿透的笔记本、装样品的塑料瓶。

pos.zh: 生态学家；生态研究工作者；生态保护者

derivatives.zh: 生态主义（以生态为核心的政治理念）

senses.title: The scientist: one who studies ecology
senses.titleCN: 科学家：以生态学为专业的人
senses.definition: a scientist whose discipline is the study of organisms and their environments
senses.definitionCN: 以研究生物与其环境关系为学科专业的科学家
senses.example: The ecologist argued that the two lakes differ in nutrient flow, not in size.
senses.exampleCN: 这位生态学家认为，两个湖的差别在养分流动，而不在面积。
senses.why: Ecologist is ecology plus -ist, the person suffix from Greek -istēs. Ecology itself was coined from oikos 'house' and -logia 'study', so the person is literally 'one who studies the household of life'.
senses.whyCN: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist，后者出自希腊语 -istēs，表示从事某学科的人。ecology 本身由 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”构成，所以这个人字面上就是“研究生命之家户的人”。

senses.title: The field worker: counting in the mud
senses.titleCN: 野外工作者：在泥里做计数
senses.definition: a researcher who gathers ecological data outdoors rather than only from models or archives
senses.definitionCN: 在户外而非仅从模型或档案中获取生态数据的研究者
senses.example: A field ecologist spent the summer tagging young bats.
senses.exampleCN: 一位野外生态学家整个夏天都在给幼蝠上标记。
senses.why: Because ecology's object is a relation in a real place, its practitioners must go there. The word in this sense names a method as much as a degree: boots, nets, quadrats.
senses.whyCN: 因为生态学的对象是真实地点中的关系，从业者必须到现场。这个义项里的词，既指一种学位，也指一种方法：靴子、网、样方。

senses.title: The advocate: using ecology for protection
senses.titleCN: 倡导者：用生态学推动保护
senses.definition: a person who applies ecological knowledge to defend species, habitats, or ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 运用生态学知识来保护物种、生境或生态系统的人
senses.example: The ecologist testified against draining the marsh.
senses.exampleCN: 这位生态学家出庭作证，反对排干这片沼泽。
senses.why: The suffix -ist also marks a role in public life. When the study's findings are used in argument, 'ecologist' shifts from researcher to witness for a place that cannot speak.
senses.whyCN: -ist 也标记公共生活中的角色。当研究结论被用于论辩时，ecologist 就从研究者转为替一个无法开口的地方作证的人。

senses.title: The modeller: turning relations into equations
senses.titleCN: 建模者：把关系写成方程
senses.definition: a researcher who represents ecological processes in mathematical or computational models
senses.definitionCN: 用数学或计算模型表示生态过程的研究者
senses.example: A theoretical ecologist predicted the collapse before it was visible.
senses.exampleCN: 一位理论生态学家在崩溃可见之前就预测到了它。
senses.why: Ecology's relations can be counted, so a branch of the field works indoors with parameters instead of quadrats. The person noun stays the same, but the tools change.
senses.whyCN: 生态学的关系可以计数，于是有分支在室内用参数而非样方工作。人这个名词不变，工具却换了。

senses.title: The restorer: rebuilding a broken system
senses.titleCN: 修复者：重建受损的系统
senses.definition: a specialist who plans and monitors the recovery of a degraded ecosystem
senses.definitionCN: 规划并监测退化生态系统恢复的专门人员
senses.example: A restoration ecologist chose native grasses for the old quarry.
senses.exampleCN: 一位修复生态学家为这座旧采石场选用了本地草种。
senses.why: Restoration adds a purpose to the study: the ecologist does not only describe the web but tries to re-weave it. The compound names a practical branch of the discipline.
senses.whyCN: 修复给研究加上了目的：生态学家不只描述这张网，还试着把它重新织起来。这个复合词命名了该学科的一个实践分支。

senses.title: The specialist: named by the group studied
senses.titleCN: 专门家：按研究类群命名
senses.definition: a researcher identified by the kind of organism or habitat they study, as in plant ecologist or microbial ecologist
senses.definitionCN: 按所研究的生物类群或生境来称呼的研究者，如植物生态学家、微生物生态学家
senses.example: A microbial ecologist found the bacteria living two kilometres underground.
senses.exampleCN: 一位微生物生态学家发现了生活在两公里地下的细菌。
senses.why: When ecology became a profession, its division of labour followed taxa. The modifier before 'ecologist' is not decoration; it states which part of the web the person follows.
senses.whyCN: 生态学成为专业后，分工按类群展开。ecologist 前的修饰语并非装饰，它说明这个人追踪的是网上的哪一部分。

senses.title: The historian of nature: reading old systems
senses.titleCN: 自然史研究者：读取旧系统
senses.definition: a researcher who reconstructs past ecological conditions from sediments, pollen, or old records
senses.definitionCN: 从沉积物、花粉或旧记录重建过去生态状况的研究者
senses.example: A historical ecologist traced the lake's decline through pollen layers.
senses.exampleCN: 一位历史生态学家通过花粉层追溯这个湖的衰退。
senses.why: This branch adds time to ecology: a system has a past, and the ecologist reads it in layers. The noun now covers work in cores and archives, not only in living places.
senses.whyCN: 这一分支给生态学加上时间：系统有过去，生态学家在层层沉积中读取它。这个名词于是覆盖了岩芯与档案里的工作，而不只是活着的现场。

senses.title: The consultant: ecology applied to a project
senses.titleCN: 顾问：把生态学用于具体项目
senses.definition: a professional who assesses ecological risk for developers, planners, or regulators
senses.definitionCN: 为开发商、规划者或监管者评估生态风险的专业人员
senses.example: The consultant ecologist required a survey before the road was widened.
senses.exampleCN: 这位生态咨询顾问要求在拓宽道路之前先做一次调查。
senses.why: In planning law, ecological knowledge becomes a check on construction. The person noun takes on a commercial role, but the object remains the same: which relations will this project cut?
senses.whyCN: 在规划法中，生态知识成为对建设的审查。这个人称名词带上了商业角色，但对象没变：这个项目会切断哪些关系？

intro.en: Ecologist is ecology plus -ist, the person suffix from Greek -istēs. Ecology was coined by Ernst Haeckel in 1866 from Greek oikos 'house' and -logia 'study'. The first English uses of ecologist date from the late 19th century, though the exact year is not certain.
intro.cn: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist，后者出自希腊语 -istēs 的人物后缀。ecology 由恩斯特·海克尔于 1866 年用希腊语 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”造出。英语中 ecologist 最早见于 19 世纪后期，具体年份来源不确定。

items.en: Specialisms multiply: restoration ecologist, microbial ecologist, consultant ecologist, and historical ecologist become ordinary job titles.
items.cn: 专业分支不断增多：修复生态学家、微生物生态学家、生态咨询顾问、历史生态学家都成了常见职称。

items.en: English ecologist is recorded as the science acquires its first journals and university posts; the dating is approximate.
items.cn: 随着这门科学拥有最早的期刊与大学教职，英语 ecologist 见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Haeckel names Oecologie, the study of the relations of organisms to their surroundings, and the person noun follows naturally from the discipline name.
items.cn: 海克尔命名 Oecologie，即研究生物与其周围环境关系的学问，人物名词随之自然派生。
