items.en: oikos 'house, household' supplies eco-, and -logia 'study, discourse' supplies -logy; -istēs was the ordinary Greek suffix for 'one who practises'.
items.cn: oikos“房屋、家户”提供 eco-，-logia“研究、论述”提供 -logy；-istēs 是希腊语中表示“从事者”的常用后缀。

items.en: The -ist suffix is productive rather than inherited: English can attach it to almost any discipline, which is why ecologist may mean researcher, advocate, or consultant.
items.cn: -ist 是能产的后缀而非直接继承：英语几乎可以把它加到任何学科名上，这正是 ecologist 可指研究者、倡导者或顾问的原因。

note.en: The first group separates a shared-house relative from a true derivative and an accidental neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个同屋同源的词、一个真正的派生词和一个偶然撞形的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: one who studies the production and use of wealth. It shares oikos 'house' but joins it to nomos 'managing', not to logia 'study'.
entries.definitionCN: 研究财富生产与使用的人。它与 ecologist 共享 oikos“房屋”，但接的是 nomos“管理”，不是 logia“研究”。

entries.definition: the adjective of ecology, describing relations rather than a person. Ecologist is the human counterpart of the same stem.
entries.definitionCN: ecology 的形容词，描述关系而非人。ecologist 是同一词干上的人物对应词。

entries.definition: selecting from many sources. Greek eklektikos 'selective' has no connection with oikos or -logia.
entries.definitionCN: 从多种来源中选取的。希腊语 eklektikos“挑选的”与 oikos、-logia 均无关联。

entries.definition: a scientist who studies living things generally. Ecology is one branch of biology, so ecologist is narrower and relation-focused.
entries.definitionCN: 泛研究生命的科学家。生态学是生物学的一个分支，所以 ecologist 范围更窄、更聚焦关系。

entries.definition: a person who campaigns for environmental protection. It names a stance, while ecologist names a training.
entries.definitionCN: 为环境保护奔走的人。它指立场，而 ecologist 指专业训练。

entries.definition: a person who studies nature by observation, often without formal experiment. Ecologist implies measurement and hypothesis, naturalist implies close watching.
entries.definitionCN: 以观察研究自然的人，常不做正式实验。ecologist 含测量与假设，naturalist 含细致观看。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecologist is ecology plus -ist, the same -ist that makes biologist and geologist.
normal.cn: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist，和 biologist、geologist 里的 -ist 一样。

normal.en: eco- is Greek oikos 'house', so the ecologist studies the household of life.
normal.cn: eco- 是希腊语 oikos“房屋”，所以生态学家研究的是生命这户人家。

normal.en: Economist and ecologist share oikos but split at the second element: nomos 'manage' versus logia 'study'.
normal.cn: economist 与 ecologist 共享 oikos，却在第二截分开：nomos“管理”对 logia“研究”。

normal.en: The -ist does not only mean 'scientist': it also covers the advocate and the consultant.
normal.cn: -ist 不只表示“科学家”，也覆盖倡导者和顾问。

normal.en: A field ecologist carries boots and nets; a theoretical ecologist carries equations; both carry the same word.
normal.cn: 野外生态学家带靴子和网，理论生态学家带方程，两者都带同一个词。

abstract.en: Picture a person kneeling in a stream, counting what lives under stones, because the web is invisible unless someone counts its knots.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人跪在溪里数石头下的生物，因为这张网若不数结，就看不见。

abstract.en: The same person may later testify, model, replant a quarry, or sign a survey for a road.
abstract.cn: 同一个人后来可以去作证、做模型、在采石场补种，或为一条道路签调查报告。

abstract.en: Every sense asks who is counting the web, and for what purpose.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：是谁在数这张网，又为了什么。

examples.en: The ecologist found that removing one predator reshaped the whole pond.
examples.cn: 这位生态学家发现，移除一种捕食者改变了整个池塘。

examples.en: Consultant ecologists must survey the site before construction.
examples.cn: 生态咨询顾问必须在施工前勘察场地。

examples.en: A restoration ecologist spent five years reweaving the floodplain.
examples.cn: 一位修复生态学家花了五年重建这片洪泛平原的生态联系。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口逻辑事」——一口水一口土都要讲逻辑，专门研究它的人 → ecologist 生态学家

root: 希腊语 oikos“房屋、家户”＋-logia“研究”构成 ecology；再加 -ist（希腊语 -istēs，表示从事者）→ ecologist。核心是“数清生命之家户里各种关系的人”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses name the same role: someone who reads the web of relations. What varies is the setting and the purpose — a laboratory, a stream, a hearing, a model, a quarry, a taxon, a sediment core, a planning office.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项命名的是同一个角色：读那张关系之网的人。变化的是场景与目的——实验室、溪流、听证会、模型、采石场、某类群、沉积岩芯、规划办公室。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person kneels in shallow water, counting larvae under stones.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人跪在浅水里，数石头下的幼虫。

branches.en: THE PROFESSION AND ITS METHOD: the discipline creates the title, and the field forces the practitioner outdoors.
branches.cn: 专业与方法：学科造出头衔，野外又把这个从业者赶到户外。

branches.en: PROTECTION: findings become testimony when a habitat cannot speak for itself.
branches.cn: 保护：当生境无法为自己发言时，研究结论就成了证词。

branches.en: ABSTRACTION: relations become parameters, and the ecologist works with equations instead of quadrats.
branches.cn: 抽象化：关系变成参数，生态学家用方程代替样方工作。

branches.en: SPECIALISATION: the role narrows either by purpose (restoration) or by taxon (plant, microbe).
branches.cn: 专门化：角色或按目的收窄（修复），或按类群收窄（植物、微生物）。

branches.en: TWO OUTER ROLES: one reads the past in sediments, the other reads the future in a project's plans.
branches.cn: 两个外围角色：一个在沉积物里读过去，一个在项目图纸里读未来。

intro.en: Ecologist is ecology plus -ist. -ist, from Greek -istēs, names a person who practises an art or science; English attaches it freely to discipline names.
intro.cn: ecologist 是 ecology 加 -ist。-ist 出自希腊语 -istēs，表示从事某种技艺或科学的人；英语可以自由地把它加到学科名上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base is oikos 'house' plus -logia 'study'. The same oikos appears in economy, and the same -logia in biology and geology.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基是 oikos“房屋”加 -logia“研究”。同一个 oikos 见于 economy，同一个 -logia 见于 biology 与 geology。

items.meaning: one who studies ecology
items.meaningCN: 研究生态学的人（-ist 表示从业者）
items.example: The ecologist mapped the nesting sites.
items.exampleCN: 这位生态学家绘制了筑巢地点图。

items.meaning: the science of organisms and environments
items.meaningCN: 研究生物与其环境的科学
items.example: Ecology answers questions about relations, not just species.
items.exampleCN: 生态学回答的是关系问题，而不只是物种问题。

items.meaning: of ecology or of organism-environment relations
items.meaningCN: 生态学的；生态关系的
items.example: The site has high ecological value.
items.exampleCN: 这处场地具有很高的生态价值。

items.meaning: in ecological terms, from an ecological standpoint
items.meaningCN: 从生态角度看；在生态上
items.example: The plan is ecologically sound.
items.exampleCN: 这个方案在生态上是合理的。

items.meaning: a political philosophy centred on ecology
items.meaningCN: 以生态为中心的政治理念（-ism 表示主义）
items.example: Ecologism treats nature as a political subject.
items.exampleCN: 生态主义把自然当作政治主体。

items.meaning: one who studies living things
items.meaningCN: 研究生命的研究者（生物学家）
items.example: The biologist specialised in bats.
items.exampleCN: 这位生物学家专门研究蝙蝠。

items.meaning: one who studies rocks and earth history
items.meaningCN: 研究岩石与地球历史的人（地质学家）
items.example: A geologist dated the ash layer.
items.exampleCN: 一位地质学家测定了火山灰层的年代。

items.meaning: one who studies production, wealth and markets
items.meaningCN: 研究生产、财富与市场的人（经济学家）
items.example: The economist forecast slower growth.
items.exampleCN: 这位经济学家预测增长放缓。

items.meaning: one who campaigns to protect nature
items.meaningCN: 致力于保护自然的人（自然保护者）
items.example: Conservationists opposed the dam.
items.exampleCN: 自然保护者反对这座大坝。

items.meaning: one devoted to a narrow field
items.meaningCN: 专攻某一狭窄领域的人（专家）
items.example: The specialist identified the rare moss.
items.exampleCN: 这位专家辨认出了那种稀有苔藓。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 从事者；追随者（后被英语吸收为 -ist）

latinEntries.meaning: study of the household of nature

definition_zh: 生态学；生物与环境关系的总体；生态系统的运作状态；生态保护运动；人类生态学；深层生态学；某一专门分支（如微生物生态学）；相互关联的系统隐喻
definition_en: the scientific study of the relations between organisms and their environments, and by extension the system of those relations, its condition, or a movement that treats it as a political object
core_image: 一座玻璃房里的所有生物、水、土和光都被放在同一张关系图上
scene: Inside the sealed glass house, every plant, drop of water, grain of soil and ray of light appears on one relation chart. Ecology is the study of exactly these relations.
sceneCN: 这里 ecology 是「生态学，把生物与环境当作一个关系系统来研究」（第 1 个义项：生态学）；句意：生态学研究的正是这些关系。图中可辨识物件：玻璃温室、植物、水珠、土粒、光线、墙上的关系图。

pos.zh: 生态学；生态系统；生态关系；生态保护运动

collocations.zh: 深层生态学（自然具有内在价值的理念）

forms.label: 单数（一门学科／一个系统）
复数（多种生态／多套生态系统）

senses.title: The discipline: the science of relations
senses.titleCN: 学科：研究关系的科学
senses.definition: the branch of biology that studies how organisms interact with one another and with their surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 研究生物如何彼此互动、以及如何与环境互动的生物学分支
senses.example: Ecology asks how a change in one species propagates through a community.
senses.exampleCN: 生态学追问一个物种的变化如何传遍整个群落。
senses.why: Haeckel coined Oecologie in 1866 from Greek oikos 'house' and -logia 'study'. The name imagines nature as one household whose members cannot be understood alone.
senses.whyCN: 海克尔于 1866 年用希腊语 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”造出 Oecologie。这个名字把自然想象成一户人家，成员无法被孤立地理解。

senses.title: The relations themselves: how the parts hang together
senses.titleCN: 关系本身：各部分如何彼此牵连
senses.definition: the set of interactions that link organisms to each other and to their physical setting
senses.definitionCN: 把生物彼此、以及把生物与物理环境联系起来的互动总体
senses.example: The ecology of the salt marsh depends on the tide more than on rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 这片盐沼的生态关系更多取决于潮汐，而非降雨。
senses.why: The suffix -logy names a study, but English often uses the noun for the object studied as well. Metonymy moves the word from the account to the thing accounted for.
senses.whyCN: -logy 命名的是“研究”，但英语常把这个名词也用于被研究的对象。转喻让词从“论述”移到“被论述之物”。

senses.title: The system itself: a place taken as a whole
senses.titleCN: 系统本身：把一处地方当作整体
senses.definition: a particular community and its environment considered as a working unit
senses.definitionCN: 被当作运作单元来看待的某一群落及其环境
senses.example: The pond's ecology collapsed after the oxygen dropped.
senses.exampleCN: 溶氧下降后，这个池塘的生态系统崩溃了。
senses.why: Saying 'the ecology of the pond' treats a place as an object with a working order. The word licenses statements about health, collapse, and recovery, which a mere species list would not.
senses.whyCN: 说“这个池塘的 ecology”就是把一处地方当成有运作秩序的对象。这个词使“健康、崩溃、恢复”这类说法成立，而单靠物种清单做不到。

senses.title: The movement: ecology as a political cause
senses.titleCN: 运动：把生态当作政治议题
senses.definition: an organised movement that seeks to protect ecosystems and limit environmental damage
senses.definitionCN: 旨在保护生态系统、限制环境破坏的有组织运动
senses.example: The ecology movement forced the plant to publish its emissions.
senses.exampleCN: 生态保护运动迫使这家工厂公布排放数据。
senses.why: Once the science showed that damage spreads through the web, the noun could name the campaign built on those findings. Ecology became a label for a politics, not only a course.
senses.whyCN: 一旦科学证明破坏会沿网扩散，这个名词就能命名建立在这些发现之上的运动。ecology 成了一个政治标签，而不只是一门课。

senses.title: Human ecology: people inside the web
senses.titleCN: 人类生态学：人也在网中
senses.definition: the study of human societies as parts of ecological systems, including resource use and settlement patterns
senses.definitionCN: 把人类社会当作生态系统的组成部分来研究，包括资源利用与聚落格局
senses.example: Human ecology links city growth to the water supply of the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 人类生态学把城市增长与平原的供水联系起来。
senses.why: The compound puts humans back among the organisms rather than outside nature. The same relational logic now covers food, housing and waste.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把人放回生物之中，而不是置于自然之外。同一套关系逻辑现在覆盖食物、住房与废物。

senses.title: Deep ecology: nature with its own value
senses.titleCN: 深层生态学：自然自身的价值
senses.definition: a philosophy holding that ecosystems have intrinsic worth independent of human use
senses.definitionCN: 认为生态系统具有独立于人类用途的内在价值的哲学
senses.example: Deep ecology rejects the idea that a forest is only a timber reserve.
senses.exampleCN: 深层生态学反对“森林只是一座木材储备”的观点。
senses.why: The adjective 'deep' marks a shift from managing nature for people to asking whether it has claims of its own. Ecology here becomes an ethics, not a measurement.
senses.whyCN: 形容词“deep”标记一次转向：从“为人管理自然”转向“自然是否有自身的主张”。这里的 ecology 成了伦理学，而不是测量。

senses.title: A named branch: ecology plus a subject
senses.titleCN: 分支学科：生态学加上某个对象
senses.definition: a specialised field formed by joining ecology to the organisms or setting studied, as in microbial or chemical ecology
senses.definitionCN: 把生态学与所研究的生物或场景结合而成的专门领域，如微生物生态学、化学生态学
senses.example: Chemical ecology explains how a plant's scent calls its predators' enemies.
senses.exampleCN: 化学生态学解释了植物的气味如何召来捕食者的天敌。
senses.why: The noun is productive in compounds because relations can be studied at any scale. The modifier says which scale or signal is in view.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词在复合词中很有能产性，因为关系可以在任何尺度上研究。修饰语说明所看的是哪个尺度或哪种信号。

senses.title: A system metaphor: any field of interdependence
senses.titleCN: 系统隐喻：任何相互依赖的领域
senses.definition: the pattern of interdependence within a non-biological system, such as media, software, or knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 非生物系统（如媒介、软件、知识）内部相互依赖的格局
senses.example: The 'information ecology' of a newsroom shapes which stories survive.
senses.exampleCN: 新闻编辑室的“信息生态”决定了哪些报道能活下来。
senses.why: Because ecology's core is relation rather than biology, the word travels: an ecology of media has niches, flows and extinctions too. The metaphor borrows structure, not organisms.
senses.whyCN: 因为 ecology 的核心是关系而非生物，这个词可以迁移：媒介生态也有生态位、流动与灭绝。隐喻借用的是结构，而非生物。

intro.en: Ecology was coined as a scientific term, not inherited. Ernst Haeckel proposed Oecologie in 1866 from Greek oikos 'house, dwelling' and -logia 'study, discourse'. English adopted it in the 1870s. The claim that the term was first used in 1866 rather than 1869 rests on Haeckel's own account and is generally accepted.
intro.cn: ecology 是作为科学术语被造出的，而非继承而来。恩斯特·海克尔于 1866 年用希腊语 oikos“房屋、居所”与 -logia“研究、论述”提出 Oecologie。英语一般认为在 1870 年代采用。关于该词最早使用于 1866 年而非 1869 年，依据是海克尔本人的记述，一般被接受。

items.en: The noun spreads beyond biology into human ecology, deep ecology, media ecology, and political language.
items.cn: 这个名词越出生物学，进入人类生态学、深层生态学、媒介生态学与政治语言。

items.en: English ecology is recorded, and the word enters textbooks and journals alongside the new German science.
items.cn: 英语 ecology 一般认为在 1870 年代见于记载（确切年份来源不确定），随着这门新的德国科学进入教科书与期刊。

items.en: Haeckel proposes Oecologie for the body of knowledge about the relations of organisms to their environment.
items.cn: 海克尔提出 Oecologie，指关于生物与其环境关系的知识总体。

items.en: oikos 'house, household' supplies the first element, and -logia 'study, discourse' the second. The same oikos gives economy; the same -logia gives biology.
items.cn: oikos“房屋、家户”提供第一成分，-logia“研究、论述”提供第二成分。同一个 oikos 给出 economy；同一个 -logia 给出 biology。

items.en: Haeckel's original spelling Oecologie reflects the Greek oikos with an oe-; English simplified it to eco-. The 'household' image is deliberate, not decorative.
items.cn: 海克尔原拼 Oecologie 用 oe- 反映希腊语 oikos；英语简化为 eco-。“家户”意象是有意为之，不是装饰。

note.en: The first group separates a shared-oikos relative from a derivative and a real lexical neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个共享 oikos 的同源词、一个派生词和一个真正相邻的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the management of resources. It joins oikos 'house' to nomos 'managing, law', so it names household management rather than the study of life.
entries.definitionCN: 资源的管理。它把 oikos“房屋”接到 nomos“管理、法则”上，因此命名的是家务管理，而非生命研究。

entries.definition: a community and its environment as one unit. It was built in 1935 from ecology plus system, so it names one object of ecology rather than the discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 群落与其环境构成的整体。它于 1935 年由 ecology 加 system 造成，命名的是生态学的一个对象，而非学科本身。

entries.definition: the study of animal behaviour. Its root is Greek ethos 'character, habit', not oikos 'house'.
entries.definitionCN: 动物行为学。其词根是希腊语 ethos“性格、习性”，不是 oikos“房屋”。

entries.definition: the study of living things in general. Ecology is a branch of biology that concentrates on relations and environments.
entries.definitionCN: 泛研究生命的科学。生态学是生物学的一个分支，集中于关系与环境。

entries.definition: an interdisciplinary field focused on environmental problems and solutions. It is more applied and more human-centred than ecology.
entries.definitionCN: 聚焦环境问题与对策的交叉领域。它比 ecology 更应用、更以人为中心。

entries.definition: an older term for the study of organisms in relation to their environment. It has largely been replaced by ecology.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物与环境关系的较早术语，现已基本被 ecology 取代。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecology = oikos 'house' + logia 'study': the study of nature's household.
normal.cn: ecology ＝ oikos“房屋”＋ logia“研究”：研究自然这户人家。

normal.en: Haeckel coined it in 1866, so it is younger than Darwin's Origin (1859).
normal.cn: 海克尔于 1866 年造出这个词，所以它比达尔文的《物种起源》（1859）更年轻。

normal.en: ecology and economy share oikos; -logy studies the house, -nomy manages it.
normal.cn: ecology 与 economy 共享 oikos；-logy 研究这座房子，-nomy 管理这座房子。

normal.en: The noun can name the science, the relations, or the system, because the study and its object share one word by metonymy.
normal.cn: 这个名词可指学科、关系或系统，因为“研究”与“对象”通过转喻共用一个词。

normal.en: Deep ecology is philosophy, not filed work: it asks whether nature has value without people.
normal.cn: 深层生态学是哲学而非野外工作：它问自然是否在人之外自有价值。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed glass house where every plant, drop and ray is drawn on one chart.
abstract.cn: 想象一座封闭的玻璃温室，每株植物、每滴水、每束光都被画在同一张图上。

abstract.en: The same chart becomes a science, a place, a movement, a human study, an ethic, a branch, and a metaphor for newsrooms.
abstract.cn: 同一张图可以变成一门科学、一处地方、一场运动、一项人类研究、一种伦理、一个分支，以及新闻编辑室的隐喻。

abstract.en: Every sense asks what is inside the glass and what is connected to what.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：玻璃房里有什么，什么又与什么相连。

examples.en: Ecology shows that a small change in one species can reshape a whole forest.
examples.cn: 生态学表明，一个物种的小变化可以重塑整片森林。

examples.en: The ecology of the estuary depends on the rhythm of the tides.
examples.cn: 这片河口的生态取决于潮汐的节律。

examples.en: Human ecology treats the city as a habitat, not as an exception to nature.
examples.cn: 人类生态学把城市看作一种生境，而不是自然的例外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口逻辑」——一口水、一口土都讲逻辑，研究这层关系 → ecology 生态学

root: 希腊语 oikos“房屋、家户”＋-logia“研究、论述”（logos“言说、推理”，legein“聚集、说”）→ ecology。1866 年由海克尔造出，核心是“把自然当作一户人家来研究其内部关系”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses share one chart of relations. What changes is whether the chart is the science, the relations, the place, a politics, a human application, a philosophy, a branch, or a pure metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享同一张关系图。变化的只是这张图是学科、是关系、是地方、是政治、是人类应用、是哲学、是分支，还是纯隐喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sealed glass house whose every inhabitant is drawn on one relation chart.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座封闭的玻璃温室，里面每个居民都被画在同一张关系图上。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE AND OBJECT: -logy names the study, but metonymy lets the same noun name the relations studied.
branches.cn: 学科与对象：-logy 命名研究，但转喻让同一名词也命名被研究的关系。

branches.en: WHOLE SYSTEM: 'the ecology of a pond' treats a place as a working order that can be healthy or collapsed.
branches.cn: 整体系统：“一个池塘的 ecology”把一处地方当成可健康、可崩溃的运作秩序。

branches.en: POLITICS: findings about spreading damage turn into an organised movement with demands.
branches.cn: 政治：关于破坏扩散的发现，转化为一场有诉求的有组织运动。

branches.en: HUMANS AND VALUE: people are put inside the web, and the web is then asked whether it has worth of its own.
branches.cn: 人与价值：人先被放进网里，随后这张网被追问是否有自身价值。

branches.en: SCALE AND METAPHOR: compounds name branches by scale or signal, and non-biological systems borrow the same structure.
branches.cn: 尺度与隐喻：复合词按尺度或信号命名分支，非生物系统则借用同一结构。

intro.en: Ecology is a compound of two Greek elements, eco- and -logy, coined as a unit in the 19th century. Neither half is a Latin affix in the strict sense; both are productive combining forms in modern science.
intro.cn: ecology 是 eco- 与 -logy 两个希腊成分构成的复合词，在 19 世纪作为整体被造出。两半严格说都不是拉丁语缀，而是现代科学中能产的构词成分。

latinIntro.en: The Greek sources are oikos 'house, household' and logos 'word, account, reasoning', from legein 'to gather, say'. The second element appears as -logia in Greek, shortened to -logy in English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊来源是 oikos“房屋、家户”与 logos“言说、论述、推理”，后者源于 legein“聚集、说”。第二成分在希腊语中作 -logia，英语缩短为 -logy。

items.meaning: the study of organisms in their household, the environment
items.meaningCN: 研究生物在其“家户”（环境）中的关系之学
items.example: Ecology began as the study of plant communities.
items.exampleCN: 生态学最初研究植物群落。

items.meaning: one who practises ecology
items.meaningCN: 从事生态学的人
items.example: The ecologist sampled the stream quarterly.
items.exampleCN: 这位生态学家每季度对溪流采样。

items.meaning: of ecology or environment
items.meaningCN: 生态的；与生态学相关的
items.example: The corridor has ecological importance.
items.exampleCN: 这条走廊具有生态重要性。

items.meaning: in ecological terms
items.meaningCN: 从生态角度
items.example: The wetland is ecologically sensitive.
items.exampleCN: 这片湿地在生态上很敏感。

items.meaning: a community and its environment as one working unit
items.meaningCN: 群落与环境构成的运作单元
items.example: The ecosystem recovers slowly after dredging.
items.exampleCN: 疏浚之后，这个生态系统恢复得很慢。

items.meaning: a boundary zone between two ecosystems
items.meaningCN: 两个生态系统之间的过渡带
items.example: Deer browse along the ecotone.
items.exampleCN: 鹿在生态过渡带上取食。

items.meaning: a locally adapted form of a species
items.meaningCN: 适应特定生境的生态型
items.example: The alpine ecotype flowers earlier.
items.exampleCN: 高山生态型开花更早。

items.meaning: the whole global system of life and its environment
items.meaningCN: 地球生命与环境构成的整体（生态圈）
items.example: Carbon cycles through the ecosphere.
items.exampleCN: 碳在生态圈中循环。

items.meaning: a community of interacting organisms
items.meaningCN: 相互作用生物构成的群落
items.example: The biocoenosis shifted after the flood.
items.exampleCN: 洪水之后，生物群落发生了改变。

items.meaning: the destruction of an ecosystem on a large scale
items.meaningCN: 大规模破坏生态系统（生态灭绝）
items.example: The spill was described as ecocide.
items.exampleCN: 这次泄漏被描述为生态灭绝。

latinEntries.meaning: the study or discourse of something
latinEntries.meaningCN: 关于某物的研究或论述

latinEntries.meaning: the modern Latin form behind ecology
latinEntries.meaningCN: ecology 所依据的近代拉丁构词形式

definition_zh: 节约的；省钱的；使用成本低的；节省资源的；简洁的；（旧）经济学的；委婉说法“不完全说实话的”；动作省力的
definition_en: using money, time, or resources without waste; cheap to operate; concise; or, in older use, relating to economics
core_image: 一位主妇把一张纸正反两面都写完，最后裁下边角当书签
scene: The housekeeper writes on both sides of the page and cuts the margin into a bookmark. Her habit of using both sides of the page is an economical one.
sceneCN: 这里 economical 是「节约的、不浪费的」（第 1 个义项：节约的）；句意：她把纸的正反两面都写满，还裁下边角当书签，这是节俭的做法。图中可辨识物件：写满两面的纸、裁纸刀、充当书签的纸边、旧信封、记账本。

pos.zh: 节约的；省钱的；节省资源的；简洁的

senses.title: Thrifty: spending little and wasting nothing
senses.titleCN: 节俭：少花钱、不浪费
senses.definition: careful in spending money or using goods so that nothing is wasted
senses.definitionCN: 在花钱或使用物品时谨慎，尽量不浪费
senses.example: An economical household repairs before it replaces.
senses.exampleCN: 节俭的家庭会先修理，而不是直接换新。
senses.why: Economical is economy plus -al, and economy comes from Greek oikonomia, 'household management': oikos 'house' plus nomos 'managing'. Thrift is literally good housekeeping.
senses.whyCN: economical 是 economy 加 -al，而 economy 出自希腊语 oikonomia“家务管理”：oikos“房屋”加 nomos“管理”。节俭字面上就是“会当家”。

senses.title: Cheap to run: low cost per use
senses.titleCN: 使用成本低：每次使用花费少
senses.definition: costing little to operate or maintain over time
senses.definitionCN: 长期使用或维护的花费很少
senses.example: The smaller engine is more economical on long trips.
senses.exampleCN: 较小的发动机在长途行驶中更省油。
senses.why: The focus shifts from the person's habit to the object's appetite. An economical machine manages its own household of fuel and upkeep well.
senses.whyCN: 焦点从人的习惯转到物的“食量”。一台 economical 的机器，能把燃料与保养这户小日子管理得很好。

senses.title: Resource-sparing: getting more from less
senses.titleCN: 省资源：用更少换更多
senses.definition: achieving a result with a small input of material, energy, or time
senses.definitionCN: 以较少的材料、能量或时间投入达成结果
senses.example: The design is economical in its use of steel.
senses.exampleCN: 这个设计在钢材使用上很节省。
senses.why: Here thrift is measured as a ratio rather than a virtue: output divided by input. The Greek 'management' idea becomes engineering efficiency without changing the word.
senses.whyCN: 这里的节俭被量成比率而非美德：产出除以投入。希腊语“管理”观念变成工程效率，词本身没变。

senses.title: Concise: a style that spends few words
senses.titleCN: 简洁：少花词句的文风
senses.definition: expressed in few words; not verbose
senses.definitionCN: 用很少的词表达；不啰嗦
senses.example: Her economical prose leaves the reader room to think.
senses.exampleCN: 她简洁的文笔给读者留出思考空间。
senses.why: When the budget is words, thrift becomes style. The metaphor treats language as a household whose supplies should not be wasted.
senses.whyCN: 当预算换成词句，节俭就变成文风。这个隐喻把语言当作一户人家，其“用品”不该被浪费。

senses.title: Modest: not lavish or extravagant
senses.titleCN: 朴素：不铺张、不奢华
senses.definition: simple and restrained rather than rich or showy
senses.definitionCN: 简单克制，而非富丽或张扬
senses.example: They chose an economical ceremony over a grand one.
senses.exampleCN: 他们选择了朴素的仪式，而不是盛大的典礼。
senses.why: The sense extends from money to taste: a thing can be economical because it refuses ornament. Restraint is thrift applied to appearance.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项从金钱延伸到品味：一物之所以 economical，是因为它拒绝装饰。克制就是把节俭用在观感上。

senses.title: Of economics: the older, now rare use
senses.titleCN: 经济学的：旧用法，今已少见
senses.definition: relating to economics or economic science (now usually expressed by economic)
senses.definitionCN: 与经济学或经济科学相关的（今多用 economic）
senses.example: The old treatise was titled 'Economical Arrangements'.
senses.exampleCN: 那部旧论著题为“经济安排”。
senses.why: In the 18th and 19th centuries economical often meant 'of political economy'. English later split the pair: economic for the science, economical for thrift.
senses.whyCN: 在 18、19 世纪，economical 常指“政治经济学的”。英语后来把这组词分开：economic 指学科，economical 指节俭。

senses.title: Economical with the truth: a polite evasion
senses.titleCN: 对真相有所保留：委婉的回避
senses.definition: a euphemism for misleading by omitting part of what one knows
senses.definitionCN: 以省略所知部分来误导他人的委婉说法
senses.example: The report was economical with the facts it did not like.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告对不合意的那些事实避而不谈。
senses.why: The phrase became famous in British official speech in the 1980s. It applies thrift to truth: the supply of information is deliberately rationed, which is not the same as lying outright.
senses.whyCN: 这个说法在 1980 年代英国官场广为人知。它把节俭用于真相：信息的供给被刻意配给，这与 outright 说谎并不相同。

senses.title: Economical in motion: a gait that saves effort
senses.titleCN: 动作省力：省劲的步态
senses.definition: moving with minimum wasted energy, as of a runner's stride
senses.definitionCN: 以最少多余能量移动，如跑者的步幅
senses.example: The runner's economical stride looked almost lazy.
senses.exampleCN: 这位跑者省力的步态看上去几乎有些懒散。
senses.why: The body too has a budget of energy. An economical movement wastes no motion, which is thrift measured in joules rather than coins.
senses.whyCN: 身体也有能量预算。economical 的动作不浪费一丝动程，这是以焦耳而非钱币衡量的节俭。

intro.en: Economical is economy plus -al. Economy entered English in the 16th century from Latin oeconomia, from Greek oikonomia 'household management', oikos 'house' plus nomos 'managing, law'. The adjective's older sense was 'of economics'; the 'thrifty' sense became dominant later.
intro.cn: economical 是 economy 加 -al。economy 一般认为于 16 世纪经拉丁语 oeconomia 进入英语，源自希腊语 oikonomia“家务管理”，即 oikos“房屋”加 nomos“管理、法则”。这个形容词较早的义项是“经济学的”，后来“节俭的”义项占了上风。

items.en: The pair splits: economic is fixed for 'of the economy or the science', economical for 'thrifty'. Before this, both forms overlapped.
items.cn: 这组词分工：economic 固定指“经济的、经济学的”，economical 指“节俭的”。在此之前两种形式有重叠。

items.en: Economical is common in titles and treatises meaning 'of political economy', a use now archaic.
items.cn: economical 常见于标题与论著，意为“政治经济学的”，此用法今已古旧。

items.en: Economy is borrowed from Latin oeconomia for the management of a household or state; the adjective follows with -al.
items.cn: economy 从拉丁语 oeconomia 借入，指管理家户或国家；形容词随后加 -al 而成。

items.en: oikonomia joins oikos 'house' with nomos 'managing, law', from nemein 'to distribute, manage'. The image is a steward allocating a household's stores.
items.cn: oikonomia 把 oikos“房屋”与 nomos“管理、法则”结合，后者源于 nemein“分配、管理”。意象是一位管家分配家中的存粮。

items.en: nomos 'law, managing' is not nomen 'name'. The -nomy in economy belongs with autonomy and astronomy's 'arranging', not with nominal and nominate.
items.cn: nomos“法则、管理”不是 nomen“名字”。economy 里的 -nomy 与 autonomy、astronomy 的“安排”同族，而与 nominal、nominate 无关。

note.en: The first group separates a same-root usage twin and two genuinely different roots; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个同根但分工不同的词和两个真正不同词根的词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: relating to the economy or to economics. It describes systems and policy; economical describes thrift in use.
entries.definitionCN: 与经济或经济学相关的。它描述系统与政策；economical 描述使用中的节俭。

entries.definition: existing in name only, or stated as a name value. It comes from nomen 'name', not nomos 'law, managing'.
entries.definitionCN: 名义上的；名目上的。它出自 nomen“名字”，不是 nomos“法则、管理”。

entries.definition: worldwide or unifying among churches. It comes from Greek oikoumene 'the inhabited world', built on oikos, but has no nomos element.
entries.definitionCN: 全世界范围的；教会间合一的。它出自希腊语 oikoumene“有人居住的世界”，以 oikos 为基，但没有 nomos 成分。

entries.definition: careful with money, often as a character trait. It stresses the person's habit, while economical can describe objects and methods.
entries.definitionCN: 花钱谨慎，常指性格。它强调人的习惯，而 economical 也可描述物件与方法。

entries.definition: sparing to the point of austerity. It is stronger and more moral in tone than economical, suggesting deliberate simplicity.
entries.definitionCN: 节省到近乎清苦。它比 economical 更强、更带道德色彩，暗示有意的简朴。

entries.definition: giving good value for the money spent. It is a calculated comparison, where economical may be a plain description.
entries.definitionCN: 花出的钱换来合算的价值。它是计算出来的比较，而 economical 可能只是平实描述。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: economical is economy plus -al; -al turns the noun into an adjective of manner.
normal.cn: economical 是 economy 加 -al；-al 把名词变成表示方式形容词。

normal.en: oikos 'house' explains why economical originally meant 'good at running a household'.
normal.cn: oikos“房屋”解释了为什么 economical 原意是“会当家的”。

normal.en: economic versus economical: one is about the system, the other about not wasting.
normal.cn: economic 对 economical：一个讲系统，一个讲不浪费。

normal.en: nomos 'manage' is not nomen 'name': economy has nothing to do with nominal.
normal.cn: nomos“管理”不是 nomen“名字”：economy 与 nominal 无关。

normal.en: Economical with the truth rations information the way a thrifty cook rations salt.
normal.cn: economical with the truth 像节俭的厨娘省盐一样，省着给信息。

abstract.en: Picture a page written on both sides, with the margin cut into a bookmark.
abstract.cn: 想象一张正反两面都写满、边角被裁成书签的纸。

abstract.en: The same thrift applies to fuel, steel, words, ceremony, truth and a runner's stride.
abstract.cn: 同一种节俭可以用在燃料、钢材、词句、仪式、真相和跑者的步幅上。

abstract.en: Every sense asks how much was spent to get the result, and whether the spending was necessary.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：为得到这个结果花了多少，以及这笔花费是否必要。

examples.en: This method is more economical because it reuses the solvent.
examples.cn: 这种方法更节约，因为它重复使用溶剂。

examples.en: Her economical style makes the argument easy to follow.
examples.cn: 她简洁的文风让论证容易跟上。

examples.en: The minister was accused of being economical with the truth.
examples.cn: 这位部长被指对真相有所隐瞒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口弄米扣」——一口锅弄米还要扣着量，太会省 → economical 节约的

root: 希腊语 oikonomia“家务管理”＝oikos“房屋”＋nomos“管理、法则”（nemein“分配”），经拉丁语 oeconomia 进入英语作 economy；加 -al 成 economical。核心是“把家中的存粮管得恰到好处，不浪费”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses apply one idea — no waste — to different budgets: coins, fuel, steel, words, ornament, public speech, truth, and bodily energy.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把同一个观念——“不浪费”——用到不同的预算上：钱币、燃料、钢材、词句、装饰、公开言论、真相、身体能量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page written on both sides, its margin cut into a bookmark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张正反两面都写满、边角被裁成书签的纸。

branches.en: PERSON AND OBJECT: first the householder wastes nothing, then the machine itself uses little.
branches.cn: 人与物：先是当家人不浪费，接着机器本身就吃得少。

branches.en: RATIO: thrift becomes a measured output per input, the engineering face of good management.
branches.cn: 比率：节俭变成可测量的投入产出比，即“会管理”的工程面孔。

branches.en: STYLE: a budget of words and a budget of ornament both produce restraint.
branches.cn: 风格：词句的预算与装饰的预算，都会产生克制。

branches.en: AN OLDER FIELD: economical once meant 'of political economy', the sense later taken over by economic.
branches.cn: 旧领域：economical 曾指“政治经济学的”，这一义项后来被 economic 接管。

branches.en: EXTREME CASES: truth can be rationed, and energy can be saved in a stride — thrift applied to information and to muscle.
branches.cn: 极端情形：真相可以被配给，能量可以在步态里节省——节俭被用于信息与肌肉。

intro.en: Economical is economy plus -al. The suffix -al, from Latin -alis, forms adjectives of relation; the base economy is Greek oikonomia, borrowed through Latin oeconomia.
intro.cn: economical 是 economy 加 -al。后缀 -al 出自拉丁语 -alis，构成关系形容词；词基 economy 是希腊语 oikonomia，经拉丁语 oeconomia 借入。

latinIntro.en: The Greek elements are oikos 'house' and nomos 'managing, law', from nemein 'to distribute'. oikos also gives ecology and ecumenical; nomos also gives autonomy and astronomy.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分是 oikos“房屋”与 nomos“管理、法则”，后者源于 nemein“分配”。oikos 还给出 ecology、ecumenical；nomos 还给出 autonomy、astronomy。

items.meaning: thrifty, or using resources without waste
items.meaningCN: 节约的；不浪费资源的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The stove is economical with firewood.
items.exampleCN: 这个炉子很省柴。

items.meaning: the management of resources; a country's system of production
items.meaningCN: 资源管理；一个国家的生产体系
items.example: The local economy depends on fishing.
items.exampleCN: 当地经济依赖渔业。

items.meaning: relating to the economy or economics
items.meaningCN: 经济的；经济学的
items.example: Economic growth slowed in the third quarter.
items.exampleCN: 第三季度经济增长放缓。

items.meaning: in economic terms, or in a thrifty way
items.meaningCN: 在经济上；节约地
items.example: The region is economically depressed.
items.exampleCN: 该地区经济萧条。

items.meaning: to cut spending or use less
items.meaningCN: 节省；节约使用（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: They economized by sharing an office.
items.exampleCN: 他们合用一间办公室以节省开支。

items.meaning: one who studies the economy
items.meaningCN: 经济学家（-ist 表示从业者）
items.example: Economists disagree about the cause of the slump.
items.exampleCN: 经济学家对衰退的原因意见不一。

items.meaning: the study of organisms and their household
items.meaningCN: 生态学（同样以 oikos“房屋”为基）
items.example: Ecology studies relations, not just species.
items.exampleCN: 生态学研究关系，而不只是物种。

items.meaning: self-rule; independence
items.meaningCN: 自治；自主（auto- 表示“自己”，nomos 指“法则”）
items.example: The region was granted limited autonomy.
items.exampleCN: 该地区获得有限自治权。

items.meaning: the study of the arrangement of stars
items.meaningCN: 天文学（字面“星辰的排布法则”）
items.example: Astronomy began with careful observation.
items.exampleCN: 天文学始于细致的观测。

items.meaning: sparing, avoiding waste
items.meaningCN: 节俭的；不浪费的（与 -al 同形，但词根不同）
items.example: A frugal diet kept them healthy.
items.exampleCN: 节俭的饮食让他们保持健康。

latinEntries.meaning: the Latin form through which economy reached English
latinEntries.meaningCN: economy 经以进入英语的拉丁语形式

definition_zh: 在经济上；从经济角度；节约地；以低成本方式；在资源使用效率上；在经济上处于某种状况（如贫困、活跃）；有利可图地；经济上依赖地
definition_en: with respect to the economy or to cost, or in a manner that avoids waste of money, time, or resources
core_image: 一个人左手提着满袋的特价菜，右手拿着账本，两条路都走向同一个收银台
scene: With a bag of discounted vegetables in one hand and a ledger in the other, he walks to the same checkout. He shops economically, buying discounted vegetables and entering every price in the ledger.
sceneCN: 这里 economically 是「在经济上、从花费角度」（第 3 个义项：在成本上）；句意：他一手提打折蔬菜，一手记账，按经济划算的方式采购。图中可辨识物件：特价蔬菜袋、账本、收银台、价签、计算器。

pos.zh: 在经济上；节约地；以低成本方式

collocations.zh: 经济活动人口中的（有工作或求职的）

senses.title: Thriftily: with little waste of money
senses.titleCN: 节约地：很少浪费钱
senses.definition: in a way that spends money carefully and avoids waste
senses.definitionCN: 以谨慎花钱、避免浪费的方式
senses.example: They lived economically and saved for the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 他们节俭度日，为修屋顶攒钱。
senses.why: Economically is economic plus -ally. Because economic and economical both descend from Greek oikonomia 'household management', the adverb can carry either 'of the economy' or 'without waste'.
senses.whyCN: economically 是 economic 加 -ally。由于 economic 与 economical 都出自希腊语 oikonomia“家务管理”，这个副词既能带“经济上的”义，也能带“不浪费地”义。

senses.title: In economic terms: as measured by the economy
senses.titleCN: 在经济上：按经济指标衡量
senses.definition: with reference to economic activity, output, or conditions
senses.definitionCN: 参照经济活动、产出或状况而言
senses.example: The two regions are economically very different.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个地区在经济上差别很大。
senses.why: Here -ally marks a point of view rather than a manner: the sentence looks at the region through an economic lens. This is the adverb's most common academic use.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 -ally 标记的是视角而非方式：句子透过经济这只镜头看这个地区。这是该副词最常见的学术用法。

senses.title: Cost-wise: in terms of price or outlay
senses.titleCN: 在成本上：就价格或开支而言
senses.definition: with respect to the cost of producing or obtaining something
senses.definitionCN: 就生产或获取某物的花费而言
senses.example: The plan is economically attractive but technically risky.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案在成本上有吸引力，技术上却有风险。
senses.why: Cost is the individual's version of the economy's budget. The adverb moves easily between a household ledger and a national accounts table.
senses.whyCN: 成本是个人版的“经济预算”。这个副词可以自如地在家用账本与国民账户之间移动。

senses.title: Resource-efficiently: using less to do more
senses.titleCN: 资源高效地：用更少做更多
senses.definition: in a manner that obtains a result with minimal material or energy input
senses.definitionCN: 以最少的材料或能量投入取得结果的方式
senses.example: The engine runs more economically at a steady speed.
senses.exampleCN: 发动机在稳定速度下运行更省。
senses.why: The adverb can modify a process rather than a person: running economically means the machine's input-output ratio is good, which is thrift expressed as engineering.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词可以修饰过程而非人：运行得 economically，就是机器的投入产出比好，也就是以工程语言表达的节俭。

senses.title: Profitably: so that the numbers work
senses.titleCN: 有利可图地：账算得过来
senses.definition: in a way that can be sustained financially or is worth the investment
senses.definitionCN: 在财务上可持续、或值得投入的方式
senses.example: The mine can operate economically only at high ore prices.
senses.exampleCN: 这座矿只有在矿石价格高时才能在经济上维持运营。
senses.why: Viability is thrift at the scale of a firm: what cannot cover its costs is not economical to run. The adverb here means 'so that costs are covered'.
senses.whyCN: 可行性是“企业尺度上的节俭”：覆盖不了成本的事，就不值得做。这个副词在此意为“在成本能被覆盖的前提下”。

senses.title: Economically disadvantaged: short of money
senses.titleCN: 经济弱势：缺钱
senses.definition: having low income or few material resources, as a social category
senses.definitionCN: 作为社会类别，指收入低或物质资源少
senses.example: The programme targets economically disadvantaged students.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目面向经济上处于弱势的学生。
senses.why: In policy language the adverb avoids naming poverty directly: it describes the dimension in which the disadvantage lies. The euphemism is precise about the axis, vague about the level.
senses.whyCN: 在政策语言中，这个副词避免直接说“贫穷”，而描述弱势所在的维度。这种委婉对“轴”很精确，对“程度”则含糊。

senses.title: Economically active: in the labour force
senses.titleCN: 经济活动人口：在劳动力中
senses.definition: engaged in or seeking paid work, as defined by labour statistics
senses.definitionCN: 按劳动统计定义，正在从事或寻找有偿工作
senses.example: Only half the adult population is economically active.
senses.exampleCN: 成年人口中只有一半属于经济活动人口。
senses.why: Statistics narrows 'economic' to paid work: caring for a household counts biologically and socially, but not in this measure. The adverb marks the boundary of the definition.
senses.whyCN: 统计把“经济的”窄化为有偿工作：家务在生物与社会意义上都算劳动，却不在此项统计内。这个副词标记了定义的边界。

senses.title: Economically dependent: relying on another's income
senses.titleCN: 经济依赖：依靠他人的收入
senses.definition: relying on another person or institution for the means of living
senses.definitionCN: 依靠他人或机构提供生活来源
senses.example: She remained economically dependent on her parents until thirty.
senses.exampleCN: 她三十岁前在经济上一直依赖父母。
senses.why: Dependence is the mirror of household management: someone else holds the purse. The adverb again marks the axis of reliance rather than describing behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 依赖是家务管理的镜像：钱袋握在别人手里。这个副词再次标记依赖的“轴”，而不是描述行为。

intro.en: Economically is economic plus -ally, the adverb ending from Latin -alis plus -e. Economic comes from Greek oikonomikos 'skilled in household management', through Latin oeconomicus. The adverb inherits both the 'of the economy' and the 'thrifty' branches of the family.
intro.cn: economically 是 economic 加 -ally，后者是拉丁语 -alis 加 -e 形成的副词词尾。economic 一般认为出自希腊语 oikonomikos“善于持家的”，经拉丁语 oeconomicus。这个副词同时继承了这一词族的“经济的”与“节俭的”两条分支。

items.en: Policy phrases such as economically disadvantaged and economically active become standard categories in official statistics.
items.cn: economically disadvantaged、economically active 等政策短语成为官方统计的标准类别。

items.en: Economic and economical settle into their modern division, and the adverb follows both: 'in economic terms' and 'without waste'.
items.cn: economic 与 economical 稳定为现代分工，副词也随之两用：既可表“在经济上”，也可表“不浪费地”。

items.en: Economic and economy enter English from Latin and Greek sources; the adverb ending -ally is added later in the usual way.
items.cn: economic 与 economy 自拉丁与希腊来源进入英语；副词词尾 -ally 随后按常规加上。

items.en: oikonomikos 'skilled in managing a household' is built on oikos 'house' plus nomos 'managing'. The adverb's two senses both descend from this one skill.
items.cn: oikonomikos“善于持家”由 oikos“房屋”加 nomos“管理”构成。副词的两个义项都源自这一种本领。

items.en: The -ally in economically is -al plus -ly, not a separate suffix '-ally'. The same pattern gives basically and systematically.
items.cn: economically 里的 -ally 是 -al 加 -ly，并不是独立的 -ally 后缀。basically、systematically 也是同样结构。

note.en: The first group separates a same-root twin and a same-root adverb from one different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分一个同根同族词、一个同根副词和一个不同词根的撞形词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the adjective meaning 'thrifty'. The adverb economically can express both this sense and the 'of the economy' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 意为“节约的”的形容词。副词 economically 既可表此义，也可表“经济上的”。

entries.definition: in name only, or by nominal value. nomen 'name' is the root, not nomos 'law, managing'.
entries.definitionCN: 名义上地；按名目值地。词根是 nomen“名字”，不是 nomos“法则、管理”。

entries.definition: in a way that unites churches or the inhabited world. It is built on oikoumene, from oikos, with no nomos element.
entries.definitionCN: 以联合各教会或普世的方式。它以 oikos 为基的 oikoumene 构成，没有 nomos 成分。

entries.definition: at low cost. It states the price level, while economically often adds the idea of good management.
entries.definitionCN: 以低价。它陈述价格水平，而 economically 常另含“管得好”的意思。

entries.definition: sparingly, with deliberate simplicity. It sounds more moral and more austere than economically.
entries.definitionCN: 节省地、有意简朴地。它比 economically 更带道德与清苦色彩。

entries.definition: in a way that gives good value for money. It is an evaluated comparison, while economically may simply describe the axis.
entries.definitionCN: 以合算的方式。它是经过评估的比较，而 economically 可能只是说明维度。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: economically is economic plus -ally, i.e. -al plus -ly, the ordinary adverb pattern.
normal.cn: economically 是 economic 加 -ally，也就是 -al 加 -ly，普通副词构词法。

normal.en: It has two jobs because the family has two adjectives: economic 'of the economy', economical 'thrifty'.
normal.cn: 它有两份工作，因为这一族有两个形容词：economic“经济的”、economical“节约的”。

normal.en: oikos 'house' plus nomos 'manage' means 'in household-management terms', whether the household is a family or a nation.
normal.cn: oikos“房屋”加 nomos“管理”，意为“按家务管理的说法”，无论这户人家是家庭还是国家。

normal.en: Economically active counts paid work only; housework is outside the statistic.
normal.cn: economically active 只计有偿工作；家务在这一统计之外。

normal.en: nominally is not related: nomen is 'name', nomos is 'law, managing'.
normal.cn: nominally 与它无关：nomen 是“名字”，nomos 是“法则、管理”。

abstract.en: Picture a shopper holding a discount bag and a ledger: two ways of watching the same money.
abstract.cn: 想象一位顾客一手提着打折菜、一手拿着账本：两种盯住同一笔钱的方式。

abstract.en: The same adverb measures a household, a region, an engine, a mine, a student, a worker, and a dependent adult.
abstract.cn: 同一个副词可以衡量一个家庭、一个地区、一台发动机、一座矿、一名学生、一位劳动者、一个受赡养的成年人。

abstract.en: Every sense asks which ledger is open: spending, output, price, resources, or dependence.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：翻开的是哪一本账——支出、产出、价格、资源，还是依赖关系。

examples.en: The factory now runs more economically than it did last year.
examples.cn: 这家工厂现在比去年运行得更省。

examples.en: The province is economically dependent on one crop.
examples.cn: 该省在经济上依赖单一作物。

examples.en: Economically, the proposal makes sense; politically, it does not.
examples.cn: 从经济上看，这个提案说得通；从政治上看则不然。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口弄米扣利」——一口锅弄米还扣着利，处处算得省 → economically 在经济上、节约地

root: 希腊语 oikonomikos“善于持家”＝oikos“房屋”＋nomos“管理”；经拉丁语 oeconomicus 入英语作 economic，加 -ally（-al＋-ly）成 economically。核心是“按一本账来衡量或行事”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses point at a ledger. What changes is which ledger — the household's spending, the region's output, a project's cost, a machine's resources, a firm's viability, a student's income, the labour force, or a dependent's support.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都指向一本账。变化的只是哪一本账——家庭支出、地区产出、项目成本、机器资源、企业可行性、学生收入、劳动力、被赡养者的生活来源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shopper with a discount bag in one hand and a ledger in the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：一位顾客一手提着特价菜，一手拿着账本。

branches.en: MANNER: the adverb describes how money or energy is spent — carefully, with little waste.
branches.cn: 方式：这个副词描述钱或能量如何被花——谨慎地、少浪费地。

branches.en: VIEWPOINT: the adverb names the lens or axis — economic terms, cost terms — rather than a manner.
branches.cn: 视角：这个副词命名镜头或维度——经济口径、成本口径——而不是方式。

branches.en: VIABILITY: at firm scale, 'economically' means costs can be covered.
branches.cn: 可行性：在企业尺度上，economically 意为成本能被覆盖。

branches.en: SOCIAL AXES: disadvantage and dependence are located on the economic axis, not described as behaviour.
branches.cn: 社会维度：弱势与依赖被定位在经济这一轴上，而不是被描述为行为。

branches.en: STATISTICAL BOUNDARY: 'economically active' marks paid work as the edge of the measure.
branches.cn: 统计边界：economically active 把有偿工作标为该测量的边界。

intro.en: Economically is economic plus -ally. The ending is -al (adjective, Latin -alis) plus -ly (adverb, Old English -līce); it is not a single suffix '-ally'.
intro.cn: economically 是 economic 加 -ally。词尾是 -al（形容词后缀，拉丁语 -alis）加 -ly（副词后缀，古英语 -līce），并非单一的 -ally 后缀。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek oikonomia through oikonomikos and Latin oeconomicus: oikos 'house' plus nomos 'managing'. The adverb inherits both the economic-science and thrift branches.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是经 oikonomikos 与拉丁语 oeconomicus 而来的希腊语 oikonomia：oikos“房屋”加 nomos“管理”。副词继承“经济科学”与“节俭”两条分支。

items.meaning: in economic terms, or without waste
items.meaningCN: 在经济上；节约地（-al＋-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The mill is economically marginal.
items.exampleCN: 这家磨坊在经济上处于边缘。

items.meaning: of the economy or economics
items.meaningCN: 经济的；经济学的
items.example: Economic policy shapes household budgets.
items.exampleCN: 经济政策塑造家庭预算。

items.meaning: thrifty, avoiding waste
items.meaningCN: 节约的；不浪费的
items.example: An economical lamp uses less power.
items.exampleCN: 省电的灯耗电更少。

items.meaning: the system of production and consumption; thrift
items.meaningCN: 经济体系；节约
items.example: The economy grew by two percent.
items.exampleCN: 经济增长了百分之二。

items.meaning: to spend or use less
items.meaningCN: 节省；节约使用
items.example: We must economize on water this summer.
items.exampleCN: 今年夏天我们必须节约用水。

items.meaning: one who studies the economy
items.meaningCN: 经济学家
items.example: The economist warned of inflation.
items.exampleCN: 这位经济学家警告通胀风险。

items.meaning: in ecological terms
items.meaningCN: 在生态上（同 oikos 词基的平行副词）
items.example: The marsh is ecologically valuable.
items.exampleCN: 这片沼泽在生态上很有价值。

items.meaning: independently, by self-rule
items.meaningCN: 自主地；自治地（nomos 指法则）
items.example: The unit operates autonomously.
items.exampleCN: 该单位自主运作。

items.meaning: in name only, by stated value
items.meaningCN: 名义上地（词根为 nomen“名字”，与本词无关）
items.example: He is nominally in charge.
items.exampleCN: 他名义上负责。

items.meaning: fundamentally, in essentials
items.meaningCN: 基本上（同样是 -al＋-ly 结构）
items.example: The two plans are basically the same.
items.exampleCN: 这两个方案基本相同。

latinEntries.meaningCN: economic 所本的拉丁语形容词

definition_zh: 生态系统；群落与其环境构成的整体；某一类生态系统（如森林）；生态系统服务；商业或创新生态圈；数字平台生态；生态系统的健康与韧性；生态系统的崩溃与退化
definition_en: a community of organisms together with its physical environment, considered as one functioning unit; by extension, any interdependent system of actors and resources
core_image: 一片林子里，树、菌根、溪水、昆虫和腐叶被画进同一个循环箭头
scene: In one patch of woodland, trees, root fungi, the stream, insects and leaf litter all sit inside the same circle of arrows. That circle of arrows is the ecosystem of the wood.
sceneCN: 这里 ecosystem 是「生物群落与环境构成的整体」（第 1 个义项：生态系统）；句意：那片林地里，树木、根菌、溪水、昆虫与落叶构成一个生态系统，被画进同一个循环箭头。图中可辨识物件：树木、菌根、溪流、昆虫、腐叶层、循环箭头。

pos.zh: 生态系统；相互依存的系统（商业、数字等）

collocations.zh: 生态系统服务（自然为人类提供的益处）

derivatives.zh: 生态系统的；系统层面的

senses.title: The ecological unit: life plus setting as one system
senses.titleCN: 生态单元：生物加环境构成一个系统
senses.definition: a community of organisms and its non-living surroundings interacting as a functional whole
senses.definitionCN: 生物群落与其非生物环境相互作用而形成的一个功能整体
senses.example: A pond is an ecosystem because its water, soil, plants and animals exchange materials.
senses.exampleCN: 池塘是一个生态系统，因为它的水、土、植物和动物在不断交换物质。
senses.why: Ecosystem is ecology plus system, coined in 1935 by A.G. Tansley. The compound insists that organisms and setting be treated as one unit, not as a list of species on a map.
senses.whyCN: ecosystem 是 ecology 加 system，由 A.G. 坦斯利于 1935 年造出。这个复合词坚持把生物与环境当作一个整体，而不是地图上的一份物种清单。

senses.title: A named type: forest, lake, or grassland
senses.titleCN: 被命名的类型：森林、湖泊或草原
senses.definition: a particular class of such units, identified by its dominant vegetation, water, or climate
senses.definitionCN: 按优势植被、水体或气候区分出的一类此类单元
senses.example: Mangrove ecosystems buffer the coast against storms.
senses.exampleCN: 红树林生态系统为海岸缓冲风暴。
senses.why: Once the unit is defined, it can be sorted into types. The modifier names the dominant structure, not a different concept; a forest ecosystem is still one web.
senses.whyCN: 单元一旦被定义，就能被分类。修饰语命名的是优势结构，而不是另一个概念；森林生态系统仍然是同一张网。

senses.title: Ecosystem services: what the system gives people
senses.titleCN: 生态系统服务：系统给人类的东西
senses.definition: the benefits people obtain from ecosystems, such as clean water, pollination, and flood control
senses.definitionCN: 人从生态系统获得的益处，如净水、授粉与防洪
senses.example: The wetland's ecosystem services are worth more than the land it occupies.
senses.exampleCN: 这片湿地的生态系统服务价值高于它所占的土地。
senses.why: Economics re-entered the term in the 1990s: a functioning ecosystem supplies services that would otherwise need costly engineering. The web is now also a budget.
senses.whyCN: 经济学在 1990 年代重新进入这个术语：一个运作良好的生态系统提供那些否则需昂贵工程才能替代的服务。这张网现在也是一本预算。

senses.title: A business ecosystem: firms growing around one platform
senses.titleCN: 商业生态圈：围绕一个平台生长的企业群
senses.definition: a network of companies, suppliers, and customers that co-evolve around a core product or platform
senses.definitionCN: 围绕核心产品或平台共同演化的公司、供应商与顾客网络
senses.example: The phone maker built an ecosystem of apps and repair shops.
senses.exampleCN: 这家手机厂商建立了一个由应用与维修店组成的生态圈。
senses.why: The metaphor took off in management writing in the 1990s: firms occupy niches, depend on partners, and can drive each other extinct. Structure is borrowed, organisms are not.
senses.whyCN: 这个隐喻在 1990 年代的管理写作中兴起：企业占据生态位、依赖伙伴，也能互相导致灭绝。借的是结构，不是生物。

senses.title: A digital ecosystem: devices, data, and users
senses.titleCN: 数字生态：设备、数据与用户
senses.definition: the linked set of hardware, software, data, and users that function together on a platform
senses.definitionCN: 在一个平台上共同运作的硬件、软件、数据与用户所构成的关联整体
senses.example: The update spread through the whole digital ecosystem in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这次更新一周内传遍整个数字生态。
senses.why: Digital ecosystems have flows, dependencies, and single points of failure, much like a food web. The word is attractive precisely because a technical system can be described as a habitat.
senses.whyCN: 数字生态有流动、依赖与单点失效，很像食物网。这个词之所以好用，正是因为技术系统可以被描述成一种生境。

senses.title: Health and resilience: whether the system holds
senses.titleCN: 健康与韧性：系统撑不撑得住
senses.definition: the condition of an ecosystem in terms of function, stability, and capacity to recover
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统在功能、稳定性与恢复能力方面的状况
senses.example: Monitoring tracks ecosystem health through insect diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 监测通过昆虫多样性追踪生态系统健康。
senses.why: Because the unit has a working order, it can be judged healthy or sick. Resilience adds the question of recovery time, which a species list cannot answer.
senses.whyCN: 因为单元有运作秩序，就可以被判断为健康或生病。韧性再加上恢复时间的问题，而这靠物种清单回答不了。

senses.title: The ecosystem approach: managing people and nature together
senses.titleCN: 生态系统方法：把人与自然的治理放在一起
senses.definition: a management strategy that plans for the whole system rather than for single species or uses
senses.definitionCN: 以整个系统而非单一物种或用途为规划对象的管理策略
senses.example: The ecosystem approach includes fishing families in the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 生态系统方法把渔民家庭纳入规划。
senses.why: Management language converts the concept into a procedure: if everything is connected, a rule for one part must be checked against the whole. The noun becomes a principle of governance.
senses.whyCN: 管理语言把这个概念变成程序：既然万物相连，对某一部分的规定就必须放到整体中检验。这个名词成了治理原则。

senses.title: Collapse: the system losing its structure
senses.titleCN: 崩溃：系统失去结构
senses.definition: the abrupt loss of an ecosystem's structure and functions beyond a point of recovery
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统结构与功能急剧丧失、越过不可恢复的临界点
senses.example: The reef passed a threshold and suffered ecosystem collapse.
senses.exampleCN: 这片礁越过了临界点，发生了生态系统崩溃。
senses.why: A system can fail as a whole even when some species remain. Collapse names that level of failure, which is why the concept is used in policy as well as in ecology.
senses.whyCN: 即使还有些物种残留，一个系统也可能整体失效。崩溃命名的正是这一层面的失败，因此这个概念同时用于政策与生态学。

intro.en: Ecosystem is a 20th-century compound of ecology and system, coined by the British ecologist Arthur Tansley in 1935. It is not a Latin word and has no classical antecedent. system comes from Greek systema 'organized whole', from syn- 'together' plus histanai 'to set up'.
intro.cn: ecosystem 是 20 世纪由 ecology 与 system 构成的复合词，一般认为由英国生态学家阿瑟·坦斯利于 1935 年造出。它不是拉丁词，也没有古典先例。system 出自希腊语 systema“有组织的整体”，由 syn-“共同”加 histanai“安置”构成。

items.en: Business and digital ecosystems borrow the term, and ecosystem services becomes a standard phrase in environmental economics.
items.cn: 商业与数字生态借用这个词，ecosystem services 成为环境经济学的标准说法。

items.en: Tansley proposes ecosystem for the whole unit of organisms plus environment, arguing that ecology must think at the level of the system.
items.cn: 坦斯利提出 ecosystem，指生物加环境的整体单元，主张生态学必须在系统层面思考。

items.en: The word appears in the context of British plant ecology, where 'system' was already used for a whole community.
items.cn: 这个词出现在英国植物生态学的语境中，那里已经用“系统”指整个群落。

items.en: systema 'organized whole' joins syn- 'together' with histanai 'to set up, stand'. Ecology supplies the first half from oikos 'house' plus -logia 'study'.
items.cn: systema“有组织的整体”把 syn-“共同”与 histanai“安置、站立”结合起来。ecology 提供前半，来自 oikos“房屋”加 -logia“研究”。

items.en: The compound is unusual in joining a science name to an object name: the ecosystem is what ecology studies. That is why 'ecosystem' names a thing, while 'ecology' names both a science and its subject.
items.cn: 这个复合词特别在于把学科名接到对象名上：生态系统是生态学所研究的东西。这正是 ecosystem 指“物”，而 ecology 同时指学科与对象的原因。

note.en: The first group separates the parent discipline, a shared-oikos relative, and a genuine different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分母学科、一个共享 oikos 的同源词和一个真正不同词根的邻近词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the science of organisms and environments. Ecology studies ecosystems; the ecosystem is the object, not the study.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物与环境的科学。生态学研究生态系统；生态系统是对象，不是学科。

entries.definition: the system of production and consumption. It shares oikos 'house' but joins it to nomos 'managing'.
entries.definitionCN: 生产与消费体系。它与 ecosystem 共享 oikos“房屋”，但接的是 nomos“管理”。

entries.definition: affecting the whole body or whole system. It comes from the same Greek systema, but in medicine it means 'throughout the organism'.
entries.definitionCN: 影响整个身体或整个系统的。它同出希腊语 systema，但在医学中指“遍及整个机体”。

entries.definition: a large region defined by climate and dominant vegetation. It is broader than an ecosystem and may contain many of them.
entries.definitionCN: 按气候与优势植被划定的大区域。它比生态系统更大，可包含许多生态系统。

entries.definition: the place where a particular organism lives. It is narrower and species-centred, where ecosystem includes the whole community.
entries.definitionCN: 某一生物居住的地方。它更窄、以物种为中心，而生态系统包含整个群落。

entries.definition: the interacting organisms in an area, without the physical setting. Ecosystem adds soil, water, and climate to the community.
entries.definitionCN: 某区域内相互作用的生物，不含物理环境。生态系统在群落之上加上土壤、水与气候。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ecosystem = ecology + system: the object that ecology studies.
normal.cn: ecosystem ＝ ecology ＋ system：生态学所研究的那个对象。

normal.en: Tansley coined it in 1935, so the word is younger than the science of ecology by about seventy years.
normal.cn: 坦斯利在 1935 年造出这个词，所以它比生态学这门科学晚了约七十年。

normal.en: system comes from Greek systema, syn- 'together' plus histanai 'set up' — parts set up together.
normal.cn: system 出自希腊语 systema，syn-“共同”加 histanai“安置”——把各部分立在一起。

normal.en: A community is only the living part; an ecosystem adds water, soil, air and light.
normal.cn: 群落只是“活的部分”；生态系统还要加上水、土、空气与光。

normal.en: Business ecosystem is a metaphor: niches and extinction, but no soil.
normal.cn: 商业生态圈是隐喻：有生态位与灭绝，却没有土壤。

abstract.en: Picture a woodland drawn as a circle of arrows: leaf to soil, soil to root, root to tree, tree to insect, insect back to leaf.
abstract.cn: 想象一片林地被画成一圈箭头：落叶到土壤，土壤到根，根到树，树到昆虫，昆虫再回到落叶。

abstract.en: The same circle becomes a service budget, a company network, a device platform, a health report, a management rule, and a collapse threshold.
abstract.cn: 同一个循环可以变成服务预算、公司网络、设备平台、健康报告、管理规则与崩溃阈值。

abstract.en: Every sense asks what is inside the circle and what happens when one arrow breaks.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：圈里有什么，以及当一支箭头断掉时会发生什么。

examples.en: The salt marsh is a single ecosystem linking tide, mud and grass.
examples.cn: 这片盐沼是一个把潮水、泥滩与草连结起来的单一生态系统。

examples.en: Pollinators are an ecosystem service that farmers rarely pay for.
examples.cn: 传粉者是一项农民很少付费的生态系统服务。

examples.en: The startup joined a wider ecosystem of suppliers and app makers.
examples.cn: 这家初创公司加入了由供应商与应用开发者构成的更大生态圈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一口细思疼」——一口水一口土细细想来都牵一发动全身 → ecosystem 生态系统

root: ecology（希腊语 oikos“房屋”＋-logia“研究”）＋system（希腊语 systema“有组织的整体”，syn-“共同”＋histanai“安置”），1935 年由坦斯利造出。核心是“把生物与环境当成一部共同运转的整体机器”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one circle of arrows. What changes is the scale or the use: a pond, a type of habitat, a service budget, a firm network, a platform, a health report, a management rule, or the moment the circle breaks.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一圈箭头。变化的是尺度或用途：一个池塘、一类生境、一份服务预算、一张企业网络、一个平台、一份健康报告、一条管理规则，或圆圈断裂的那一刻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a woodland drawn as one circle of arrows linking leaf, soil, root, tree and insect.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片林地被画成一圈箭头，把落叶、土壤、根、树与昆虫连在一起。

branches.en: THE UNIT AND ITS TYPES: first the whole is defined, then it is sorted by dominant vegetation or water.
branches.cn: 单元及其类型：先定义整体，再按优势植被或水体分类。

branches.en: BENEFITS: the functioning web is converted into services that can be valued and paid for.
branches.cn: 益处：运作中的网被换算成可估值、可付费的服务。

branches.en: BORROWED STRUCTURE: firms and devices occupy niches and depend on partners, borrowing the web without the biology.
branches.cn: 借来的结构：企业与设备占据生态位、依赖伙伴，借用了网，却不带生物。

branches.en: CONDITION: a working unit can be judged healthy, stressed, or resilient, which a species list cannot express.
branches.cn: 状况：运作中的单元可以被判定为健康、受压或具韧性，而这靠物种清单表达不了。

branches.en: GOVERNANCE AND FAILURE: if all is connected, rules must consider the whole, and failure can occur at the level of the whole.
branches.cn: 治理与失效：既然万物相连，规则就必须考虑整体，而失效也可能发生在整体层面。

intro.en: Ecosystem is a compound of ecology and system, not an affixed Latin word. Both halves are productive: eco- from Greek oikos and system from Greek systema. The compound was coined whole in 1935.
intro.cn: ecosystem 是 ecology 与 system 的复合词，不是加缀的拉丁词。两半都能产：eco- 出自希腊语 oikos，system 出自希腊语 systema。这个复合词于 1935 年整体造出。

latinIntro.en: The Greek elements are oikos 'house' and -logia 'study' for the first half, and syn- 'together' plus histanai 'set up' for systema.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊成分方面，前半是 oikos“房屋”与 -logia“研究”；systema 则是 syn-“共同”与 histanai“安置”。

items.meaning: organisms and environment as one working whole
items.meaningCN: 生物与环境构成的运作整体
items.example: Each lake is a separate ecosystem.
items.exampleCN: 每个湖都是独立的生态系统。

items.meaning: the science of organism-environment relations
items.meaningCN: 研究生物—环境关系的科学
items.example: Ecology supplies the concepts used to describe ecosystems.
items.exampleCN: 生态学提供描述生态系统的概念。

items.meaning: an organized whole of interdependent parts
items.meaningCN: 由相互依存部分构成的有组织整体
items.example: The river system drains three provinces.
items.exampleCN: 这条河系统横跨三个省。

items.meaning: proceeding according to a plan
items.meaningCN: 系统的；有条理的
items.example: They made a systematic survey of the reef.
items.exampleCN: 他们对这片礁做了系统调查。

items.meaning: affecting the whole, especially of the body
items.meaningCN: 全身的；整个系统的
items.example: The infection became systemic.
items.exampleCN: 感染变成了全身性的。

items.meaning: relating to ecosystems as wholes
items.meaningCN: 生态系统的；系统层面的
items.example: The problem needs an ecosystemic view.
items.exampleCN: 这个问题需要系统层面的视角。

items.meaning: an agricultural area treated as an ecosystem
items.meaningCN: 被当作生态系统看待的农业区域
items.example: The rice field is a managed agroecosystem.
items.exampleCN: 稻田是一个被管理的农业生态系统。

items.meaning: a very small self-contained ecosystem
items.meaningCN: 极小尺度的自足生态系统
items.example: A tree hole can be a microecosystem.
items.exampleCN: 一个树洞可以成为微型生态系统。

items.meaning: a system that forms part of a larger one
items.meaningCN: 更大系统中的一个子系统
items.example: Each subsystem has its own feedback.
items.exampleCN: 每个子系统都有自己的反馈。

items.meaning: the place where an organism lives
items.meaningCN: 栖息地（生态系统的一部分）
items.example: The reed bed is prime habitat for frogs.
items.exampleCN: 芦苇丛是蛙类的理想栖息地。

definition_zh: 教育的；与教育相关的；有教育意义的；用于教学的；教育机构的；受教育程度的；教育技术的；教育心理与教育不平等的
definition_en: relating to education or to teaching, or serving to instruct and improve knowledge
core_image: 一位老师在黑板上把一道线拉长，学生顺着这条线自己走到了没教过的地方
scene: The teacher extends a line across the board, and the students follow it into ground she has not yet taught. Walking students into ground she has not taught is her most educational move.
sceneCN: 这里 educational 是「有教育意义的、能教人的」（第 2 个义项：有教育意义的）；句意：老师把线延长到尚未讲过的地方，让学生顺着走进去，这是最有教育意义的做法。图中可辨识物件：黑板、延长的粉笔线、学生的手、未擦净的旧字、打开的课本。

pos.zh: 教育的；教育性的；有教育意义的

senses.title: Of education: belonging to the institution
senses.titleCN: 教育的：属于教育制度的
senses.definition: relating to the system, institutions, or process of education
senses.definitionCN: 与教育制度、机构或过程相关的
senses.example: The country spends a small share of its budget on educational infrastructure.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家把预算中很小的一部分用于教育基础设施。
senses.why: Educational is education plus -al. Education comes from Latin educatio 'a rearing, training', from educare 'bring up'. The adjective simply marks what belongs to that process.
senses.whyCN: educational 是 education 加 -al。education 出自拉丁语 educatio“养育、培养”，源于 educare“抚养”。这个形容词只是标记“属于这一过程的东西”。

senses.title: Instructive: able to teach something
senses.titleCN: 有教育意义的：能教给人东西
senses.definition: providing knowledge or moral improvement, often outside a classroom
senses.definitionCN: 提供知识或道德提升，且常发生在课堂之外
senses.example: The failure was more educational than the lecture.
senses.exampleCN: 这次失败比那堂课更有教育意义。
senses.why: Here -al shifts from 'belonging to education' to 'having the effect of teaching'. A museum, a mistake, or a game can be educational without being part of a school.
senses.whyCN: 这里 -al 从“属于教育”转为“具有教导效果”。博物馆、一次失误、一个游戏都可以是 educational，而不属于学校。

senses.title: For teaching: materials made to instruct
senses.titleCN: 用于教学：为教而造的材料
senses.definition: designed or used for teaching, as in educational books, games, or software
senses.definitionCN: 为教学而设计或使用的，如教育书籍、游戏或软件
senses.example: The app was marketed as educational but taught little.
senses.exampleCN: 这款应用以教育为卖点，却几乎没教什么。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a market category: educational toys promise instruction as a product feature. The word now describes intent rather than result.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词成了市场类别：教育玩具把“教导”当作产品卖点。此时它描述“意图”，而非“结果”。

senses.title: Of attainment: how far schooling went
senses.titleCN: 受教育程度：上到哪一级
senses.definition: concerning the level of schooling a person or group has completed
senses.definitionCN: 关于个人或群体完成的教育层级
senses.example: Educational attainment predicts income more strongly than birthplace.
senses.exampleCN: 受教育程度对收入的预测力比出生地更强。
senses.why: Statistics turns a process into a level. 'Educational attainment' counts years and certificates, which is a measurable proxy for what the process gave.
senses.whyCN: 统计把过程变成一个层级。“受教育程度”计年数与证书，作为该过程所给之物的可测代理。

senses.title: Of technology: tools built for learning
senses.titleCN: 教育技术的：为学习而造的工具
senses.definition: relating to digital or mechanical tools used to support teaching and learning
senses.definitionCN: 与支持教与学的数字或机械工具相关的
senses.example: Educational technology promised personalisation and delivered screens.
senses.exampleCN: 教育技术承诺个性化，交付的却是屏幕。
senses.why: The compound 'educational technology' treats teaching as a field that can be engineered. The adjective keeps its institutional sense but attaches to machines.
senses.whyCN: 复合词 educational technology 把教学当作可被工程化的领域。形容词保持其制度义，却接到了机器上。

senses.title: Of psychology: learning as a subject of study
senses.titleCN: 教育心理的：把学习当作研究对象
senses.definition: concerning the psychological study of learning, motivation, and instruction
senses.definitionCN: 关于学习、动机与教学心理研究的
senses.example: Educational psychology studies how feedback changes retention.
senses.exampleCN: 教育心理学研究反馈如何改变记忆保持。
senses.why: A discipline name built on the adjective means 'the psychology of education'. The word marks the application of one field to the concerns of another.
senses.whyCN: 以这个形容词构成的学科名，意为“教育过程的心理学”。这个词标记一个领域对另一个领域的应用。

senses.title: Of inequality: gaps in what schooling delivers
senses.titleCN: 教育不平等的： schooling 所给之物的差距
senses.definition: concerning differences in access, resources, or outcomes among groups
senses.definitionCN: 关于不同群体在入学机会、资源或结果上的差异
senses.example: Educational inequality persists even when funding is equalised.
senses.exampleCN: 即使经费拉平，教育不平等依然存在。
senses.why: The adjective allows policy to name the arena of a gap without naming its cause. 'Educational inequality' locates the difference in outcomes, not in genes or income.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词让政策能说出差距所在的场域，而不必说出原因。“教育不平等”把差异定位在结果上，而不在基因或收入上。

senses.title: Of value: what a thing teaches
senses.titleCN: 教育价值：一物能教什么
senses.definition: the worth of an experience or object measured by what it teaches
senses.definitionCN: 按“能教什么”来衡量一段经历或一个物件的价值
senses.example: The documentary's educational value outweighed its inaccuracies.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片的教益超过了它的失实之处。
senses.why: Value language asks for a return: what did the learner get? Educational value is the pedagogy of an object, whether or not anyone planned it.
senses.whyCN: 价值语言要求回报：学习者得到了什么？教育价值就是一个物件的“教学性”，无论是否有人刻意设计。

intro.en: Educational is education plus -al. Education entered English in the 16th century from Latin educatio 'a rearing, training', from educare 'bring up, rear'. educare is related to educere 'lead out', and the old 'drawing out' idea is often mentioned, though the direct source is educare rather than educere.
intro.cn: educational 是 education 加 -al。education 于 16 世纪经拉丁语 educatio“养育、培养”进入英语，源于 educare“抚养、培育”。educare 与 educere“引出”相关，“把潜能引出来”的旧说常被提及，但直接来源是 educare，而非 educere。

items.en: Educational psychology, educational technology and educational inequality become established compound terms in research and policy.
items.cn: 教育心理学、教育技术、教育不平等成为研究与政策中的固定复合术语。

items.en: Educational is recorded as the adjective of education; the dating is approximate.
items.cn: educational 作为 education 的形容词见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Education is borrowed from Latin educatio, naming the rearing and training of a child.
items.cn: education 借自拉丁语 educatio，指对儿童的养育与培养。

items.en: educare 'bring up, rear' and educere 'lead out' are related but not identical: educare is frequentative in form, suggesting repeated care, while educere stresses leading forth.
items.cn: educare“抚养、培育”与 educere“引出”相关但不相同：educare 形式上有反复意味，暗示持续的照料；educere 则强调“引出”。

items.en: ducere 'to lead' comes from PIE *deuk- 'to lead'. The same root gives duct, conduct, introduce and produce, all involving leading or bringing.
items.cn: ducere“引导”出自原始印欧语 *deuk-“引导”（重构形式）。同一词根给出 duct、conduct、introduce、produce，都含“引、带”之意。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives from two genuine different-root neighbours; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与两个不同词根的撞形词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: a version of a published work. It comes from edere 'give out', from ex- plus dare 'give', not from educare 'rear'.
entries.definitionCN: 出版物的一种版本。它出自 edere“给出”，即 ex- 加 dare“给”，与 educare“养育”无关。

entries.definition: a large building. It comes from aedes 'building' plus facere 'make', with no connection to education.
entries.definitionCN: 大型建筑物。它出自 aedes“建筑”加 facere“制造”，与 education 无关。

entries.definition: the verb behind education, from educare. It is the source relation, not a look-alike.
entries.definitionCN: education 背后的动词，出自 educare。它是来源关系，不是撞形词。

entries.definition: giving useful information or a moral lesson. It is close to educational in sense 02, but stresses the lesson delivered.
entries.definitionCN: 提供有用信息或道德教训的。它与 educational 第 02 义接近，但强调所传递的教训。

entries.definition: relating to formal study at schools or universities. It is narrower than educational and often contrasts with practical.
entries.definitionCN: 与学校或大学的正式学习相关的。它比 educational 窄，且常与 practical 相对。

entries.definition: relating to teaching methods. It is more technical than educational and focuses on how, not what or where.
entries.definitionCN: 与教学方法相关的。它比 educational 更技术化，关注“怎么教”，而不是教什么、在哪里教。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: educational is education plus -al, the same pattern as national and personal.
normal.cn: educational 是 education 加 -al，和 national、personal 一样。

normal.en: The root educare 'rear' is related to educere 'lead out': teaching as leading someone out of where they were.
normal.cn: 词根 educare“养育”与 educere“引出”相关：教学就是把一个人从原处引出来。

normal.en: ducere 'lead' also gives conduct, introduce and produce.
normal.cn: ducere“引导”还给出 conduct、introduce、produce。

normal.en: edition and edifice look like education but belong to dare 'give' and facere 'make'.
normal.cn: edition 与 edifice 看着像 education，却分属 dare“给”与 facere“造”。

normal.en: A museum can be educational without being educational in the institutional sense.
normal.cn: 一座博物馆可以是 educational（有教益），却不必是制度意义上的 educational。

abstract.en: Picture a line on a blackboard extended past the lesson, and a student walking along it.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上一条线被延长到课程之外，一名学生沿着它走。

abstract.en: The same line appears as a system, an attainment level, a toy, a technology, a psychology, an inequality, and a value.
abstract.cn: 同一条线可以显形为制度、受教育程度、玩具、技术、心理学、不平等与价值。

abstract.en: Every sense asks who is being led, and how far past the lesson they go.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：被引领的是谁，又比课程多走了多远。

examples.en: The museum runs educational programmes for local schools.
examples.cn: 这家博物馆为当地学校开设教育项目。

examples.en: The game is educational without feeling like homework.
examples.cn: 这个游戏有教育意义，却不像作业。

examples.en: Educational attainment varies widely across the region.
examples.cn: 该地区的受教育程度差异很大。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱就开心脑」——爱学习就开心动脑，越学越有教益 → educational 教育的、有教育意义的

root: 拉丁语 educatio“养育、培养”＝educare“抚养、培育”＋-atio（动作名词后缀）；educare 与 educere“引出”相关，后者＝ex-“出”＋ducere“引导”。educational＝education＋-al（形容词后缀）。核心是“把人从原处引出来”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: a line drawn past the lesson. What changes is whether the line is an institution, an effect, a product, a level, a tool, a research field, a gap, or a value.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一条画到课程之外的线。变化的只是这条线是制度、效果、产品、层级、工具、研究领域、差距，还是价值。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a teacher extends a chalk line past what has been taught, and students follow it.
core.cn: 核心意象：老师把粉笔线延长到已教内容之外，学生顺着走。

branches.en: INSTITUTION AND EFFECT: first the adjective marks what belongs to schooling, then what teaches outside it.
branches.cn: 制度与效果：形容词先标记属于学校教育的东西，再标记在校外教人的东西。

branches.en: MATERIALS: intent is built into toys and software, so the word describes design rather than result.
branches.cn: 材料：意图被做进玩具与软件，于是这个词描述设计而非结果。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT: the process is converted into years and certificates, a level that can be compared.
branches.cn: 测量：过程被换算成年数与证书，成为可比较的层级。

branches.en: A FIELD OF STUDY: one discipline applies itself to education, producing educational psychology.
branches.cn: 研究领域：一门学科把自身应用于教育，产生教育心理学。

branches.en: VALUE AND GAP: the same line lets policy locate inequality and lets critics ask what an object teaches.
branches.cn: 价值与差距：同一条线让政策定位不平等，也让批评者追问一物教了什么。

intro.en: Educational is education plus -al. The suffix -al, from Latin -alis, forms relational adjectives; English first borrowed education, then added the adjective ending.
intro.cn: educational 是 education 加 -al。后缀 -al 出自拉丁语 -alis，构成关系形容词；英语先借入 education，再加形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The base verb is educare 'bring up, rear', related to educere 'lead out' (ex- 'out' plus ducere 'lead'). ducere supplies duct-, visible in conduct, introduce and produce.
latinIntro.cn: 词基动词是 educare“抚养、培育”，与 educere“引出”（ex-“出”＋ducere“引导”）相关。ducere 提供 duct- 词干，见于 conduct、introduce、produce。

items.meaning: relating to education, or serving to teach
items.meaningCN: 与教育相关的；有教益的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The trip had real educational value.
items.exampleCN: 这次旅行有真正的教益。

items.meaning: the process of rearing and teaching
items.meaningCN: 养育与教学的过程（-ion 构成动作名词）
items.example: Education begins long before school.
items.exampleCN: 教育在学校之前很久就开始了。

items.meaning: to teach and bring up
items.meaningCN: 教育；培养
items.example: They educated their children at home.
items.exampleCN: 他们在家教育孩子。

items.meaning: one who educates
items.meaningCN: 教育者（-or 表示施动者）
items.example: The educator designed the curriculum.
items.exampleCN: 这位教育者设计了课程。

items.meaning: in educational terms
items.meaningCN: 在教育上
items.example: The two districts are educationally unequal.
items.exampleCN: 这两个学区在教育上并不平等。

items.meaning: one who studies or promotes education
items.meaningCN: 教育学家；教育改革推动者
items.example: The educationalist argued for smaller classes.
items.exampleCN: 这位教育学家主张缩小班级规模。

items.meaning: having the power to teach or improve
items.meaningCN: 有教育作用的；能起教化作用的
items.example: The experience was educative rather than pleasant.
items.exampleCN: 这段经历与其说愉快，不如说有教益。

items.meaning: capable of being educated
items.meaningCN: 可教育的；有学习能力的
items.example: The test measured whether the child was educable.
items.exampleCN: 这项测试测量这个孩子是否具备受教育能力。

items.meaning: teaching both sexes together
items.meaningCN: 男女同校的（co- 表示“共同”）
items.example: The college became coeducational in 1970.
items.exampleCN: 这所学院于 1970 年改为男女同校。

items.meaning: to draw out something latent
items.meaningCN: 引出（潜能等）；推断出
items.example: Good questions educe what students already suspect.
items.exampleCN: 好问题能引出学生已有的猜想。

latinEntries.meaning: a rearing, training; the source of education
latinEntries.meaningCN: 养育、培养；education 所本的拉丁动作名词

definition_zh: 有效性；效力；成效；治疗效果；组织或政策的实效；说服力；成本效益中的效益面；教学效果；与效率相区分的“做对事”能力
definition_en: the degree to which something produces the intended result, especially in real conditions rather than under ideal ones
core_image: 一支箭正中标靶的圆心，而旁边另一支箭虽飞得极快却落在靶外
scene: One arrow strikes the centre of the target, while a faster arrow lands outside the ring. The arrow in the centre shows the effectiveness of the shot, not its speed.
sceneCN: 这里 effectiveness 是「产生预期结果的能力」（第 1 个义项：有效性）；句意：正中靶心的那支箭体现的是这次射击的有效性，而不是速度。图中可辨识物件：靶心、插在中心的箭、落在环外的箭、拉满的弓、风速标。

collocations.zh: 效力与实效（理想条件对真实条件）

derivatives.zh: 效力（尤指药物或治疗的）

senses.title: Producing the intended result: the arrow hits
senses.titleCN: 产生预期结果：箭中了
senses.definition: the degree to which an action or thing achieves the result it was meant to achieve
senses.definitionCN: 某一行动或事物达成其既定目标的程度
senses.example: Researchers measured the effectiveness of the warning system by counting lives saved.
senses.exampleCN: 研究者通过统计获救人数来衡量这套预警系统的有效性。
senses.why: Effectiveness is effective plus -ness, and effective comes from Latin effectivus 'productive', from efficere 'work out, accomplish'. The noun asks whether the work got done.
senses.whyCN: effectiveness 是 effective 加 -ness，effective 出自拉丁语 effectivus“有产出力的”，源于 efficere“做出、完成”。这个名词问的是“事情有没有做成”。

senses.title: Clinical effectiveness: working in real patients
senses.titleCN: 临床实效：在真实病人身上起作用
senses.definition: the performance of a treatment under ordinary clinical conditions, as distinct from efficacy in trials
senses.definitionCN: 治疗在常规临床条件下的表现，区别于试验中的效力
senses.example: The drug's effectiveness in clinics was lower than its trial efficacy.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药在诊所中的实效低于试验中的效力。
senses.why: Medicine splits efficacy from effectiveness: efficacy is whether it can work under controlled conditions, effectiveness whether it does work in messy ones. The suffix -ness here measures the real world.
senses.whyCN: 医学把效力与实效分开：efficacy 指在受控条件下能否起效，effectiveness 指在混乱的真实条件下是否真的起效。这里的 -ness 量的是真实世界。

senses.title: Organisational effectiveness: the institution delivers
senses.titleCN: 组织实效：机构把事办成
senses.definition: the extent to which an organisation meets its goals and serves its stated purpose
senses.definitionCN: 组织达成目标、实现其既定宗旨的程度
senses.example: The review judged effectiveness by outcomes, not by activity.
senses.exampleCN: 这次评估按结果而非忙碌程度来判断实效。
senses.why: Management theory distinguishes doing the right things from doing things right. Effectiveness is the first; efficiency is the second.
senses.whyCN: 管理理论区分“做对的事”与“把事做对”。effectiveness 是前者，efficiency 是后者。

senses.title: Policy effectiveness: a rule that changes behaviour
senses.titleCN: 政策有效性：能改变行为的规则
senses.definition: the capacity of a policy to alter behaviour or conditions in the direction intended
senses.definitionCN: 政策按预期方向改变行为或状况的能力
senses.example: The tax's effectiveness depended on how easily it could be avoided.
senses.exampleCN: 这项税的有效性取决于它有多容易被规避。
senses.why: A policy can be well designed and still ineffective if actors route around it. The noun measures the gap between the rule on paper and the behaviour on the ground.
senses.whyCN: 一项政策可以设计得很好，却因被绕开而无效。这个名词衡量纸面规则与地面行为之间的落差。

senses.title: Persuasive force: words that move people
senses.titleCN: 说服力：能打动人的话
senses.definition: the power of speech or writing to produce the intended response in an audience
senses.definitionCN: 言语或文字在受众身上产生预期反应的力量
senses.example: The speech's effectiveness lay in what it left unsaid.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇演讲的力量在于它没有说出的部分。
