senses.why: Rhetoric has always asked whether speech achieves its purpose. Here -ness measures impact on hearers, not on machines or cells.
senses.whyCN: 修辞学一直在问言语是否达成目的。这里的 -ness 量的是对听者的影响，而不是对机器或细胞的影响。

senses.title: Cost-effectiveness: result per unit of money
senses.titleCN: 成本效益：每单位钱换来的结果
senses.definition: the ratio of achieved outcomes to the resources spent in achieving them
senses.definitionCN: 所达成结果与为达成它而花费的资源之比
senses.example: The cheaper drug was preferred on cost-effectiveness grounds.
senses.exampleCN: 基于成本效益的考虑，更便宜的那种药被选中。
senses.why: This sense joins effectiveness to a denominator. A treatment can be effective and still not cost-effective; the compound asks how much result each dollar buys.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项给有效性加上分母。一种治疗可以有效，却未必合算；这个复合词问的是每一元钱买到多少结果。

senses.title: Instructional effectiveness: teaching that produces learning
senses.titleCN: 教学效果：教出了学习
senses.definition: the degree to which teaching methods produce measurable learning gains
senses.definitionCN: 教学方法带来可测量学习进步的程度
senses.example: The study compared the effectiveness of lectures and small groups.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究比较了讲座与小组教学的效果。
senses.why: In education the intended result is learning, so effectiveness must be measured by gains, not by satisfaction scores. The word forces a definition of the goal.
senses.whyCN: 在教育中，预期结果是学习，所以有效性必须用进步来测，而不是用满意度。这个词迫使人们定义目标。

senses.title: Effectiveness as a contrast term: right things versus things right
senses.titleCN: 作为对照概念：做对的事与把事做对
senses.definition: the quality of achieving the right goal, conventionally contrasted with efficiency in using resources
senses.definitionCN: 达成正确目标的性质，惯例上与“资源使用效率”相对照
senses.example: The team was efficient at producing a report nobody used: high efficiency, low effectiveness.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队高效地做出了一份没人用的报告：效率高，实效低。
senses.why: Peter Drucker made this pair famous: efficiency is doing things right, effectiveness is doing the right things. The distinction is conceptual, not etymological; both come from efficere.
senses.whyCN: 彼得·德鲁克让这组对照广为人知：efficiency 是把事做对，effectiveness 是做对的事。这一区分是概念性的，不是词源性的；两者都出自 efficere。

intro.en: Effectiveness is effective plus -ness. Effective comes from Latin effectivus 'productive, creative', from effectus, the past participle of efficere 'work out, accomplish', itself ex- 'out' plus facere 'do, make'. The English noun is recorded in the 17th century; the exact date is approximate.
intro.cn: effectiveness 是 effective 加 -ness。effective 出自拉丁语 effectivus“有产出力的、创造的”，源于 effectus——efficere“做出、完成”的过去分词，而 efficere＝ex-“出”＋facere“做、造”。这个英语名词见于 17 世纪，确切年代为大致估计。

items.en: Clinical trials formalise the efficacy/effectiveness split, and management theory pairs effectiveness with efficiency.
items.cn: 临床试验把效力与实效的区分制度化，管理理论则把 effectiveness 与 efficiency 配成一对。

items.en: English effectiveness is recorded, built on effective with the noun suffix -ness.
items.cn: 英语 effectiveness 见于记载，由 effective 加名词后缀 -ness 构成。

items.en: effectivus 'productive' is formed on effectus, the past participle of efficere 'to accomplish'. The -ivus suffix marks a capacity, which is why effective means 'able to produce an effect'.
items.cn: effectivus“有产出力的”由 effectus 构成，即 efficere“完成”的过去分词。-ivus 后缀表示能力，所以 effective 意为“能产生效果的”。

items.en: facere 'to do, make' is generally derived from PIE *dhe- 'to set, put, do'. The same root underlies effect, affect, defect, perfect and manufacture.
items.cn: facere“做、造”一般认为出自原始印欧语 *dhe-“放置、做”（重构形式）。同一词根支撑着 effect、affect、defect、perfect、manufacture。

items.en: Effectiveness and efficiency share efficere but differ in suffix: -ive/-ness stresses the result achieved, -ency stresses the power or ratio of achieving it.
items.cn: effectiveness 与 efficiency 共享 efficere，却在后缀上分开：-ive/-ness 强调达成的结果，-ency 强调达成结果的能力或比率。

note.en: The first group separates two true relatives and one genuine different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分两个真正的同族词和一个不同词根的撞形词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: output achieved per unit of input. It shares efficere with effectiveness but measures the ratio, not the achievement of the goal.
entries.definitionCN: 每单位投入所获得的产出。它与 effectiveness 共享 efficere，但衡量的是比率，而非目标是否达成。

entries.definition: the power to produce a desired effect, especially of a drug under controlled conditions. It is the laboratory twin of effectiveness.
entries.definitionCN: 产生预期效果的能力，尤指药物在受控条件下的效力。它是 effectiveness 的实验室孪生词。

entries.definition: exertion to get something done. It comes from ex- plus fortis 'strong', not from facere 'do'.
entries.definitionCN: 为完成某事付出的气力。它出自 ex- 加 fortis“强壮”，不是 facere“做”。

entries.definition: the accomplishment of an aim. It is the outcome, while effectiveness is the measured capacity that produced it.
entries.definitionCN: 目标的达成。它是结果，而 effectiveness 是产生该结果的可测能力。

entries.definition: a marked effect or influence. It may be unintended, whereas effectiveness is judged against an intended aim.
entries.definitionCN: 显著的作用或影响。它可能是无意的，而 effectiveness 是相对既定目标来评判的。

entries.definition: the quality of being useful. It is broader and often economic, while effectiveness implies a specific purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 有用性。它更宽泛、常带经济色彩，而 effectiveness 暗示一个特定目的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: effectiveness is effective plus -ness, and effective is 'able to produce an effect'.
normal.cn: effectiveness 是 effective 加 -ness，而 effective 就是“能产生效果的”。

normal.en: efficere = ex- 'out' + facere 'do': to do something out into the world.
normal.cn: efficere ＝ ex-“出”＋facere“做”：把事情做出来、做到世上。

normal.en: effectiveness versus efficiency: the first hits the target, the second spends little doing it.
normal.cn: effectiveness 对 efficiency：前者打中靶，后者少花钱。

normal.en: Efficacy is the trial's question, effectiveness the clinic's question.
normal.cn: efficacy 是试验的问题，effectiveness 是诊所的问题。

normal.en: effort looks like effect but comes from fortis 'strong', not facere 'do'.
normal.cn: effort 看着像 effect，却出自 fortis“强壮”，不是 facere“做”。

abstract.en: Picture two arrows: the slower one in the bullseye, the faster one outside the ring.
abstract.cn: 想象两支箭：慢的那支插在靶心，快的那支落在环外。

abstract.en: The same bullseye is asked of drugs, offices, policies, speeches, budgets, classrooms, and management theory.
abstract.cn: 同一个靶心可以被拿来问药物、机关、政策、演讲、预算、课堂与管理理论。

abstract.en: Every sense asks the same thing: did it produce what it was meant to produce?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问同一件事：它有没有产出它本该产出的东西？

examples.en: The panel questioned the effectiveness of the new patrol system.
examples.cn: 专家组质疑这套新巡逻系统的有效性。

examples.en: Effectiveness in the clinic was lower than efficacy in the trial.
examples.cn: 临床实效低于试验中的效力。

examples.en: They chose the simpler plan for cost-effectiveness, not prestige.
examples.cn: 他们基于成本效益而非排场选择了更简单的方案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一费克提舞呢事」——花一费克力气，提得起、舞得动，事真办成了 → effectiveness 有效性

root: 拉丁语 efficere“做出、完成”＝ex-“出”＋facere“做、造”；其过去分词 effectus 加 -ivus 成 effectivus“有产出力的”，再入英语作 effective，加 -ness 成 effectiveness。核心是“把事真正做成”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses ask whether the intended result happened. What changes is the intended result — a saved life, a treated patient, a met goal, changed behaviour, a persuaded audience, value for money, learning gained, or the right goal itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在问“预期的结果有没有发生”。变化的只是预期结果——救回的性命、治好的病人、达成的目标、改变的行为、被说服的听众、划算的价值、获得的学习，或目标本身是否正确。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow in the bullseye, beside a faster arrow outside the ring.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支箭插在靶心，旁边一支更快的箭落在环外。

branches.en: AIM AND RESULT: the noun asks whether an action achieved what it was meant to, whether in a system or in a policy.
branches.cn: 目标与结果：这个名词问行动是否达成既定目标，不论在系统还是政策中。

branches.en: REAL CONDITIONS: effectiveness is efficacy tested in messy clinics rather than clean trials.
branches.cn: 真实条件：实效是效力在混乱诊所而非洁净试验中的版本。

branches.en: THE RIGHT GOAL: an institution can be busy and efficient while aiming at the wrong target.
branches.cn: 正确的目标：机构可以很忙、很高效，却瞄错了靶。

branches.en: AUDIENCE AND LEARNER: speech and teaching are effective when the hearer or student actually changes.
branches.cn: 受众与学习者：只有当听者或学生真的改变，演讲与教学才算有效。

branches.en: A DENOMINATOR: cost-effectiveness adds money underneath the result, turning achievement into a ratio.
branches.cn: 分母：成本效益在结果下面加上钱，把“达成”变成比率。

intro.en: Effectiveness is effective plus -ness. The suffix -ness, from Old English -nes, turns an adjective into a quality noun; effective itself is Latin effectivus, from efficere.
intro.cn: effectiveness 是 effective 加 -ness。后缀 -ness 出自古英语 -nes，把形容词变成性质名词；effective 本身是拉丁语 effectivus，源于 efficere。

latinIntro.en: efficere joins ex- 'out' with facere 'do, make'. facere supplies the stems fact-, fect- and fic-, visible in effect, affect, defect, perfect, sufficient and efficient.
latinIntro.cn: efficere 把 ex-“出”与 facere“做、造”结合。facere 提供 fact-、fect-、fic- 词干，见于 effect、affect、defect、perfect、sufficient、efficient。

items.meaning: the quality of producing the intended result
items.meaningCN: 产生预期结果的性质（-ness 构成性质名词）
items.example: The effectiveness of the filter was tested monthly.
items.exampleCN: 这个过滤器的有效性每月检测一次。

items.meaning: producing the intended result; in force
items.meaningCN: 有效的；生效的（-ive 表示能力）
items.example: The vaccine is effective against the strain.
items.exampleCN: 这种疫苗对该毒株有效。

items.meaning: in a way that produces results; in practice
items.meaningCN: 有效地；实际上
items.example: The rule effectively ended the practice.
items.exampleCN: 这条规定实际上终止了这种做法。

items.meaning: a result, or to bring about
items.meaningCN: 效果；影响；使产生
items.example: The change had little effect on prices.
items.exampleCN: 这一变化对价格几乎没有影响。

items.meaning: the power to produce a desired effect
items.meaningCN: 效力；产生预期效果的效能
items.example: Trials measured the drug's efficacy.
items.exampleCN: 试验测量了这种药的效力。

items.meaning: producing the desired effect
items.meaningCN: 有效力的；灵验的
items.example: The remedy was efficacious in most cases.
items.exampleCN: 这种疗法在多数病例中有效。

items.meaning: output per unit of input
items.meaningCN: 效率；投入产出比
items.example: The motor's efficiency improved by ten percent.
items.exampleCN: 这台电机的效率提高了百分之十。

items.meaning: achieving results with little waste
items.meaningCN: 高效的；效率高的
items.example: An efficient pump uses less power.
items.exampleCN: 高效的泵耗电更少。

items.meaning: not producing the intended result
items.meaningCN: 无效的
items.example: The appeal was ineffective.
items.exampleCN: 这项呼吁没有效果。

items.meaning: producing the desired result, often of action
items.meaningCN: 奏效的；有效果的（较正式）
items.example: Only a change of law proved effectual.
items.exampleCN: 只有修改法律才真正奏效。

latinEntries.meaning: a doing, an accomplishment, a result

definition_zh: 效率；投入产出比；能源效率；（人与方法的）不浪费时间；经济效率（配置效率、技术效率）；行政效率；热效率；市场效率；单间小公寓（美式旧称）
definition_en: the ratio of useful output to the input of energy, time, or resources; also the quality of working without waste, and several technical measures built on that ratio
core_image: 一台水车把落下的水几乎全部变成了转动的力，只有少量溅出
scene: The waterwheel turns almost every drop into motion, and only a little spray escapes. The waterwheel's efficiency is measured by how little spray escapes.
sceneCN: 这里 efficiency 是「投入与产出的比率」（第 1 个义项：效率）；句意：水车的效率由溅出多少水来衡量。图中可辨识物件：水车、落下的水流、转轴、溅出的水花、测量刻度。

forms.label: 复数（多种效率／多间单间公寓）

senses.title: Output over input: useful work divided by what was spent
senses.titleCN: 产出除以投入：有用功与花费之比
senses.definition: the ratio of useful output to the total input of energy, material, or effort
senses.definitionCN: 有用产出与所投入能量、材料或劳力总量之比
senses.example: The plant's efficiency rose from forty to sixty percent.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂的效率从百分之四十提高到六十。
senses.why: Efficiency comes from Latin efficientia, from efficere 'accomplish'. The modern ratio sense grew out of engineering: of the work put in, how much comes out useful?
senses.whyCN: efficiency 出自拉丁语 efficientia，源于 efficere“完成”。现代比率义从工程中长出来：投入的功里，有多少变成有用的产出？

senses.title: Energy efficiency: the same service for less power
senses.titleCN: 能源效率：同样服务，更少电力
senses.definition: the amount of useful service obtained per unit of energy consumed
senses.definitionCN: 每消耗一单位能量所获得的有用服务量
senses.example: Better insulation raised the building's energy efficiency.
senses.exampleCN: 更好的保温提升了这座建筑的能源效率。
senses.why: The ratio gets a fuel on top: kilowatt-hours in, warmth and light out. Policy uses this sense because a higher ratio means the same comfort with less generation.
senses.whyCN: 这个比率被加上了一个“分子对象”：输入的千瓦时，输出的温暖与光。政策使用这个义项，因为比率更高意味着同样的舒适、更少的发电。

senses.title: Personal efficiency: no wasted motion
senses.titleCN: 个人效率：没有多余动作
senses.definition: the quality of working quickly and orderly without wasted steps
senses.definitionCN: 迅速有序、没有多余步骤地工作的性质
senses.example: She ran the clinic with an efficiency that patients could feel.
senses.exampleCN: 她把诊所运营得高效，病人能感受到。
senses.why: Taylor's time studies moved the word from machines to workers. The same arithmetic applies: useful minutes divided by paid minutes.
senses.whyCN: 泰勒的时间研究把这个词从机器移到工人身上。同一套算术仍适用：有用分钟除以付薪分钟。

senses.title: Economic efficiency: resources go where they are worth most
senses.titleCN: 经济效率：资源流向最值钱的地方
senses.definition: the allocation of resources so that waste is minimised and value is maximised
senses.definitionCN: 使浪费最小、价值最大的资源配置方式
senses.example: The reform aimed at allocative efficiency rather than at output alone.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革瞄准的是配置效率，而不只是产量。
senses.why: Economics splits the term into allocative and technical efficiency. The first asks whether the right things are produced; the second whether they are produced with least input.
senses.whyCN: 经济学把这个术语分成配置效率与技术效率。前者问是否生产了对的东西，后者问是否用最少投入生产。

senses.title: Administrative efficiency: fewer steps to the same decision
senses.titleCN: 行政效率：同样决定，更少环节
senses.definition: the speed and economy with which an organisation reaches and implements decisions
senses.definitionCN: 组织达成并执行决定的速度与经济性
senses.example: Digitising the forms improved administrative efficiency more than hiring did.
senses.exampleCN: 把表格数字化比增加人手更能提高行政效率。
senses.why: In administration the input is staff time, and the output is a completed decision. Waste appears as waiting, duplication and rework.
senses.whyCN: 在行政中，投入是员工时间，产出是完成一项决定。浪费表现为等待、重复与返工。

senses.title: Thermal efficiency: heat turned into work
senses.titleCN: 热效率：热量变成机械功
senses.definition: the fraction of heat supplied to an engine that is converted into useful work
senses.definitionCN: 供给发动机的热量中转化为有用功的比例
senses.example: The turbine's thermal efficiency set the plant's fuel bill.
senses.exampleCN: 汽轮机的热效率决定了电厂的燃料账单。
senses.why: This is the strictest technical sense: a percentage bounded by thermodynamics. No engine reaches one hundred percent, which is why efficiency talk always implies a limit.
senses.whyCN: 这是最严格的技术义：一个受热力学限制的百分比。没有发动机能达到百分之百，因此谈效率总暗含一个上限。

senses.title: Market efficiency: prices carry the available information
senses.titleCN: 市场效率：价格携带可得信息
senses.definition: the extent to which prices reflect all available information and adjust without delay
senses.definitionCN: 价格反映全部可得信息并及时调整的程度
senses.example: The theory tests market efficiency by looking for predictable profits.
senses.exampleCN: 该理论通过寻找可预测的利润来检验市场效率。
senses.why: Finance uses efficiency for information rather than energy: a market is efficient when nothing left over can be arbitraged. The ratio here is information in, price out.
senses.whyCN: 金融学把 efficiency 用于信息而非能量：当没有可套利的剩余时，市场就是有效率的。这里的比率是“输入信息，输出价格”。

senses.title: An efficiency apartment: one room used well
senses.titleCN: 单间小公寓：把一间房用到极致
senses.definition: a small apartment consisting of one main room, rented as economical housing (American usage)
senses.definitionCN: 美式用法中指只有一间主房、作为经济住房出租的小公寓
senses.example: He rented an efficiency near the campus.
senses.exampleCN: 他在校园附近租了一间单间小公寓。
senses.why: American usage turned the abstract noun into a noun for the dwelling itself: a home organised for maximum use of minimal space. The name praises the layout, not the tenant.
senses.whyCN: 美式用法把这个抽象名词变成了住宅本身：一套按“最小空间最大利用”组织的住处。这个名字赞美的是布局，而不是租客。

intro.en: Efficiency comes from Latin efficientia 'efficient power', from efficere 'work out, accomplish'. English first used it in the late 16th century for 'power to accomplish'; the mechanical ratio sense developed in the 19th century with thermodynamics and engineering. The exact date of the ratio sense is approximate.
intro.cn: efficiency 出自拉丁语 efficientia“有产出力的能力”，源于 efficere“做出、完成”。英语在 16 世纪后期先以“完成某事的能力”使用它；机械比率义随热力学与工程学在 19 世纪发展出来。比率义的确切年代来源不确定。

items.en: Economic, administrative and market efficiency become standard terms, each with its own kind of input and output.
items.cn: 经济效率、行政效率、市场效率成为标准术语，各有自己的投入与产出。

items.en: Engineering fixes the ratio sense: useful work divided by energy supplied, expressed as a percentage.
items.cn: 工程学固定了比率义：有用功除以供给能量，以百分比表示。

items.en: English efficiency is recorded in the sense 'power to accomplish something', close to the older meaning of effective.
items.cn: 英语 efficiency 以“完成某事的能力”义见于记载，接近 effective 的较早含义。

items.en: efficientia is formed on efficere 'to accomplish', whose participle efficiens supplies the stem. The suffix -entia names a quality or state.
items.cn: efficientia 由 efficere“完成”构成，其分词 efficiens 提供词干。后缀 -entia 表示性质或状态。

items.en: efficere joins ex- 'out' with facere 'do, make', from PIE *dhe- 'to set, do'. The same facere gives effect, defect, perfect and sufficient.
items.cn: efficere 由 ex-“出”与 facere“做、造”构成，后者出自原始印欧语 *dhe-“放置、做”（重构形式）。同一个 facere 给出 effect、defect、perfect、sufficient。

note.en: The first group separates two true relatives from one different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分两个真正的同族词与一个不同词根的撞形词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the degree to which the intended result is achieved. Efficiency asks how little was spent; effectiveness asks whether the right thing was achieved.
entries.definitionCN: 既定结果的达成程度。efficiency 问花了多少，effectiveness 问是否达成了对的目标。

entries.definition: producing the desired effect, usually of a remedy. It is about success, not about input ratios.
entries.definitionCN: 产生预期效果的，常用于疗法。它讲成功，不讲投入比率。

entries.definition: having qualities conventionally associated with women. It comes from ex- plus femina 'woman', not from facere.
entries.definitionCN: 带有传统上被视为女性气质的。它出自 ex- 加 femina“女人”，不是 facere。

entries.definition: output per unit of labour or time. It is a productivity measure, while efficiency compares output to all inputs including energy.
entries.definitionCN: 每单位劳动或时间的产出。它是生产率指标，而 efficiency 把产出与包括能源在内的全部投入相比。

entries.definition: avoidance of waste, or the system of production. In the saving sense it overlaps efficiency but is less quantitative.
entries.definitionCN: 避免浪费，或生产体系。在“节省”义上与 efficiency 重叠，但更少量化。

entries.definition: the amount produced. It is an absolute figure, while efficiency is a ratio.
entries.definitionCN: 产出总量。它是绝对数值，而 efficiency 是比率。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: efficiency and efficient share the stem effic-, from efficere 'accomplish'.
normal.cn: efficiency 与 efficient 共享 effic- 词干，出自 efficere“完成”。

normal.en: efficiency is a ratio, so it always needs a numerator and a denominator: useful out divided by everything in.
normal.cn: efficiency 是比率，所以总要一个分子一个分母：有用产出除以全部投入。

normal.en: Effectiveness asks if you hit the target; efficiency asks how little fuel you used getting there.
normal.cn: effectiveness 问有没有打中靶；efficiency 问走过去用了多少油。

normal.en: A thermal efficiency can never reach 100 percent, which is why the word implies a limit.
normal.cn: 热效率永远到不了百分之百，这正是这个词总暗含上限的原因。

normal.en: An efficiency apartment is named for its layout, not for its tenant.
normal.cn: efficiency apartment 是按布局命名，不是按租客命名。

abstract.en: Picture a waterwheel that turns nearly every drop into motion, with only a little spray lost.
abstract.cn: 想象一台水车几乎把每一滴水都变成转动，只溅失一点点。

abstract.en: The same wheel becomes a power plant, a worker's day, a budget, an office, a turbine, a price, and a one-room flat.
abstract.cn: 同一台水车可以变成电厂、工人的一天、预算、办公室、汽轮机、价格，以及一间单间公寓。

abstract.en: Every sense divides something useful by something spent.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在用“有用的东西”除以“花掉的东西”。

examples.en: The new boiler raised fuel efficiency by a fifth.
examples.cn: 新锅炉把燃油效率提高了五分之一。

examples.en: Reviewers questioned the efficiency of a process with nine approvals.
examples.cn: 评审者质疑一个需要九道审批的流程的效率。

examples.en: The market's efficiency is tested by whether anyone can earn easy profits.
examples.cn: 市场是否有效率，要看有没有人能轻松获利。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一飞升水」——一飞升的水全变成力，几乎不浪费 → efficiency 效率

root: 拉丁语 efficientia“有产出力的能力”＝efficere“做出、完成”＋-entia（性质名词后缀）；efficere＝ex-“出”＋facere“做、造”。核心是“投入的东西有多少变成了有用的产出”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses divide a useful output by something spent. What changes is the pair of terms — joules, minutes, money, staff hours, heat, information, or floor area.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在用“有用产出”除以“花掉的东西”。变化的是这对项——焦耳、分钟、金钱、员工小时、热量、信息，或楼面面积。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a waterwheel turns almost every drop of falling water into motion.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台水车几乎把每一滴落水都变成转动。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL RATIO: work out divided by energy in, from a plant to a turbine.
branches.cn: 物理比率：输出的功除以输入的能，从电厂到汽轮机。

branches.en: ENERGY SERVICE: the same warmth or light for fewer kilowatt-hours.
branches.cn: 能源服务：同样的温暖或光，用更少的千瓦时。

branches.en: HUMAN TIME: a worker's or an office's useful minutes divided by paid minutes.
branches.cn: 人的时间：工人或办公室的有用分钟除以付薪分钟。

branches.en: ALLOCATION: resources should go where they produce the most value, not merely be used quickly.
branches.cn: 配置：资源应流向产出价值最大之处，而不只是被快速用掉。

branches.en: TWO EXTENSIONS: prices absorb information, and a one-room flat absorbs space.
branches.cn: 两个延伸：价格吸收信息，单间公寓吸收空间。

intro.en: Efficiency is Latin efficientia: the stem effic- plus -ency. The suffix -ency, from Latin -entia, names a quality or state; English uses it for both an ability and a computed ratio.
intro.cn: efficiency 是拉丁语 efficientia：词干 effic- 加 -ency。后缀 -ency 出自拉丁语 -entia，表示性质或状态；英语既用它指能力，也用它指算出的比率。

latinIntro.en: efficere 'accomplish' joins ex- 'out' and facere 'do'. The participle efficiens supplies effic-, and facere supplies the wider family effect, defect, perfect, sufficient.
latinIntro.cn: efficere“完成”由 ex-“出”与 facere“做”构成。分词 efficiens 提供 effic-，facere 则提供更广的词族 effect、defect、perfect、sufficient。

items.meaning: the power to accomplish, or the ratio of output to input
items.meaningCN: 完成的能力；投入产出比（-ency 构成性质名词）
items.example: The pump's efficiency fell after the seal wore.
items.exampleCN: 密封磨损后，这台泵的效率下降。

items.meaning: producing results with little waste
items.meaningCN: 高效的；少浪费地产生结果的
items.example: An efficient worker finishes without overtime.
items.exampleCN: 高效的工人不用加班就能完成。

items.meaning: in a way that wastes little
items.meaningCN: 高效地；少浪费地
items.example: The line runs efficiently at low speed.
items.exampleCN: 这条生产线在低速下运行得很高效。

items.meaning: wasting resources
items.meaningCN: 低效的；浪费资源的
items.example: The old furnace was inefficient.
items.exampleCN: 旧炉子很费燃料。

items.meaning: waste in a process
items.meaningCN: 低效；流程中的浪费
items.example: Auditors found inefficiency in the supply chain.
items.exampleCN: 审计人员在供应链中发现了低效环节。

items.meaning: power to produce a desired effect
items.meaningCN: 效力；产生预期效果的能力
items.example: The efficacy of the vaccine was high.
items.exampleCN: 这种疫苗的效力很高。

items.meaning: effective, producing the intended result
items.meaningCN: 有效力的；灵验的
items.example: The treatment proved efficacious.
items.exampleCN: 这种治疗被证明有效。

items.meaning: producing the intended result
items.meaningCN: 有效的；生效的
items.example: The policy was effective from January.
items.exampleCN: 该政策自一月起生效。

items.meaning: a result, or to bring about
items.meaningCN: 效果；使产生
items.example: The drug had a rapid effect.
items.exampleCN: 这种药起效很快。

items.meaning: enough, meeting a need
items.meaningCN: 充足的；足够的（与 facere 同根）
items.example: The evidence was sufficient for a verdict.
items.exampleCN: 证据足以作出裁决。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 有产出力的能力；完成的能力

definition_zh: 高效地；效率高地；少浪费地；系统顺畅运转地；组织把活办完地；动作省力地；表达简洁地；按产出比率地
definition_en: in a manner that produces results with little waste of time, energy, or resources
core_image: 一条流水线上的瓶子一个接一个通过，没有一只停住，也没有一只被碰倒
scene: Bottles pass along the line one after another; none stops, none is knocked over. The line runs efficiently because no bottle stops and none is knocked over.
sceneCN: 这里 efficiently 是「高效地、少浪费地」（第 1 个义项：高效地）；句意：流水线高效运转，没有一只瓶子停住，也没有一只被碰倒。图中可辨识物件：传送带、排列整齐的瓶子、机械臂、指示灯、计时器。

collocations.zh: 定价有效率的（信息已反映在价格中）

senses.title: With little waste: the shortest necessary route
senses.titleCN: 少浪费地：走最短的必要路径
senses.definition: in a way that achieves a result with minimal waste of time, energy, or material
senses.definitionCN: 以最少浪费时间、能量或材料的方式达成结果
senses.example: The team finished the survey efficiently, without a second trip.
senses.exampleCN: 团队高效地完成了调查，没有跑第二趟。
senses.why: Efficiently is efficient plus -ly. Efficient comes from Latin efficientem, the present participle of efficere 'accomplish', so the adverb describes how the accomplishing was done.
senses.whyCN: efficiently 是 efficient 加 -ly。efficient 出自拉丁语 efficientem，即 efficere“完成”的现在分词，因此这个副词描述“完成的过程是怎么进行的”。

senses.title: Smoothly: a system with no stalls
senses.titleCN: 顺畅地：系统不卡顿
senses.definition: of a system or machine, operating without interruption or wasted motion
senses.definitionCN: 指系统或机器不中断、不做无用动作地运行
senses.example: The cooling system efficiently handles the midday load.
senses.exampleCN: 冷却系统高效地应对正午的负荷。
senses.why: Here the adverb modifies a process rather than a person: efficiency appears as smooth flow, with no queue building up and no component idling.
senses.whyCN: 这里副词修饰过程而非人：效率表现为流动顺畅，没有队列堆积，也没有部件空转。

senses.title: Organisationally: work processed without duplication
senses.titleCN: 组织层面：工作不重复地流转
senses.definition: of an organisation, completing tasks without duplicated steps or avoidable delay
senses.definitionCN: 指组织完成任务时不重复步骤、不出现本可避免的延误
senses.example: The agency processed the claims efficiently after the forms were merged.
senses.exampleCN: 表格合并后，该机构高效地处理了理赔。
senses.why: In organisations, waste is mostly waiting and rework. The adverb therefore often describes a flow design rather than an individual's speed.
senses.whyCN: 在组织中，浪费主要是等待与返工。因此这个副词常描述流程设计，而不是个人的速度。

senses.title: With little effort: bodies and tools that save energy
senses.titleCN: 省力地：身体与工具节省能量
senses.definition: of movement, using the least muscular or mechanical effort needed
senses.definitionCN: 指动作以所需的最少肌肉或机械力量完成
senses.example: She rowed efficiently, letting the boat run between strokes.
senses.exampleCN: 她划得很省力，让船在两次划桨之间自行滑行。
senses.why: Efficiency's ratio can be felt in the body: the same distance for fewer strokes. The adverb then describes rhythm, not speed.
senses.whyCN: 效率的比率可以在身体里被感觉到：同样的距离，更少的桨数。此时副词描述节奏，而非速度。

senses.title: Concisely: saying the same in fewer words
senses.titleCN: 简洁地：用更少的词说同样的事
senses.definition: expressing something clearly with few words
senses.definitionCN: 用很少的词把意思讲清楚
senses.example: He explained the method efficiently, in three sentences.
senses.exampleCN: 他用三句话高效地讲清了方法。
senses.why: When the input is breath or attention, efficiency becomes concision. The ratio is meaning out over words in.
senses.whyCN: 当投入是气息或注意力时，效率就变成简洁。比率是“输出的意思除以输入的词”。

senses.title: By ratio: as measured in output per input
senses.titleCN: 按比率：以投入产出比衡量
senses.definition: in a manner described by the numerical ratio of output to input
senses.definitionCN: 以产出与投入的数值比来描述的方式
senses.example: The engine runs most efficiently at a steady 2,000 revolutions.
senses.exampleCN: 这台发动机在稳定两千转时效率最高。
senses.why: The adverb can attach to a measured optimum: there is a speed at which the ratio peaks. Here 'efficiently' is shorthand for 'at the best point on the efficiency curve'.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词可以接一个测得的最优点：存在某个转速使比率达到峰值。此处 efficiently 是“处在效率曲线最佳点”的简写。

senses.title: Administratively: decisions cleared without delay
senses.titleCN: 行政上：决定不被拖延地办完
senses.definition: of public or corporate administration, reaching decisions and delivering services promptly
senses.definitionCN: 指公共或企业管理及时作出决定并交付服务
senses.example: The city now issues permits more efficiently than before.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市现在发放许可比过去更高效。
senses.why: Public administration measures efficiency in days saved. The adverb carries an implicit comparison: faster or with fewer steps than the previous arrangement.
senses.whyCN: 公共行政用“省下的天数”衡量效率。这个副词暗含比较：比原先的安排更快或环节更少。

senses.title: In market terms: prices that already know
senses.titleCN: 市场意义：价格已经知道
senses.definition: of a market, adjusting prices quickly so that available information is reflected
senses.definitionCN: 指市场价格迅速调整，使可得信息得到反映
senses.example: The shares were efficiently priced within minutes of the news.
senses.exampleCN: 消息发布几分钟内，股价就被有效率地定价了。
senses.why: Finance uses the adverb for information processing: a market that prices efficiently leaves no easy arbitrage. Input is news, output is price.
senses.whyCN: 金融学用这个副词描述信息处理：定价有效率的市场不留下轻易的套利空间。投入是消息，产出是价格。

intro.en: Efficiently is efficient plus -ly. Efficient comes from Latin efficientem, the present participle of efficere 'work out, accomplish'. The English adverb follows the adjective in the ordinary way, with -ly from Old English -līce.
intro.cn: efficiently 是 efficient 加 -ly。efficient 出自拉丁语 efficientem，即 efficere“做出、完成”的现在分词。这个英语副词按常规由形容词派生，-ly 出自古英语 -līce。

items.en: The adverb spreads into computing, logistics and market economics, wherever a ratio of output to input is at issue.
items.cn: 这个副词扩展到计算、物流与市场经济学，凡涉及投入产出比之处都能用。

items.en: Engineering measurement makes 'running efficiently' a precise comparative claim rather than a general compliment.
items.cn: 工程测量使“运行得高效”成为精确的比较判断，而不是泛泛的称赞。

items.en: Efficient is recorded in English with the sense 'productive, capable of accomplishing'; the adverb follows.
items.cn: efficient 以“有产出力的、能完成的”义见于英语记载；副词随后出现。

items.en: efficiens is the present participle of efficere, so efficient literally means 'accomplishing'. The adverb keeps that verbal force: it describes how the accomplishing goes.
items.cn: efficiens 是 efficere 的现在分词，所以 efficient 字面就是“正在完成的”。副词保留了这层动词性：它描述“完成得怎么样”。

items.en: facere 'do, make' is generally referred to PIE *dhe- 'to set, do'. The same root gives effect, defect, perfect and sufficient.
items.cn: facere“做、造”一般认为出自原始印欧语 *dhe-“放置、做”（重构形式）。同一词根给出 effect、defect、perfect、sufficient。

note.en: The first group separates two same-root adverbs and one genuine different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分两个同根副词和一个不同词根的撞形词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: in a way that achieves the intended result, or in practice. It asks whether the aim was met, not how little was spent.
entries.definitionCN: 以达成预期结果的方式；实际上。它问目标是否达成，而非花了多少。

entries.definition: to a degree that is enough. It also uses facere, but under sub- 'up to', so it means 'enough', not 'without waste'.
entries.definitionCN: 达到足够的程度。它同样用 facere，但前缀是 sub-“达到”，因此意为“足够”，不是“不浪费”。

entries.definition: a carved or burnt image of a person. It comes from ex- plus fingere 'to shape', not from facere 'to do'.
entries.definitionCN: 人的雕像或焚毁的人像。它出自 ex- 加 fingere“塑形”，不是 facere“做”。

entries.definition: in a way that produces much. It stresses quantity of output, while efficiently stresses low input per output.
entries.definitionCN: 以产出很多的方式。它强调产出量，而 efficiently 强调每份产出的低投入。

entries.definition: in cost terms, or without waste of money. It overlaps efficiency but often concerns money rather than a physical ratio.
entries.definitionCN: 在成本上；不浪费钱地。它与效率重叠，但常指钱而非物理比率。

entries.definition: without difficulty or interruption. It describes the feel of a process, while efficiently adds the idea of measured waste.
entries.definitionCN: 无困难、无中断地。它描述过程的触感，而 efficiently 另含“浪费可测”之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: efficiently is efficient plus -ly, the ordinary adverb pattern.
normal.cn: efficiently 是 efficient 加 -ly，普通副词构词法。

normal.en: efficient comes from efficere, so efficiently describes how the 'accomplishing' was done.
normal.cn: efficient 出自 efficere，所以 efficiently 描述“完成得怎么样”。

normal.en: effectively asks whether you hit the goal; efficiently asks how little you spent doing it.
normal.cn: effectively 问有没有达成目标；efficiently 问做成它花了多少。

normal.en: sufficiently shares facere but begins with sub-, so it means 'enough', not 'economical'.
normal.cn: sufficiently 共享 facere，但以 sub- 开头，意为“足够”，不是“节约”。

normal.en: Running efficiently is not running fast: it is finding the speed where the ratio peaks.
normal.cn: 运行得 efficiently 不等于跑得快：而是找到比率最高的那个速度。

abstract.en: Picture bottles moving down a line with no gaps and no collisions: every motion is necessary.
abstract.cn: 想象瓶子在流水线上移动，没有空隙也没有碰撞：每个动作都是必要的。

abstract.en: The same line becomes an engine, an office, a rower, a sentence, a permit desk, and a share price.
abstract.cn: 同一条流水线可以变成发动机、办公室、划船者、一句话、许可窗口与股价。

abstract.en: Every sense asks how much was spent for each unit of result.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：每单位结果花了多少。

examples.en: The new software processes invoices more efficiently than the old system.
examples.cn: 新软件处理发票比旧系统更高效。

examples.en: She rowed efficiently, saving her strength for the last stretch.
examples.cn: 她划得省力，把体力留给最后一段。

examples.en: The market priced the news efficiently within a few minutes.
examples.cn: 市场在几分钟内就把消息有效地反映在价格里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一飞身提溜」——一飞身把东西提溜走，一个多余动作都没有 → efficiently 高效地

root: 拉丁语 efficere“做出、完成”＝ex-“出”＋facere“做、造”，其现在分词 efficiens 入英语作 efficient，加 -ly 成 efficiently。核心是“每个动作都必要，没有浪费”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses describe the same manner: result achieved with little spent. What changes is the system being described — a task, a machine, an office, a body, a sentence, an optimum, a permit desk, a market.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描述同一种方式：用很少的花费达成结果。变化的是被描述的系统——一项任务、一台机器、一间办公室、一具身体、一句话、一个最优点、一个许可窗口、一个市场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bottles pass along a line with no gaps and no collisions.
core.cn: 核心意象：瓶子沿流水线通过，既无空隙也无碰撞。

branches.en: MANNER AND FLOW: the adverb says a result was reached with little waste, and that the process ran without stalls.
branches.cn: 方式与流动：副词表示结果以很少浪费达成，且过程不卡顿。

branches.en: ORGANISATION: duplication and delay are removed from work, whether in an agency or a company.
branches.cn: 组织：工作里的重复与延误被去掉，无论在机关还是公司。

branches.en: THE BODY: fewer strokes for the same distance, efficiency felt as rhythm.
branches.cn: 身体：同样距离用更少的桨，效率被感觉为节奏。

branches.en: LANGUAGE: meaning out over words in, efficiency as concision.
branches.cn: 语言：输出的意思除以输入的词，效率即简洁。

branches.en: OPTIMA: a machine has a best point on its curve, and a market prices news without leaving easy profit.
branches.cn: 最优点：机器在曲线上有最佳点，市场把消息定价到不剩轻易利润。

intro.en: Efficiently is efficient plus -ly. The -ly ending comes from Old English -līce and turns adjectives into manner adverbs; efficient is Latin efficiens, the participle of efficere.
intro.cn: efficiently 是 efficient 加 -ly。-ly 出自古英语 -līce，把形容词变成方式副词；efficient 是拉丁语 efficiens，即 efficere 的分词。

latinIntro.en: efficere joins ex- 'out' with facere 'do'. Its participle efficiens means 'accomplishing', which is why the adverb can describe a process as well as a person.
latinIntro.cn: efficere 把 ex-“出”与 facere“做”结合。其分词 efficiens 意为“正在完成”，这正是这个副词既能修饰人也能修饰过程的原因。

items.meaning: in a way that wastes little
items.meaningCN: 以很少浪费的方式（-ly 构成方式副词）
items.example: The warehouse now ships orders efficiently.
items.exampleCN: 仓库现在发货很高效。

items.meaning: accomplishing with little waste
items.meaningCN: 高效的；少浪费地完成的
items.example: The motor is efficient at low load.
items.exampleCN: 这台电机在低负载时效率高。

items.meaning: output per unit of input
items.meaningCN: 效率；投入产出比
items.example: Efficiency is the ratio the adverb presupposes.
items.exampleCN: 效率正是这个副词所预设的比率。

items.meaning: with avoidable waste
items.meaningCN: 低效地；有可避免浪费地
items.example: The old process handled returns inefficiently.
items.exampleCN: 旧流程处理退货很低效。

items.meaning: in a way that achieves the aim
items.meaningCN: 有效地；实际上
items.example: The team effectively closed the case.
items.exampleCN: 团队有效地结了案。

items.meaning: to an adequate degree
items.meaningCN: 充分地；足够地
items.example: The soil was sufficiently wet to plant.
items.exampleCN: 土壤湿得够种东西了。

items.meaning: in a way that yields much
items.meaningCN: 富有成效地；多产地
items.example: They spent the morning productively.
items.exampleCN: 他们上午过得很有效率。

items.meaning: in cost terms, or without waste
items.meaningCN: 在经济上；节约地
items.example: The plant now runs economically.
items.exampleCN: 这家工厂现在运行省钱。

items.meaning: without interruption or friction
items.meaningCN: 顺畅地；无摩擦地
items.example: The handover went smoothly.
items.exampleCN: 交接进行得很顺畅。

items.meaning: according to reason
items.meaningCN: 理性地
items.example: Resources were allocated rationally.
items.exampleCN: 资源被理性地分配。

definition_zh: 详述；精心制作；细化；附加细节；理论或计划的展开；装饰性加工；认知精细加工（心理学）；生物结构的复杂化
definition_en: the act or result of working something out in detail, adding parts or explanation until it is full; also, the added detail itself
core_image: 一张草图被一层层加上标注、剖面和箭头，最后密得几乎盖住原线
scene: A rough sketch is covered with labels, sections and arrows until the original line is almost hidden. Every added label and arrow is part of the elaboration of that sketch.
sceneCN: 这里 elaboration 是「逐层添加细节、把东西做细」（第 1 个义项：详述、细化）；句意：每一条标注与箭头都是那张草图细化的一部分。图中可辨识物件：草图、标注线、剖面图、箭头、叠放的描图纸。

pos.zh: 详述；细化；精心制作；附加细节

collocations.zh: 精细复述（心理学记忆策略）

forms.label: 复数（多处细节／多种加工）

derivatives.zh: 详细阐述；精心制作；复杂精细的

senses.title: Working it out in detail: adding until it is full
senses.titleCN: 细化：一直加到完整
senses.definition: the act of developing something in detail by adding parts, steps, or explanation
senses.definitionCN: 通过添加部分、步骤或说明来详细展开某事的行为
senses.example: The plan needed elaboration before anyone could build from it.
senses.exampleCN: 这份计划需要细化，别人才能照着施工。
senses.why: Elaboration is Latin elaboratio, from elaborare 'to labor out', ex- 'out' plus laborare 'to work'. The image is work applied until the thing comes out complete.
senses.whyCN: elaboration 是拉丁语 elaboratio，源于 elaborare“劳作而成”，即 ex-“出”加 laborare“工作”。意象是不断施力，直到东西完整地出来。

senses.title: The added detail itself: an amplification
senses.titleCN: 所加的细节：一段铺陈
senses.definition: a particular added explanation, example, or ornament that develops a point
senses.definitionCN: 用来展开某一要点的具体补充说明、例证或修饰
senses.example: His speech was full of elaborations that obscured the main claim.
senses.exampleCN: 他的演讲满是铺陈，反而遮住了主要论点。
senses.why: The action noun can shift to its product, as 'building' can mean a building. Here elaboration is a thing added, not the process of adding.
senses.whyCN: 动作名词可以转指其产物，正如 building 既可指建造也可指建筑物。这里的 elaboration 是被加上的东西，而不是添加的过程。

senses.title: Theory development: extending a model
senses.titleCN: 理论展开：把模型往外扩
senses.definition: the extension of a theory or model with further distinctions and mechanisms
senses.definitionCN: 用更多区分与机制来扩展某一理论或模型
senses.example: The paper's elaboration of the model added three testable predictions.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文对模型的展开增加了三项可检验的预测。
senses.why: In research, elaboration is not decoration but specification: each added part must be capable of being tested. The 'labor' is intellectual.
senses.whyCN: 在研究中，elaboration 不是装饰而是具体化：每个添加部分都必须可被检验。这里的“劳作”是智力上的。

senses.title: Plan detail: from outline to instructions
senses.titleCN: 计划细节：从提纲到作业指导
senses.definition: the conversion of a general plan into detailed, actionable steps
senses.definitionCN: 把总体计划转化为详细可执行的步骤
senses.example: The elaboration of the schedule took longer than the design.
senses.exampleCN: 把进度表细化所花的时间比设计还长。
senses.why: A plan is elaborated when every step has an owner and a time. The noun measures the distance between an intention and a set of instructions.
senses.whyCN: 当每一步都有责任人和时间，计划就被细化了。这个名词衡量“意图”与“一套指令”之间的距离。

senses.title: Spoken expansion: saying more about it
senses.titleCN: 口头铺陈：就这一点多说几句
senses.definition: the act of expanding on a point in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 在口头或书面表达中对某一要点加以展开
senses.example: The chair asked for elaboration on the second recommendation.
senses.exampleCN: 主席要求就第二项建议作进一步说明。
senses.why: This is the metalinguistic sense: 'could you elaborate?' asks for more words, not more parts. The labor is now verbal.
senses.whyCN: 这是元语言层面的义项：“能不能 elaborate 一下？”要的是更多话，而不是更多零件。此时的“劳作”是言辞上的。

senses.title: Ornamental working: the detail that is craft
senses.titleCN: 装饰性加工：细节本身就是工艺
senses.definition: intricate workmanship or ornamentation added to an object or design
senses.definitionCN: 加在物件或设计上的繁复工艺或装饰
senses.example: The carving's elaboration marks it as a master's work.
senses.exampleCN: 这件雕刻的繁复细节表明它是大师之作。
senses.why: Here the added parts are not for clarity but for beauty. The same word covers both explanation and ornament because both require prolonged labour.
senses.whyCN: 这里加上的部分不是为了清楚，而是为了美。同一个词既覆盖说明也覆盖装饰，因为两者都需要长时间的劳作。

senses.title: Cognitive elaboration: linking new to known
senses.titleCN: 认知精细加工：把新的接到已知上
senses.definition: the mental process of connecting new information to existing knowledge to aid memory
senses.definitionCN: 把新信息与已有知识联系起来以帮助记忆的心理过程
senses.example: Elaboration improved recall more than repetition did.
senses.exampleCN: 精细加工比重复更能改善回忆。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the word for depth of processing: the learner adds links, examples and inferences. The added parts are now mental connections.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借这个词指加工深度：学习者加上联系、例子与推论。此时被加上的部分是心理联结。

senses.title: Biological elaboration: structure growing complex
senses.titleCN: 生物复杂化：结构越长越复杂
senses.definition: the evolutionary development of more complex structures or behaviours
senses.definitionCN: 更复杂的结构或行为在演化中的发展
senses.example: The elaboration of the shell parallels the elaboration of the burrow.
senses.exampleCN: 壳的复杂化与洞穴的复杂化是同步的。
senses.why: Evolutionary biology uses the noun for added structure, often with a cost: complexity is elaborated only when it pays. The 'labor' is blind selection over generations.
senses.whyCN: 演化生物学用这个名词指增加的结构，且常带代价：只有划算时复杂结构才会被 elaborat。这里的“劳作”是跨越世代的盲目选择。

intro.en: Elaboration comes from Latin elaboratio, from elaborare 'to labor out, work out', itself ex- 'out' plus laborare 'to work', from labor 'toil'. English borrowed it in the 16th century. The 'detail' sense and the 'ornament' sense both descend from the same image of prolonged work.
intro.cn: elaboration 出自拉丁语 elaboratio，源于 elaborare“劳作而成、做出”，即 ex-“出”加 laborare“工作”，而 labor 意为“辛劳”。英语于 16 世纪借入。‘细节’义与‘装饰’义都来自同一个“长时间劳作”的意象。

items.en: Psychology adopts elaboration for deep processing, and biology uses it for the evolution of complex structures.
items.cn: 心理学采用 elaboration 指深度加工，生物学用它指复杂结构的演化。

items.en: English elaboration is recorded, borrowed from Latin elaboratio with the sense of working something out fully.
items.cn: 英语 elaboration 见于记载，借自拉丁语 elaboratio，意为把某事做到底、做完整。

items.en: elaboratio is the action noun of elaborare: ex- 'out' plus laborare 'to work'. The noun names both the effort and its finished result.
items.cn: elaboratio 是 elaborare 的动作名词：ex-“出”加 laborare“工作”。这个名词既指付出的努力，也指完成的结果。

items.en: labor 'toil, hardship' is generally connected with PIE *slab- 'to slip, be weak', though the semantic path is reconstructed rather than attested.
items.cn: labor“辛劳、艰难”一般认为与原始印欧语 *slab-“滑、虚弱”相关，但这条语义路径是重构而非有直接文献佐证，*slab- 为重构形式。

items.en: laboratory also comes from laborare 'to work', but through medieval Latin laboratorium, a place for work. It is a true relative, not a look-alike.
items.cn: laboratory 同样出自 laborare“工作”，但经由中世纪拉丁语 laboratorium（工作之处）。它是真正的同族词，不是撞形词。

note.en: The first group separates two true relatives from one different-root neighbour; the second compares words that share only part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组区分两个真正的同族词和一个不同词根的撞形词；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: a room for scientific work. It comes from medieval Latin laboratorium, 'a place for labour', from the same laborare as elaboration.
entries.definitionCN: 进行科学工作的房间。它出自中世纪拉丁语 laboratorium“劳作之处”，与 elaboration 同用 laborare。

entries.definition: to work with others. It is con- 'together' plus laborare, so the labour is shared rather than detailed.
entries.definitionCN: 与他人一起工作。它是 con-“共同”加 laborare，因此“劳作”是共享的，而非细化的。

entries.definition: relating to the lips. It comes from labium 'lip', which is not labor 'toil'.
entries.definitionCN: 与嘴唇相关的。它出自 labium“唇”，不是 labor“辛劳”。

entries.definition: the act of expanding a statement or signal. It stresses making bigger, while elaboration stresses adding worked-out parts.
entries.definitionCN: 对陈述或信号的扩展。它强调“变大”，而 elaboration 强调“加上做细的部分”。

entries.definition: the improvement of something by small changes. It stresses precision and polish rather than the addition of parts.
entries.definitionCN: 通过细微改动来改进。它强调精确与打磨，而不是增加部分。

entries.definition: a small individual feature. It names the part, while elaboration names the act of adding parts.
entries.definitionCN: 小的个别特征。它命名部分本身，而 elaboration 命名添加部分的行为。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: elaboration is e- 'out' plus labor 'work' plus -ation: working something out until it is complete.
normal.cn: elaboration 是 e-“出”＋labor“劳动”＋-ation：一直把东西做出来、做到完整。

normal.en: The same labor gives laboratory, laborious and collaborate; all involve work, not lips.
normal.cn: 同一个 labor 给出 laboratory、laborious、collaborate，都关乎劳作，而非嘴唇。

normal.en: laboratory is a true relative: laboratorium means 'a place for work'.
normal.cn: laboratory 是真正的同族词：laboratorium 意为“工作之处”。

normal.en: labial comes from labium 'lip', which only looks like labor.
normal.cn: labial 出自 labium“唇”，只是看起来像 labor。

normal.en: Could you elaborate? means 'add words', while cognitive elaboration means 'add mental links'.
normal.cn: Could you elaborate? 意思是“多说几句”，而 cognitive elaboration 是“增加心理联结”。

abstract.en: Picture a sketch buried under labels, sections and arrows until the first line is almost gone.
abstract.cn: 想象一张草图被标注、剖面与箭头埋住，最初的线条几乎消失。

abstract.en: The same layers become a theory, a schedule, a speech, a carving, a memory and a shell.
abstract.cn: 同样的层层叠加可以变成理论、进度表、演讲、雕刻、记忆与贝壳。

abstract.en: Every sense asks how much worked-out material was added, and whether it helped or merely encrusted.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问：加了多多少经加工的材料，以及它是帮了忙，还是只堆成了壳。

examples.en: The proposal is sound but needs elaboration before funding.
examples.cn: 这个提案是合理的，但在拨款前需要细化。

examples.en: Her elaboration of the theory connected three separate literatures.
examples.cn: 她对理论的展开把三支彼此分离的文献连了起来。

examples.en: Elaboration during study helps memory more than rereading.
examples.cn: 学习时的精细加工比反复阅读更有助于记忆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一拉玻璃拉深」——一层层拉、一层层加深，细节越做越细 → elaboration 详述、细化

root: 拉丁语 elaboratio“劳作而成”＝elaborare（ex-“出”＋laborare“工作”，源于 labor“辛劳”）＋-atio（动作名词后缀）。核心是“持续下功夫，直到细节完整地长出来”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: work added layer by layer until the thing is full. What changes is what the layers are — steps, explanations, ornaments, mental links, or evolved structures.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一层层加上功夫，直到东西变完整。变化的只是这些层是什么——步骤、说明、装饰、心理联结，或演化出的结构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sketch buried under labels, sections and arrows until the first line nearly disappears.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张草图被标注、剖面与箭头层层埋住，最初的线条几乎不见。

branches.en: PROCESS AND PRODUCT: the labour of detailing and the detail that results share one noun.
branches.cn: 过程与产物：细化的劳作与由此产生的细节共用一个名词。

branches.en: SPECIFICATION: a theory or plan is elaborated until each added part can be tested or executed.
branches.cn: 具体化：理论或计划被展开，直到每个添加部分都可检验或可执行。

branches.en: WORDS: in conversation the added parts are sentences, and 'elaborate' means 'say more'.
branches.cn: 言辞：在对话中，被加上的部分是句子，elaborate 意为“多说一些”。

branches.en: CRAFT: when the added parts serve beauty rather than clarity, the same labour becomes ornament.
branches.cn: 工艺：当添加的部分服务于美而非清楚，同一种劳作就变成装饰。

branches.en: INNER AND EVOLVED LAYERS: the mind adds links to remember, and evolution adds structures that must pay for themselves.
branches.cn: 内在与演化的层：心智加上联结以记住，演化加上必须自偿其成本的结构。

intro.en: Elaboration is elaborate plus -ion. The suffix -ion, from Latin -ionem, names an action or its result; elaborate is Latin elaborare, ex- 'out' plus laborare 'to work'.
intro.cn: elaboration 是 elaborate 加 -ion。后缀 -ion 出自拉丁语 -ionem，表示动作或其结果；elaborate 是拉丁语 elaborare，即 ex-“出”加 laborare“工作”。

latinIntro.en: labor 'toil' supplies laborare 'to work'; the same family gives labor, laborious, laboratory and collaborate. labium 'lip' is a different root and accounts for labial.
latinIntro.cn: labor“辛劳”提供 laborare“工作”；同一词族给出 labor、laborious、laboratory、collaborate。labium“唇”是另一个词根，给出 labial。

items.meaning: the act or result of working something out in detail
items.meaningCN: 把某事做细的行为或其结果（-ion 构成动作名词）
items.example: The design's elaboration took six drafts.
items.exampleCN: 这个设计的细化花了六稿。

items.meaning: to work out in detail; or intricately made
items.meaningCN: 详细阐述、精心制作；或繁复精细的
items.example: She elaborated the point with two examples.
items.exampleCN: 她用两个例子展开了这一点。

items.meaning: in an intricate or detailed way
items.meaningCN: 精细地；繁复地
items.example: The hall was elaborately decorated.
items.exampleCN: 大厅装饰得繁复精致。

items.meaning: toil; to work hard
items.meaningCN: 劳动；辛劳；努力工作
items.example: The harvest required weeks of labor.
items.exampleCN: 收割需要数周的劳作。

items.meaning: requiring much effort
items.meaningCN: 费力的；辛苦的（-ious 构成性质形容词）
items.example: The translation was laborious but accurate.
items.exampleCN: 这项翻译很费力，但准确。

items.meaning: a place for scientific work
items.meaningCN: 实验室（字面“劳作之处”）
items.example: The samples were sent to the laboratory.
items.exampleCN: 样本被送到实验室。

items.meaning: to work together
items.meaningCN: 合作；协作（共同劳作）
items.example: Two institutes collaborated on the survey.
items.exampleCN: 两个研究所合作完成了这项调查。

items.meaning: the act of working together
items.meaningCN: 合作；协作行为
items.example: The book is a collaboration of historians.
items.exampleCN: 这本书是历史学家合作的成果。

items.meaning: relating to the lips
items.meaningCN: 唇音的；与唇相关的（词根 labium，“唇”）
items.example: The sound is labial, made with both lips.
items.exampleCN: 这个音是唇音，用双唇发出。

items.meaning: of time, to pass by
items.meaningCN: （时间）流逝（词根 labi“滑”，不是 labor）
items.example: Ten years elapsed before they met again.
